CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acquire_production_write_lease(p_lease_key text, p_owner_id uuid, p_ttl_seconds integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  acquired_owner UUID;
BEGIN
  IF p_ttl_seconds < 60 OR p_ttl_seconds > 10800 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_lease_ttl';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.production_write_leases (lease_key, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at)
  VALUES (p_lease_key, p_owner_id, NOW(), NOW() + make_interval(secs => p_ttl_seconds))
  ON CONFLICT (lease_key) DO UPDATE
  SET owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, acquired_at = EXCLUDED.acquired_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
  WHERE public.production_write_leases.expires_at <= NOW()
     OR public.production_write_leases.owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id
  RETURNING owner_id INTO acquired_owner;
  RETURN acquired_owner = p_owner_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_exchange_reported_valuation_transaction_v3_16_9(p_input exchange_reported_valuation_input_v3_13, p_caller uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(reported_valuation_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();v_id uuid;v_created boolean:=false;v_hash text;
  v_session_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal(p_caller,'opportunity_runner',v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable';END IF;
  IF (p_input).stock_id IS NULL OR (p_input).close<=0 OR (p_input).close>='Infinity'::double precision
    OR ((p_input).reported_pe IS NULL AND (p_input).reported_pb IS NULL)
    OR ((p_input).reported_pe IS NOT NULL AND ((p_input).reported_pe<=0 OR (p_input).reported_pe>200))
    OR ((p_input).reported_pb IS NOT NULL AND ((p_input).reported_pb<=0 OR (p_input).reported_pb>100))
    OR NOT ((p_input).published_at<=(p_input).source_timestamp
      AND (p_input).source_timestamp<=(p_input).collected_at AND (p_input).collected_at<=v_now)
    OR char_length((p_input).source_ref) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    OR ((p_input).exchange='TWSE' AND (p_input).source_ref
      !~ '^(twse-openapi:BWIBBU_ALL|twse-rwd:BWIBBU_d):[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{4}$')
    OR ((p_input).exchange='TPEX' AND (p_input).source_ref
      !~ '^(tpex-openapi:peratio|tpex-rwd:peratio):[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{4}$')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_exchange_reported_valuation';END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_session_count
  FROM public.resolve_legacy_trading_session_dependency_v3_16_9_internal((p_input).session_date,
    (p_input).exchange::text::public.tw_market_v3,(p_input).collected_at,v_now) session
  WHERE session.status='completed' AND session.close_at<=(p_input).collected_at;
  IF v_session_count<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='calendar_dependency_unavailable',
      CONSTRAINT='calendar_dependency_unavailable';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(jsonb_build_array('exchange_reported_valuation',
    (p_input).stock_id,(p_input).exchange,(p_input).session_date)::text,0));
  SELECT reported_pe_id INTO v_id FROM public.opportunity_exchange_reported_pe_v3 row
  WHERE row.stock_id=(p_input).stock_id AND row.exchange=(p_input).exchange
    AND row.session_date=(p_input).session_date AND row.close=(p_input).close
    AND row.reported_pe IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (p_input).reported_pe
    AND row.reported_pb IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (p_input).reported_pb
    AND row.published_at=(p_input).published_at AND row.source_timestamp=(p_input).source_timestamp
    AND row.collected_at=(p_input).collected_at AND row.source_ref=(p_input).source_ref
  ORDER BY row.recorded_at,row.reported_pe_id LIMIT 1;
  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_exchange_reported_pe_v3(stock_id,exchange,session_date,close,
      reported_pe,reported_pb,published_at,source_timestamp,collected_at,source_ref,recorded_at)
    VALUES((p_input).stock_id,(p_input).exchange,(p_input).session_date,(p_input).close,
      (p_input).reported_pe,(p_input).reported_pb,(p_input).published_at,(p_input).source_timestamp,
      (p_input).collected_at,(p_input).source_ref,v_now) RETURNING reported_pe_id INTO v_id;
    v_created:=true;
  END IF;
  v_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
    (p_input).stock_id,(p_input).exchange,(p_input).session_date,(p_input).close,(p_input).reported_pe,
    (p_input).reported_pb,(p_input).published_at,(p_input).source_timestamp,(p_input).collected_at,
    (p_input).source_ref)::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,
    input_hash,disposition,recorded_at)
  VALUES('append_price_authority_v3',p_caller,'exchange_reported_pe',v_id,v_hash,
    (CASE WHEN v_created THEN 'appended' ELSE 'idempotent' END)::public.opportunity_rpc_audit_disposition_v3,v_now);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_id,v_now;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_financial_fact_pre_history_v1(input financial_fact_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(fact_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();v_existing uuid;v_existing_recorded_at timestamptz;v_hash text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal(caller_principal,'opportunity_runner',v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable';END IF;
  IF (input).collected_at<(input).source_timestamp OR (input).collected_at>v_now
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';END IF;

  -- Use the predecessor's exact series lock.  This serializes the lookup with
  -- both another recollection and a genuine new revision; using a narrower
  -- recollection-only key would permit two first observers to miss each other.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws('|',
    (input).stock_id,(input).fact_key,coalesce((input).period_start::text,''),
    (input).period_end,(input).duration_kind),0));
  SELECT fact.fact_id,fact.recorded_at INTO v_existing,v_existing_recorded_at
  FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
  WHERE fact.stock_id=(input).stock_id AND fact.fact_key=(input).fact_key
    AND fact.period_start IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (input).period_start
    AND fact.period_end=(input).period_end AND fact.duration_kind=(input).duration_kind
    AND fact.value=(input).value AND fact.unit=(input).unit AND fact.provider=(input).provider
    AND fact.authority_tier=(input).authority_tier AND fact.estimate_kind=(input).estimate_kind
    AND fact.estimate_horizon=(input).estimate_horizon
    AND fact.filing_published_at=(input).filing_published_at
    AND fact.source_timestamp=(input).source_timestamp
    AND fact.filing_restatement_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (input).filing_restatement_id
    AND fact.source_ref=(input).source_ref AND fact.collected_at<=(input).collected_at
  ORDER BY fact.collected_at,fact.recorded_at,fact.fact_id LIMIT 1;
  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
      (input).stock_id,(input).fact_key,(input).period_start,(input).period_end,(input).duration_kind,
      (input).value,(input).unit,(input).provider,(input).authority_tier,(input).estimate_kind,
      (input).estimate_horizon,(input).filing_published_at,(input).source_timestamp,
      (input).collected_at,(input).filing_restatement_id,(input).source_ref
    )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,
      input_hash,disposition,recorded_at)
    VALUES('append_financial_fact_v3',caller_principal,'financial_fact',v_existing,v_hash,
      'idempotent'::public.opportunity_rpc_audit_disposition_v3,v_now);
    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing,v_existing_recorded_at;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT appended.fact_id,appended.recorded_at
  FROM public.append_financial_fact_pre_v3_16_16(input,caller_principal) appended;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_financial_fact_pre_v3_16_16(input financial_fact_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(fact_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
  v_id uuid:=extensions.gen_random_uuid();
  v_existing uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal($2,'opportunity_runner',v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable'; END IF;
  IF ($1).filing_published_at>($1).source_timestamp
    OR ($1).source_timestamp>($1).collected_at
    OR ($1).collected_at>v_now
    OR (($1).estimate_kind='reported' AND (
      ($1).period_end>(($1).filing_published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
      OR ($1).period_end>(($1).source_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date))
    OR char_length(btrim(($1).source_ref)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    OR ($1).source_ref<>btrim(($1).source_ref)
    OR (
      (($1).provider IN ('mops','twse','tpex')
        AND ($1).authority_tier<>'official_filing')
      OR (($1).provider='finmind' AND ($1).authority_tier<>'finmind_mirror')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'monthly_revenue','quarterly_revenue','quarterly_gross_profit',
        'quarterly_operating_expense','quarterly_operating_income','quarterly_non_operating_income',
        'quarterly_pretax_income','quarterly_income_tax_expense','quarterly_noncontrolling_interest',
        'quarterly_net_income','quarterly_net_income_attributable_to_common','quarterly_ebitda',
        'depreciation_amortization','net_debt','cash_and_equivalents','total_debt','total_equity',
        'total_assets','invested_capital','net_asset_value','operating_cash_flow','capital_expenditure','interest_expense'
      ) AND ($1).unit NOT IN ('TWD','TWD_thousand','TWD_million')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN ('diluted_shares','diluted_weighted_average_shares','shares_outstanding')
      AND ($1).unit NOT IN ('share','thousand_shares')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'quarterly_diluted_eps','book_value_per_share','broker_target_price'
      )
      AND ($1).unit<>'TWD_per_share'
    )
    OR (($1).fact_key='roe' AND ($1).unit<>'percentage_points')
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'pe_multiple','pb_multiple','ev_ebitda_multiple','ev_sales_multiple'
      ) AND ($1).unit<>'dimensionless'
    )
    OR (
      ($1).duration_kind='instant' AND ($1).period_start IS NOT NULL
    )
    OR (
      ($1).duration_kind<>'instant'
      AND (($1).period_start IS NULL OR ($1).period_start>($1).period_end)
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='reported'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'reported_period'
        OR ($1).fact_key='broker_target_price'
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='analyst_estimate'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'next_twelve_months'
        OR ($1).fact_key NOT IN (
          'quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda','quarterly_revenue',
          'book_value_per_share'
        )
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='broker_consensus'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'target_12m'
        OR ($1).fact_key<>'broker_target_price'
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind<>'reported'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
        WHERE verification.evidence_ref=($1).source_ref
          AND verification.recorded_at<=v_now
          AND verification.collected_at<=v_now
          AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws('|',
    ($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,coalesce(($1).period_start::text,''),
    ($1).period_end,($1).duration_kind
  ),0));
  SELECT fact.fact_id INTO v_existing
  FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
  WHERE fact.stock_id=($1).stock_id
    AND fact.fact_key=($1).fact_key
    AND fact.period_start IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).period_start
    AND fact.period_end=($1).period_end
    AND fact.duration_kind=($1).duration_kind
    AND fact.value=($1).value
    AND fact.unit=($1).unit
    AND fact.provider=($1).provider
    AND fact.authority_tier=($1).authority_tier
    AND fact.estimate_kind=($1).estimate_kind
    AND fact.estimate_horizon=($1).estimate_horizon
    AND fact.filing_published_at=($1).filing_published_at
    AND fact.source_timestamp=($1).source_timestamp
    AND fact.collected_at=($1).collected_at
    AND fact.filing_restatement_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).filing_restatement_id
    AND fact.source_ref=($1).source_ref
  ORDER BY fact.fact_id
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing,fact.recorded_at
    FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
    WHERE fact.fact_id=v_existing;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3(
    fact_id,stock_id,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,value,unit,provider,authority_tier,
    estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,filing_published_at,source_timestamp,collected_at,
    filing_restatement_id,source_ref,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(v_id,($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,($1).period_start,($1).period_end,($1).duration_kind,
    ($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).authority_tier,
    ($1).estimate_kind,($1).estimate_horizon,($1).filing_published_at,
    ($1).source_timestamp,($1).collected_at,($1).filing_restatement_id,($1).source_ref,v_now);
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(
    function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,input_hash,
    disposition,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    'append_financial_fact_v3',$2,'financial_fact',v_id,
    encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
      ($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,($1).period_start,($1).period_end,
      ($1).duration_kind,($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).authority_tier,
      ($1).estimate_kind,($1).estimate_horizon,
      ($1).filing_published_at,($1).source_timestamp,($1).collected_at,
      ($1).filing_restatement_id,($1).source_ref
    )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
    'appended',v_now
  );
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_id,v_now;
END
$function$

functions.name: append_financial_fact_v3(financial_fact_input_v3,uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_financial_fact_v3(input financial_fact_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(fact_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_fact uuid;v_recorded timestamptz;v_hash text;
BEGIN
  -- The predecessor performs principal, disclosure, period and recollection
  -- validation. Receipt and fact/audit are committed or rolled back together.
  SELECT appended.fact_id,appended.recorded_at INTO STRICT v_fact,v_recorded
  FROM public.append_financial_fact_pre_history_v1(input,caller_principal) appended;
  v_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
    (input).stock_id,(input).fact_key,(input).period_start,(input).period_end,(input).duration_kind,
    (input).value,(input).unit,(input).provider,(input).authority_tier,(input).estimate_kind,
    (input).estimate_horizon,(input).filing_published_at,(input).source_timestamp,
    (input).collected_at,(input).filing_restatement_id,(input).source_ref
  )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_financial_observations_v1(fact_id,input_hash,observation_kind,
    caller_principal_id,filing_published_at,source_timestamp,collected_at)
  VALUES(v_fact,v_hash,'rpc_observation',caller_principal,(input).filing_published_at,
    (input).source_timestamp,(input).collected_at)
  ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT financial_observation_identity_v1 DO NOTHING;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_fact,v_recorded;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_legacy_expired_producer_diagnostic_v3_20(p_run uuid, p_job uuid, p_stage text, p_job_kind text, p_input_hash text, p_producer_sha text, p_diagnostic_hash text, p_recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN

      'analysis_revision','compact_radar_projection','worker_terminal')

    OR p_diagnostic_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='authentication_rejected';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_runtime_failure_diagnostics_v3_14(
    run_id,job_id,stage,job_kind,failure_code,failure_origin,invariant_code,sqlstate,constraint_name,
    item_ordinal,field_path,input_hash,producer_sha,diagnostic_hash,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    p_run,p_job,p_stage,p_job_kind,'lease_expired','lease_reaper','lease_expired',NULL,NULL,NULL,
    'leaseExpiry',p_input_hash,p_producer_sha,p_diagnostic_hash,p_recorded_at

END $function$

functions.name: append_legacy_official_ingestion_chunk_v3_14(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,integer,jsonb,text,text,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_legacy_official_ingestion_chunk_v3_14(p_run_id uuid, p_job_id uuid, p_owner_token uuid, p_kind text, p_ordinal integer, p_items jsonb, p_chunk_hash text, p_producer_sha text, p_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_existing record;v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();v_expected_hash text;
BEGIN
  IF p_kind NOT IN('trading_sessions','financial_facts','price_observations',
      'corporate_action_snapshots','reported_valuations','terminal') OR p_ordinal<0
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_items)>200 OR p_chunk_hash!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR p_producer_sha!~'^[0-9a-f]{40}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='authentication_rejected';END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_producer_jobs_v3_11 job
    JOIN public.legacy_producer_runs_v3_11 run USING(run_id)
    WHERE job.job_id=p_job_id AND job.run_id=p_run_id AND job.stage='facts_refresh' AND job.status='leased'
      AND run.status='running' AND run.producer_commit_sha=p_producer_sha AND run.source_cutoff=p_source_cutoff
      AND job.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_owner_token::text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
      AND run.owner_token_hash=job.owner_token_hash AND job.lease_expires_at>=v_now AND run.lease_expires_at>=v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_lease_mismatch';END IF;
  IF p_kind<>'terminal' THEN
    v_expected_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(jsonb_build_array(
      'official-ingestion-chunk-v3.14',p_kind,p_ordinal,p_items)),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  ELSE
    v_expected_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(jsonb_build_array(
      'official-ingestion-terminal-v3.14',p_items#>>'{0,sourceCutoff}',p_items#>'{0,counts}',p_items#>'{0,chunks}')),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
    IF jsonb_array_length(p_items)<>1 OR p_items#>>'{0,terminalRoot}'<>p_chunk_hash
      OR (p_items#>>'{0,sourceCutoff}')::timestamptz<>p_source_cutoff
      OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_items->0) key)
        <>ARRAY['chunks','counts','sourceCutoff','terminalRoot']::text[]
      OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_items#>'{0,counts}') key)
        <>ARRAY['corporate_action_snapshots','financial_facts','price_observations','reported_valuations','trading_sessions']::text[]
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_items#>'{0,chunks}','[]'::jsonb)) member(value)
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)<>'object' OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(value) key)
          <>ARRAY['chunkHash','itemCount','kind','ordinal']::text[])
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_terminal_invalid';END IF;
  END IF;
  IF v_expected_hash<>p_chunk_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_chunk_hash';END IF;
  SELECT chunk_hash,item_count,items_json INTO v_existing FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14
    WHERE job_id=p_job_id AND chunk_kind=p_kind AND chunk_ordinal=p_ordinal;
  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.chunk_hash<>p_chunk_hash OR v_existing.item_count<>jsonb_array_length(p_items)
      OR v_existing.items_json<>p_items THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_chunk_conflict';
    END IF;
    RETURN true;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14(run_id,job_id,chunk_kind,chunk_ordinal,item_count,
    chunk_hash,producer_sha,source_cutoff,items_json,recorded_at) VALUES(p_run_id,p_job_id,p_kind,p_ordinal,
    jsonb_array_length(p_items),p_chunk_hash,p_producer_sha,p_source_cutoff,p_items,v_now);
  RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_legacy_runtime_failure_diagnostic_v3_14(p_run_id uuid, p_job_id uuid, p_owner_token uuid, p_stage text, p_job_kind text, p_failure_code text, p_failure_origin text, p_invariant_code text, p_sqlstate text, p_constraint_name text, p_item_ordinal integer, p_field_path text, p_input_hash text, p_producer_sha text, p_diagnostic_hash text, p_recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_producer_jobs_v3_11 job
    JOIN public.legacy_producer_runs_v3_11 run USING(run_id)
    WHERE job.job_id=p_job_id AND job.run_id=p_run_id AND job.status='leased' AND run.status='running'
      AND job.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_owner_token::text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
      AND run.owner_token_hash=job.owner_token_hash AND job.lease_expires_at>=clock_timestamp()
      AND run.lease_expires_at>=clock_timestamp() AND job.stage::text=p_stage AND job.job_kind::text=p_job_kind)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='authentication_rejected';END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_runtime_failure_diagnostics_v3_14(run_id,job_id,stage,job_kind,failure_code,
    failure_origin,invariant_code,sqlstate,constraint_name,item_ordinal,field_path,input_hash,producer_sha,diagnostic_hash,recorded_at)
  VALUES(p_run_id,p_job_id,p_stage,p_job_kind,p_failure_code,p_failure_origin,p_invariant_code,p_sqlstate,
    p_constraint_name,p_item_ordinal,p_field_path,p_input_hash,p_producer_sha,p_diagnostic_hash,p_recorded_at)
  ON CONFLICT(run_id,job_id,diagnostic_hash) DO NOTHING RETURNING diagnostic_id INTO v_id;
  IF v_id IS NULL THEN SELECT diagnostic_id INTO v_id FROM public.legacy_runtime_failure_diagnostics_v3_14
    WHERE run_id=p_run_id AND job_id=p_job_id AND diagnostic_hash=p_diagnostic_hash; END IF;
  RETURN v_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_legacy_runtime_health_rest_v3_15(p_producer_commit_sha text, p_worker_sha256 text, p_scheduler_config_sha256 text, p_observation_canonical bytea, p_observation_json jsonb, p_observation_sha256 text, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_producer_commit_sha!~'^[0-9a-f]{40}$' OR p_worker_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR p_scheduler_config_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR p_observation_sha256!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR octet_length(p_observation_canonical) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 65536
    OR convert_from(p_observation_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb<>p_observation_json
    OR encode(extensions.digest(p_observation_canonical,'sha256'),'hex')<>p_observation_sha256
    OR p_observation_json->>'producerCommitSha'<>p_producer_commit_sha
    OR p_observation_json->>'workerSha256'<>p_worker_sha256
    OR p_observation_json->>'schedulerConfigSha256'<>p_scheduler_config_sha256
    OR p_observed_at>clock_timestamp()+interval '1 minute'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='authentication_rejected';END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_runtime_health_observations_v3_11(producer_commit_sha,worker_sha256,
    scheduler_config_sha256,observation_canonical,observation_json,observation_sha256,observed_at)
  VALUES(p_producer_commit_sha,p_worker_sha256,p_scheduler_config_sha256,p_observation_canonical,
    p_observation_json,p_observation_sha256,p_observed_at)
  ON CONFLICT(producer_commit_sha,observation_sha256) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_market_observation_v3(input market_observation_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(observation_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
  v_id uuid:=extensions.gen_random_uuid();
  v_authority_date date;
  v_provider_session_date date;
  v_existing uuid;
  v_revision_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal($2,'opportunity_runner',v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable'; END IF;
  IF (($1).provider='global_allowlisted') IS DISTINCT FROM (($1).provider_identity IS NOT NULL)
    OR (($1).session_id IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (($1).session_authority_id IS NULL)
    OR ($1).scope_key='TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'
    OR (
      (($1).scope_key IN ('TAIEX','OTC','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON'))
      IS DISTINCT FROM (($1).session_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN ('taiex_close','otc_close')
      AND ($1).value<=0
    )
    OR ($1).observed_at>($1).collected_at
    OR ($1).collected_at>v_now
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES
        ('taiex_close'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'TAIEX'::public.market_scope_key_v3,
          'index_points'::public.market_unit_v3,'twse'::public.market_provider_v3,NULL::text),
        ('taiex_close','TAIEX','index_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('taiex_close','TAIEX','index_points','node_twstock',NULL),
        ('otc_close','OTC','index_points','tpex',NULL),
        ('otc_close','OTC','index_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('otc_close','OTC','index_points','node_twstock',NULL),
        ('above_ma20','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','twse',NULL),
        ('above_ma20','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('above_ma20','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','tpex',NULL),
        ('above_ma20','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('above_ma60','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','twse',NULL),
        ('above_ma60','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('above_ma60','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','tpex',NULL),
        ('above_ma60','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','percentage_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('foreign_cash_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','twse',NULL),
        ('foreign_cash_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('foreign_cash_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','tpex',NULL),
        ('foreign_cash_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('trust_cash_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','twse',NULL),
        ('trust_cash_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('trust_cash_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','tpex',NULL),
        ('trust_cash_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('margin_change_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','twse',NULL),
        ('margin_change_5d','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('margin_change_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','tpex',NULL),
        ('margin_change_5d','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON','TWD','finmind',NULL),
        ('foreign_futures_oi','TAIFEX','contracts','taifex',NULL),
        ('foreign_futures_oi','TAIFEX','contracts','finmind',NULL),
        ('put_call_ratio','TAIFEX','ratio','taifex',NULL),
        ('put_call_ratio','TAIFEX','ratio','finmind',NULL),
        ('taiwan_vix','TAIFEX','index_points','taifex',NULL),
        ('taiwan_vix','TAIFEX','index_points','finmind',NULL),
        ('sox_return_5d','SOX','percentage_points','global_allowlisted','stooq:sox:daily:v1'),
        ('nasdaq_return_5d','NASDAQ','percentage_points','global_allowlisted','stooq:nasdaq:daily:v1'),
        ('usd_twd_return_5d','USD_TWD','percentage_points','global_allowlisted','stooq:usd-twd:daily:v1')
      ) allowed(fact_key,scope_key,unit,provider,provider_identity)
      WHERE allowed.fact_key=($1).fact_key
        AND allowed.scope_key=($1).scope_key
        AND allowed.unit=($1).unit
        AND allowed.provider=($1).provider
        AND allowed.provider_identity IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).provider_identity
    )
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request'; END IF;
  IF ($1).provider='global_allowlisted' THEN
    v_provider_session_date:=CASE ($1).fact_key
      WHEN 'usd_twd_return_5d' THEN (($1).observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
      ELSE (($1).observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
    END;
    v_authority_date:=v_provider_session_date;
    IF ($1).session_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';
    END IF;
  ELSIF ($1).session_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_authority_date:=($1).session_id;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
      WHERE session.session_authority_id=($1).session_authority_id
        AND session.session_id=($1).session_id
        AND session.market=CASE
          WHEN ($1).scope_key IN ('TAIEX','TWSE_ACTIVE_COMMON')
            THEN 'TWSE'::public.tw_market_v3
          WHEN ($1).scope_key IN ('OTC','TPEX_ACTIVE_COMMON')
            THEN 'TPEX'::public.tw_market_v3
        END
        AND session.status='completed'
        AND session.recorded_at<=v_now
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 newer
          WHERE newer.market=session.market
            AND newer.session_id=session.session_id
            AND newer.recorded_at<=v_now
            AND newer.recorded_at>=session.recorded_at
            AND newer.session_authority_id<>session.session_authority_id
        )
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 counterpart
          WHERE counterpart.session_id=session.session_id
            AND counterpart.market<>session.market
            AND counterpart.open_at=session.open_at
            AND counterpart.close_at=session.close_at
            AND counterpart.status='completed'
            AND counterpart.recorded_at<=v_now
            AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 newer_counterpart
              WHERE newer_counterpart.market=counterpart.market
                AND newer_counterpart.session_id=counterpart.session_id
                AND newer_counterpart.recorded_at<=v_now
                AND newer_counterpart.recorded_at>=counterpart.recorded_at
                AND newer_counterpart.session_authority_id<>counterpart.session_authority_id
            )
        )
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='calendar_authority_mismatch'; END IF;
    IF ($1).fact_key IN ('taiex_close','otc_close') AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
      WHERE session.session_authority_id=($1).session_authority_id
        AND session.close_at=($1).observed_at
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='calendar_authority_mismatch'; END IF;
  ELSE
    v_authority_date:=(($1).observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date;
  END IF;
  IF ($1).fact_key IN ('above_ma20','above_ma60') THEN
    IF ($1).breadth_numerator_count IS NULL
      OR ($1).breadth_observed_count IS NULL
      OR ($1).breadth_observed_count<=0
      OR ($1).breadth_eligible_count IS NULL
      OR ($1).breadth_roster_manifest_id IS NULL
      OR ($1).breadth_roster_manifest_hash IS NULL
      OR ($1).value<>round(
        100.0*($1).breadth_numerator_count/($1).breadth_observed_count,2
      )::double precision
      OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
        WHERE manifest.manifest_id=($1).breadth_roster_manifest_id
          AND manifest.manifest_kind='instrument_roster'
          AND manifest.contract_version='tw-instrument-roster-v3.0'
          AND manifest.status='complete'
          AND manifest.manifest_hash=($1).breadth_roster_manifest_hash
      )
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
  ELSIF num_nonnulls(
    ($1).breadth_numerator_count,($1).breadth_observed_count,($1).breadth_eligible_count,
    ($1).breadth_roster_manifest_id,($1).breadth_roster_manifest_hash
  )<>0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws('|',
    ($1).fact_key,($1).scope_key,v_authority_date,($1).provider,
    coalesce(($1).provider_identity,'')),0));
  SELECT observation.observation_id INTO v_existing
  FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.fact_key=($1).fact_key
    AND observation.scope_key=($1).scope_key
    AND observation.authority_date=v_authority_date
    AND observation.provider=($1).provider
    AND observation.provider_identity IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).provider_identity
    AND observation.session_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).session_id
    AND observation.session_authority_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).session_authority_id
    AND observation.value=($1).value
    AND observation.unit=($1).unit
    AND observation.breadth_numerator_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).breadth_numerator_count
    AND observation.breadth_observed_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).breadth_observed_count
    AND observation.breadth_eligible_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).breadth_eligible_count
    AND observation.breadth_roster_manifest_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).breadth_roster_manifest_id
    AND observation.breadth_roster_manifest_hash IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).breadth_roster_manifest_hash
    AND observation.observed_at=($1).observed_at
    AND observation.collected_at=($1).collected_at
    AND observation.source_ref=($1).source_ref
    AND observation.provider_revision=($1).provider_revision
  ORDER BY observation.observation_id LIMIT 1;
  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing,(SELECT observation.recorded_at
      FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
      WHERE observation.observation_id=v_existing);
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_revision_count
  FROM (
    SELECT observation.observation_id
    FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
    WHERE observation.fact_key=($1).fact_key
      AND observation.scope_key=($1).scope_key
      AND observation.authority_date=v_authority_date
      AND observation.provider=($1).provider
      AND observation.provider_identity IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).provider_identity
    ORDER BY observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.observation_id
    LIMIT 65
  ) bounded_revisions;
  IF v_revision_count>=64 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_market_observations_v3(
    observation_id,fact_key,scope_key,session_id,session_authority_id,value,unit,provider,provider_identity,
    authority_date,provider_session_date,
    breadth_numerator_count,breadth_observed_count,breadth_eligible_count,breadth_roster_manifest_id,
    breadth_roster_manifest_hash,observed_at,collected_at,source_ref,provider_revision,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(v_id,($1).fact_key,($1).scope_key,($1).session_id,($1).session_authority_id,($1).value,
    ($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).provider_identity,v_authority_date,v_provider_session_date,
    ($1).breadth_numerator_count,($1).breadth_observed_count,
    ($1).breadth_eligible_count,($1).breadth_roster_manifest_id,($1).breadth_roster_manifest_hash,
    ($1).observed_at,($1).collected_at,($1).source_ref,($1).provider_revision,v_now);
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(
    function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,input_hash,disposition,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    'append_market_observation_v3',$2,'market_observation',v_id,
    encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(
      ($1).fact_key,($1).scope_key,v_authority_date,($1).provider,($1).provider_identity,
      ($1).provider_revision
    )::text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex'),'appended',v_now
  );
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_id,v_now;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_stock_flow_observation_v3(input stock_flow_observation_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(observation_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
  v_id uuid:=extensions.gen_random_uuid();
  v_existing uuid;
  v_revision_count integer;
  v_expected_owner text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal($2,'opportunity_runner',v_now) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable';
  END IF;
  v_expected_owner:=lower(($1).exchange::text);
  IF ($1).provider::text NOT IN (v_expected_owner,'finmind')
    OR ($1).source_timestamp>($1).collected_at
    OR ($1).collected_at>v_now
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key='sbl_short_balance_shares' AND ($1).unit<>'shares'
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'foreign_net_twd','trust_net_twd','margin_financing_balance_twd'
      ) AND ($1).unit<>'TWD'
    )
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
      WHERE session.session_authority_id=($1).session_authority_id
        AND session.session_id=($1).session_id
        AND session.market::text=($1).exchange::text
        AND session.status='completed'
        AND session.provider::text=v_expected_owner
        AND session.recorded_at<=v_now
    )
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.stock_instruments_v3 instrument
      WHERE instrument.stock_id=($1).stock_id
        AND instrument.exchange=($1).exchange
        AND instrument.instrument_type='common_stock'
        AND instrument.listing_status='active'
        AND instrument.source_timestamp<=($1).source_timestamp
        AND instrument.recorded_at<=v_now
        AND instrument.valid_from<=($1).source_timestamp
        AND (
          instrument.valid_to IS NULL
          OR ($1).source_timestamp<instrument.valid_to
        )
      ORDER BY instrument.recorded_at DESC,instrument.instrument_authority_id
      LIMIT 1
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
    concat_ws('|',($1).stock_id,($1).exchange,($1).session_id,
      ($1).session_authority_id,($1).fact_key,($1).provider),0
  ));
  SELECT observation.observation_id INTO v_existing
  FROM public.opportunity_stock_flow_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.stock_id=($1).stock_id
    AND observation.exchange=($1).exchange
    AND observation.session_id=($1).session_id
    AND observation.session_authority_id=($1).session_authority_id
    AND observation.fact_key=($1).fact_key
    AND observation.value=($1).value
    AND observation.unit=($1).unit
    AND observation.provider=($1).provider
    AND observation.source_timestamp=($1).source_timestamp
    AND observation.collected_at=($1).collected_at
    AND observation.source_ref=($1).source_ref
    AND observation.provider_revision=($1).provider_revision
  ORDER BY observation.observation_id
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT observation.observation_id,observation.recorded_at
    FROM public.opportunity_stock_flow_observations_v3 observation
    WHERE observation.observation_id=v_existing;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_revision_count
  FROM (
    SELECT observation.observation_id
    FROM public.opportunity_stock_flow_observations_v3 observation
    WHERE observation.stock_id=($1).stock_id
      AND observation.exchange=($1).exchange
      AND observation.session_id=($1).session_id
      AND observation.session_authority_id=($1).session_authority_id
      AND observation.fact_key=($1).fact_key
      AND observation.provider=($1).provider
    ORDER BY observation.source_timestamp DESC,observation.collected_at DESC,
      observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.source_ref,observation.observation_id
    LIMIT 65
  ) bounded_revisions;
  IF v_revision_count>=64 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_stock_flow_observations_v3(
    observation_id,stock_id,exchange,session_id,session_authority_id,fact_key,
    value,unit,provider,source_timestamp,collected_at,source_ref,
    provider_revision,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    v_id,($1).stock_id,($1).exchange,($1).session_id,($1).session_authority_id,
    ($1).fact_key,($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).source_timestamp,
    ($1).collected_at,($1).source_ref,($1).provider_revision,v_now
  );
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(
    function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,input_hash,
    disposition,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    'append_stock_flow_observation_v3',$2,'stock_flow_observation',v_id,
    encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
      ($1).stock_id,($1).exchange,($1).session_id,($1).session_authority_id,
      ($1).fact_key,($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,
      ($1).source_timestamp,($1).collected_at,($1).source_ref,
      ($1).provider_revision
    )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
    'appended',v_now
  );
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_id,v_now;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_legacy_official_ingestion_chunk_v3_14(p_run_id uuid, p_job_id uuid, p_owner_token uuid, p_kind text, p_ordinal integer, p_items jsonb, p_chunk_hash text, p_producer_sha text, p_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_staged public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14;
BEGIN
  SELECT chunk.* INTO v_staged FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
  WHERE chunk.run_id=p_run_id AND chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind=p_kind
    AND chunk.chunk_ordinal=p_ordinal FOR SHARE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_staged.chunk_hash<>p_chunk_hash OR v_staged.producer_sha<>p_producer_sha
    OR v_staged.source_cutoff<>p_source_cutoff OR v_staged.items_json<>p_items
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_staged_chunk_mismatch';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_applications_v3_15 applied
    WHERE applied.job_id=p_job_id AND applied.chunk_kind=p_kind AND applied.chunk_ordinal=p_ordinal
      AND applied.run_id=p_run_id AND applied.chunk_hash=p_chunk_hash AND applied.producer_sha=p_producer_sha
      AND applied.source_cutoff=p_source_cutoff AND applied.item_count=jsonb_array_length(p_items))
  THEN RETURN true;END IF;
  PERFORM public.apply_legacy_official_ingestion_chunk_base_v3_15(p_run_id,p_job_id,p_owner_token,p_kind,
    p_ordinal,p_items,p_chunk_hash,p_producer_sha,p_source_cutoff);
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_official_ingestion_applications_v3_15(run_id,job_id,chunk_kind,chunk_ordinal,
    chunk_hash,producer_sha,source_cutoff,item_count)
  VALUES(p_run_id,p_job_id,p_kind,p_ordinal,p_chunk_hash,p_producer_sha,p_source_cutoff,jsonb_array_length(p_items))
  ON CONFLICT(job_id,chunk_kind,chunk_ordinal) DO NOTHING;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_applications_v3_15 applied
    WHERE applied.job_id=p_job_id AND applied.chunk_kind=p_kind AND applied.chunk_ordinal=p_ordinal
      AND applied.run_id=p_run_id AND applied.chunk_hash=p_chunk_hash AND applied.producer_sha=p_producer_sha
      AND applied.source_cutoff=p_source_cutoff AND applied.item_count=jsonb_array_length(p_items))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_application_conflict';END IF;
  RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.begin_opportunity_run_v3(mode opportunity_mode_v3, run_purpose opportunity_run_purpose_v3, source_cutoff timestamp with time zone, expected_taiwan_session_authority_hash text, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(disposition opportunity_begin_disposition_v3, run_id uuid, attempt_run_id uuid, attempt integer, status opportunity_run_status_v3)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_preparation text;
  v_comparison text;
  v_cutoff_text text;
  v_evaluation_lock text;
  v_input_run_ids jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_static_identity_members jsonb := $identity$[
    ["acceptanceVersion","1.46.0"],
    ["analysisRevisionContractVersion","stock-analysis-revision-v3.11.2"],
    ["authoritySupersessionContractVersion","authority-supersession-v3.2"],
    ["controlPlaneContractVersion","opportunity-control-v3.3"],
    ["dataContractVersion","source-led-opportunity-v3.6"],
    ["decisionContractVersion","opportunity-decisions-v3.3"],
    ["detailContractVersion","opportunity-detail-v3.3"],
    ["discoveryCorrectnessContractVersion","stock-discovery-v3.11.1"],
    ["entityLinkContractVersion","entity-link-v3.1"],
    ["evaluationContractVersion","source-led-eval-v3.7"],
    ["factorCorrectnessContractVersion","opportunity-factor-correctness-v3.11.6"],
    ["featureScoringContractVersion","opportunity-features-v3.2"],
    ["financialInputContractVersion","opportunity-financial-inputs-v3.3"],
    ["hybridProductVersion","hybrid-product-v3.2"],
    ["instrumentRosterContractVersion","tw-instrument-roster-v3.0"],
    ["internalPrincipalContractVersion","internal-principal-v3.8"],
    ["jobGraphContractVersion","opportunity-job-graph-v3.15"],
    ["legacyCompatibilityContractVersion","legacy-compatibility-v3.2"],
    ["manifestStorageContractVersion","opportunity-manifest-storage-v3.10"],
    ["marketContextContractVersion","market-context-v3.6"],
    ["moverAuditPriceContractVersion","mover-audit-price-v3.3"],
    ["portfolioContextContractVersion","research-basket-v3.0"],
    ["postgresTypeContractVersion","opportunity-postgres-types-v3.22"],
    ["priceProviderAllowlistHash","48fa54ee9f0e3a0b888ac0dc17eda8ad5bb746106a6fe4395eb50a5865e4e44e"],
    ["providerFieldAllowlistHash","fe78e0f8c5b0846f822f72c6b2356cac35ed5c00dd0bcd06f9a75b7c5b21d3f7"],
    ["publisherVerificationPolicyHash","2c4746cb02d98d402ecd1d0d980c91632b8105ab9fd2aec198e7789da603abba"],
    ["runtimeContractVersion","opportunity-runtime-v3.17"],
    ["sectorBenchmarkContractVersion","sector-benchmark-v3.1"],
    ["sectorCycleContractVersion","sector-cycle-v3.0"],
    ["sectorReferenceContractVersion","sector-reference-v3.1"],
    ["sectorTaxonomyContractVersion","tw-sector-taxonomy-v3.0"],
    ["sourceAdapterContractVersion","source-adapter-v3.3"],
    ["sourceAdapterRegistryHash","a14d4753f221a43fb0422710e705ee00f529d9f31653a142211fe94596da80fe"],
    ["sourceDatasetContractVersion","source-dataset-v3.3"],
    ["sourceFunnelContractVersion","source-funnel-v3.0"],
    ["sourceFunnelPolicyHash","6893fb5f265edc10eea8222a560f9afdcc4342f72b1d7d39d5723ec0056bc105"],
    ["storageContractVersion","opportunity-storage-v3.25"],
    ["taxonomyMapHash","6b28d85903d7a410eef29386de011c71aa789dc0ce3231df38cb4e085181060c"],
    ["technicalDecisionContractVersion","opportunity-technical-decision-v3.11.1"],
    ["tradingCalendarContractVersion","tw-trading-calendar-v3.4"],
    ["valuationContractVersion","opportunity-valuation-v3.4"]
  ]$identity$::jsonb;
  v_upstream_run_id uuid;
  v_label_input_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
  v_evaluation_enrich_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
  v_evaluation_outcome_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
  v_calendar_resolution jsonb;
  v_input_count integer;
  v_raw_score_count integer := 0;
  v_terminal_outcome_count integer := 0;
  v_attempt integer := 1;
  v_existing public.opportunity_runs%ROWTYPE;
  v_run uuid := extensions.gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal(caller_principal,'opportunity_runner',v_now) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable';
  END IF;
  IF source_cutoff<>date_trunc('second',source_cutoff)
    OR NOT (
      (mode IN ('source_scan','enrich_rank')
        AND run_purpose IN ('ad_hoc_shadow','production_shadow_daily','backtest_daily_primary'))
      OR (mode='label_outcomes' AND run_purpose='outcome_label_daily')
      OR (mode='shadow_evaluate' AND run_purpose='shadow_evaluation_daily')
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  IF source_cutoff > v_now THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'PT422', MESSAGE = 'future_source_cutoff';
  END IF;
  IF expected_taiwan_session_authority_hash IS NOT NULL THEN
    WITH bounded AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT market.market,session.*
      FROM (VALUES
        ('TWSE'::public.tw_market_v3),('TPEX'::public.tw_market_v3)
      ) market(market)
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.session_authority_id,retained.open_at,retained.close_at,
          retained.status,retained.source_timestamp,retained.collected_at,
          retained.source_ref,retained.recorded_at
        FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.session_id=(source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
          AND retained.market=market.market
          AND retained.source_timestamp<=source_cutoff
          AND retained.collected_at<=source_cutoff
          AND retained.recorded_at<=source_cutoff
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.session_authority_id
        LIMIT 1025
      ) session
    ), stream_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT bounded.market,count(*) AS retained_count,
        max(bounded.recorded_at) AS greatest_recorded_at
      FROM bounded GROUP BY bounded.market
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT bounded.*
      FROM bounded JOIN stream_stats USING(market)
      WHERE bounded.recorded_at=stream_stats.greatest_recorded_at
    ), resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.market,max(stream_stats.retained_count) AS retained_count,
        count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
          greatest.open_at,greatest.close_at,greatest.status,
          CASE greatest.market WHEN 'TWSE' THEN 'twse' ELSE 'tpex' END,
          greatest.source_timestamp,greatest.collected_at,greatest.source_ref
        )) AS semantic_count,
        (array_agg(greatest.session_authority_id
          ORDER BY greatest.session_authority_id))[1] AS session_authority_id,
        min(greatest.open_at) AS open_at,min(greatest.close_at) AS close_at,
        min(greatest.status::text) AS status,
        min(greatest.source_timestamp) AS source_timestamp,
        min(greatest.collected_at) AS collected_at,
        min(greatest.source_ref) AS source_ref,
        min(greatest.recorded_at) AS recorded_at
      FROM greatest JOIN stream_stats USING(market)
      GROUP BY greatest.market
    )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'overflow',coalesce(bool_or(resolved.retained_count>1024),false),
      'conflict',coalesce(bool_or(resolved.semantic_count<>1),false),
      'memberCount',count(*),
      'completedCount',count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved.status='completed'),
      'scheduleCount',count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        resolved.open_at,resolved.close_at
      )),
      'canonicalCutoffMatches',
        source_cutoff=(
          ((source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date)::timestamp
            + time '16:00:00'
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei',
      'hash',CASE WHEN count(*)=2
          AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved.status='completed')=2
          AND count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
            resolved.open_at,resolved.close_at
          ))=1
        THEN encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
          'tw-trading-session-v3.0',
          jsonb_build_array(
            (source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date,
            min(resolved.open_at),min(resolved.close_at),
            jsonb_build_array(
              (array_agg(
                resolved.session_authority_id ORDER BY resolved.session_authority_id
              ) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TWSE'))[1],
              min(resolved.source_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TWSE'),
              min(resolved.collected_at) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TWSE'),
              min(resolved.source_ref) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TWSE'),
              min(resolved.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TWSE')
            ),
            jsonb_build_array(
              (array_agg(
                resolved.session_authority_id ORDER BY resolved.session_authority_id
              ) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TPEX'))[1],
              min(resolved.source_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TPEX'),
              min(resolved.collected_at) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TPEX'),
              min(resolved.source_ref) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TPEX'),
              min(resolved.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE resolved.market='TPEX')
            )
          )
        )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
        ELSE NULL END
    ) INTO v_calendar_resolution
    FROM resolved;
    IF coalesce((v_calendar_resolution->>'overflow')::boolean,false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
    ELSIF coalesce((v_calendar_resolution->>'conflict')::boolean,false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='authority_revision_conflict';
    ELSIF NOT coalesce((v_calendar_resolution->>'canonicalCutoffMatches')::boolean,false)
      OR v_calendar_resolution->>'hash' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_taiwan_session_authority_hash
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='calendar_authority_mismatch';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  v_cutoff_text := to_char(source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"');
  v_evaluation_lock := CASE WHEN run_purpose='ad_hoc_shadow' THEN NULL
    ELSE encode(extensions.digest(convert_to('source-led-eval-v3.7','utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') END;
  v_comparison := encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
    jsonb_build_array(
      'opportunity-comparison-contract-v3.0',
      jsonb_build_array('staticIdentityMembers',v_static_identity_members)
    )::text, ', ', ',', 'g'
  ),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  IF v_comparison<>'c81d16af92ec44fc2386165cd70f9665662e2052c680f831c78cf7d324020729'
    OR jsonb_array_length(v_static_identity_members)<>41
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
    'opportunity-begin-lineage-v3.0',mode::text,run_purpose::text,v_cutoff_text
  )::text, ', ', ',', 'g'),0));
  IF mode='enrich_rank' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_input_count
    FROM public.opportunity_runs r
    WHERE r.mode='source_scan' AND r.run_purpose=$2
      AND r.source_cutoff=$3 AND r.status='success'
      AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
      AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_evaluation_lock;
    IF v_input_count=0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='missing_source_run';
    ELSIF v_input_count>1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='multiple_source_runs';
    END IF;
    SELECT r.run_id INTO STRICT v_upstream_run_id
    FROM public.opportunity_runs r
    WHERE r.mode='source_scan' AND r.run_purpose=$2
      AND r.source_cutoff=$3 AND r.status='success'
      AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
      AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_evaluation_lock;
    v_input_run_ids:=jsonb_build_array(v_upstream_run_id::text);
  ELSIF mode='label_outcomes' THEN
    WITH recent_sessions AS (
      SELECT session_id
      FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3
      WHERE canonical_cutoff<=$3
      ORDER BY session_id DESC
      LIMIT 252
    ), raw_scores AS (
      SELECT r.run_id,r.trading_date,s.score_snapshot_id,s.horizon
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r
      JOIN recent_sessions session ON session.session_id=r.trading_date
      JOIN public.opportunity_score_snapshots s ON s.run_id=r.run_id
      WHERE r.mode='enrich_rank'
        AND r.run_purpose IN ('production_shadow_daily','backtest_daily_primary')
        AND r.status='success'
        AND r.terminal_at<=$3
        AND r.source_cutoff<=$3
        AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
        AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash=v_evaluation_lock
      ORDER BY r.trading_date,r.run_purpose,r.run_id,s.score_snapshot_id,s.horizon
      LIMIT 30241
    )
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_raw_score_count FROM raw_scores;
    IF v_raw_score_count>30240 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
    END IF;
    WITH recent_sessions AS (
      SELECT session_id
      FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3
      WHERE canonical_cutoff<=$3
      ORDER BY session_id DESC
      LIMIT 252
    ), raw_scores AS (
      SELECT r.run_id,r.trading_date,s.score_snapshot_id,s.horizon
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r
      JOIN recent_sessions session ON session.session_id=r.trading_date
      JOIN public.opportunity_score_snapshots s ON s.run_id=r.run_id
      WHERE r.mode='enrich_rank'
        AND r.run_purpose IN ('production_shadow_daily','backtest_daily_primary')
        AND r.status='success'
        AND r.terminal_at<=$3
        AND r.source_cutoff<=$3
        AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
        AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash=v_evaluation_lock
      ORDER BY r.trading_date,r.run_purpose,r.run_id,s.score_snapshot_id,s.horizon
      LIMIT 30241
    ), terminal_rows AS (
      SELECT raw.run_id,raw.score_snapshot_id,maturity.maturity_horizon
      FROM raw_scores raw
      CROSS JOIN (VALUES
        ('session_20'::public.opportunity_outcome_maturity_v3,20),
        ('session_60'::public.opportunity_outcome_maturity_v3,60),
        ('session_120'::public.opportunity_outcome_maturity_v3,120),
        ('session_250'::public.opportunity_outcome_maturity_v3,250)
      ) maturity(maturity_horizon,session_count)
      WHERE maturity.session_count<=(
        SELECT count(*) FROM recent_sessions session
        WHERE session.session_id>raw.trading_date
      )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_outcomes outcome
          WHERE outcome.score_snapshot_id=raw.score_snapshot_id
            AND outcome.maturity_horizon=maturity.maturity_horizon
        )
      ORDER BY raw.run_id,raw.score_snapshot_id,maturity.session_count
      LIMIT 20001
    )
    SELECT count(*),coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT terminal_rows.run_id ORDER BY terminal_rows.run_id),'{}'::uuid[])
      INTO v_terminal_outcome_count,v_label_input_ids
    FROM terminal_rows;
    IF v_terminal_outcome_count>20000 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(input_id::text ORDER BY input_id),'[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_input_run_ids
    FROM unnest(v_label_input_ids) input_id;
  ELSIF mode='shadow_evaluate' THEN
    IF (
      SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3
      WHERE canonical_cutoff<=$3
    ) < 252 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='provider_unavailable';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
      WITH recent_sessions AS (
        SELECT session_id
        FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3
        WHERE canonical_cutoff<=$3
        ORDER BY session_id DESC
        LIMIT 252
      )
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r
      JOIN recent_sessions session ON session.session_id=r.trading_date
      WHERE r.mode='enrich_rank'
        AND r.run_purpose IN ('production_shadow_daily','backtest_daily_primary')
        AND r.status='success'
        AND r.terminal_at<=$3
        AND r.source_cutoff<=$3
        AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
        AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash=v_evaluation_lock
      GROUP BY r.run_purpose,r.trading_date
      HAVING count(*)>1
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(candidate.run_id ORDER BY candidate.run_id),'{}'::uuid[])
      INTO v_evaluation_enrich_ids
    FROM (
      WITH recent_sessions AS (
        SELECT session_id
        FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3
        WHERE canonical_cutoff<=$3
        ORDER BY session_id DESC
        LIMIT 252
      )
      SELECT r.run_id
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r
      JOIN recent_sessions session ON session.session_id=r.trading_date
      WHERE r.mode='enrich_rank'
        AND r.run_purpose IN ('production_shadow_daily','backtest_daily_primary')
        AND r.status='success'
        AND r.terminal_at<=$3
        AND r.source_cutoff<=$3
        AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
        AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash=v_evaluation_lock
      ORDER BY r.trading_date DESC,r.run_purpose,r.run_id
      LIMIT 505
    ) candidate;
    IF cardinality(v_evaluation_enrich_ids)>504 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(candidate.run_id ORDER BY candidate.run_id),'{}'::uuid[])
      INTO v_evaluation_outcome_ids
    FROM (
      SELECT r.run_id
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r
      WHERE r.mode='label_outcomes'
        AND r.run_purpose='outcome_label_daily'
        AND r.status='success'
        AND r.terminal_at<=$3
        AND r.source_cutoff<=$3
        AND r.comparison_contract_key=v_comparison
        AND r.evaluation_dataset_lock_hash=v_evaluation_lock
      ORDER BY r.source_cutoff DESC,r.run_id
      LIMIT 253
    ) candidate;
    IF cardinality(v_evaluation_outcome_ids)>252 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(input_id::text ORDER BY input_id),'[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_input_run_ids
    FROM unnest(array_cat(v_evaluation_enrich_ids,v_evaluation_outcome_ids)) input_id;
  END IF;
  v_preparation := encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
    'opportunity-preparation-v3.0',
    jsonb_build_array('mode',mode::text),
    jsonb_build_array('runPurpose',run_purpose::text),
    jsonb_build_array('sourceCutoff',v_cutoff_text),
    jsonb_build_array('inputRunIds',v_input_run_ids),
    jsonb_build_array('comparisonContractKey',v_comparison),
    jsonb_build_array('evaluationDatasetLockHash',v_evaluation_lock),
    jsonb_build_array('staticIdentityMembers',v_static_identity_members)
  )::text, ', ', ',', 'g'), 'utf8'), 'sha256'), 'hex');
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_preparation,0));
  SELECT r.* INTO v_existing FROM public.opportunity_runs r
    WHERE r.preparation_key = v_preparation AND r.status IN ('preparing','running','success')
    ORDER BY r.created_at, r.run_id LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT
      CASE WHEN v_existing.status = 'success' THEN 'existing_success'::public.opportunity_begin_disposition_v3 ELSE 'existing_active'::public.opportunity_begin_disposition_v3 END,
      v_existing.run_id, v_existing.run_id, v_existing.attempt, v_existing.status;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(max(r.attempt),0)+1 INTO v_attempt
  FROM public.opportunity_runs r
  WHERE r.preparation_key=v_preparation;
  IF v_attempt NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_runs (
    run_id, preparation_key, attempt, mode, run_purpose, source_cutoff,
    comparison_contract_key, evaluation_dataset_lock_hash, upstream_run_id, status
  ) VALUES (
    v_run, v_preparation, v_attempt, mode, run_purpose, source_cutoff,
    v_comparison,v_evaluation_lock,v_upstream_run_id,
    'preparing'
  );
  IF v_upstream_run_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_inputs(run_id,input_run_id,input_role)
    VALUES(v_run,v_upstream_run_id,'upstream_source_scan');
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs(run_id,manifest_id,input_role,ordinal)
    SELECT v_run,m.manifest_id,m.input_role,m.ordinal
    FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs m
    JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest ON manifest.manifest_id=m.manifest_id
    WHERE m.run_id=v_upstream_run_id
      AND m.input_role IN (
        'source_identity_allowlist','publisher_verification_allowlist','instrument_roster',
        'alias_authority','taxonomy_assignment','source_dataset'
      )
      AND m.ordinal=0 AND manifest.status='complete';
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs m
        WHERE m.run_id=v_run AND m.input_role IN (
          'source_identity_allowlist','publisher_verification_allowlist','instrument_roster',
          'alias_authority','taxonomy_assignment','source_dataset'
        ))<>6
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF mode='label_outcomes' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_inputs(run_id,input_run_id,input_role)
    SELECT v_run,input_id,'outcome_enrich'::public.opportunity_run_input_role_v3
    FROM unnest(v_label_input_ids) input_id
    ORDER BY input_id;
  ELSIF mode='shadow_evaluate' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_inputs(run_id,input_run_id,input_role)
    SELECT v_run,input_id,'evaluation_enrich'::public.opportunity_run_input_role_v3
    FROM unnest(v_evaluation_enrich_ids) input_id
    ORDER BY input_id;
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_inputs(run_id,input_run_id,input_role)
    SELECT v_run,input_id,'evaluation_outcome'::public.opportunity_run_input_role_v3
    FROM unnest(v_evaluation_outcome_ids) input_id
    ORDER BY input_id;
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.enqueue_next_opportunity_job_v3_internal(v_run,NULL);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT 'created'::public.opportunity_begin_disposition_v3, v_run, v_run, v_attempt, 'preparing'::public.opportunity_run_status_v3;
END
$function$

functions.name: can_read_report(uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_report(rid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.reports r
    where r.id = rid and (
      r.visibility = 'public'
      or (r.visibility in ('members','subscribers') and auth.role() = 'authenticated')
    )
  )
$function$

functions.name: can_read_subscriber_report(uuid)
