      ORDER BY value->>'decisionRevisionId'),'[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_home_revisions FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_home_payload->'sourceSignals') card(value);
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((value#>'{bundle,json}')-'researchDossier' ORDER BY value->>'decisionRevisionId'),'[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_submitted_revisions
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_json->'decisionRevisions','[]'::jsonb)) revision(value);
    IF v_home_revisions<>v_submitted_revisions THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_revision_projection_mismatch';
    END IF;
    FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_json->'decisionRevisions','[]'::jsonb)) item(value) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}')='array' THEN
        FOR v_citation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}') citation(value) LOOP
          BEGIN
            IF NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(v_citation->>'publishedAt',''))
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(v_citation->>'collectedAt',''))
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(v_citation->>'evaluatedAt',''))
              OR (v_citation->>'publishedAt')::timestamptz>(v_citation->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz
              OR (v_citation->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz>(v_citation->>'evaluatedAt')::timestamptz
            THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_integrity_failure' USING ERRCODE='PT409';END IF;
          EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'PT409' THEN RAISE;
            WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_integrity_failure' USING ERRCODE='PT409';
          END;
        END LOOP;
      END IF;
      IF v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'='conditional_research' THEN
        v_relative_threshold:=v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,valuationSummary,thresholdAuthority}';
        IF NOT public.legacy_valid_relative_valuation_authority_v3_13(
          v_item->>'symbol',v_cutoff,v_relative_threshold)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_integrity_failure/relative_valuation_authority';END IF;
      END IF;
      IF coalesce(v_item->>'symbol','')!~'^[0-9]{4}$'
        OR coalesce(v_item->>'decisionRevisionId','')!~'^decision-v3[.](13|14):[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,kind}','') NOT IN ('legacy_decision_revision_v3_13','legacy_decision_revision_v3_14')
        OR v_item#>>'{identityBundle,kind}'<>'legacy_decision_revision_identity_v3_13'
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,hash}','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{identityBundle,hash}','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        OR v_item#>>'{bundle,json,symbol}'<>v_item->>'symbol'
        OR v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionRevisionId}'<>v_item->>'decisionRevisionId'
        OR v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,decisionRevisionId}'<>v_item->>'decisionRevisionId'
        OR NOT public.legacy_valid_decision_envelope_v3_13(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope}')
        OR (v_item#>'{bundle,json,researchDecision}' IS NOT NULL AND (
          jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,researchDecision}')<>'object'
          OR v_item#>'{bundle,json,researchDecision,decisionEnvelope}'
            IS DISTINCT FROM v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope}'))
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,version}','') NOT IN ('decision-envelope-v3.13.0','decision-envelope-v3.14.0')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,version}'='decision-envelope-v3.13.0'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,kind}'<>'legacy_decision_revision_v3_13')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,version}'='decision-envelope-v3.14.0'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,kind}'<>'legacy_decision_revision_v3_14')
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}','')
          NOT IN ('formal','conditional_research','none')
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,valuationReadiness}','')
          NOT IN ('complete','relative_only','missing','stale','conflict')
        OR coalesce(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,userAction}','')
          NOT IN ('buy','accumulate','research_starter','wait_value','wait_market','wait_breakout','wait_reclaim','avoid_chase','avoid','unavailable')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'='formal'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,valuationReadiness}'<>'complete')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'='conditional_research'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,valuationReadiness}'<>'relative_only')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'='none'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,valuationReadiness}' NOT IN ('missing','stale','conflict'))
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,userAction}' IN ('buy','accumulate')
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'<>'formal')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,userAction}'='research_starter'
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'<>'conditional_research')
        OR (v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,userAction}' IN
          ('buy','accumulate','research_starter','wait_value','wait_market','wait_breakout','wait_reclaim','avoid_chase')
          AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,recommendationAuthority}'='none')
        OR (
          (NOT (
            jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief}')='object'
            AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,availability}'='unavailable'
            AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,reason}'='insufficient_cited_decision_brief'
            AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief}'))=2
            AND v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,userAction}'='unavailable'
          ) AND (
          jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief}')<>'object'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,thesis}')<>'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,thesis}')<>3
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,thesis}') point(value)
            WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)<>'string' OR length(value#>>'{}') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 240
              OR value#>>'{}'<>btrim(value#>>'{}'))
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,risks}')<>'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,risks}')<>3
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,risks}') point(value)
            WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)<>'string' OR length(value#>>'{}') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 240
              OR value#>>'{}'<>btrim(value#>>'{}'))
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,evidence}')<>'array'
          OR jsonb_array_length(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,evidence}')<>6
          OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'point') FROM jsonb_array_elements(
            v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,evidence}') point(value))<>6
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionBrief,evidence}') point(value)
            WHERE coalesce(value->>'point','') NOT IN ('thesis:0','thesis:1','thesis:2','risk:0','risk:1','risk:2')
              OR jsonb_typeof(value->'refs')<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(value->'refs')=0
              OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(value->'refs') ref(value)
                WHERE jsonb_typeof(ref.value)<>'string')
              OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT ref.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(value->'refs') ref(value))
                <>jsonb_array_length(value->'refs')
              OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(value->'refs') ref(value)
                WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(
                  v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}','[]'::jsonb)) citation(value)
                  WHERE citation.value->>'ref'=ref.value#>>'{}'
                    AND length(coalesce(citation.value->>'sourceKey',''))>0
                    AND citation.value->>'sourceKey'=btrim(citation.value->>'sourceKey')
                    AND length(coalesce(citation.value->>'sourceName',''))>0
                    AND citation.value->>'sourceName'=btrim(citation.value->>'sourceName')
                    AND public.legacy_valid_https_url_v3_13(coalesce(citation.value->>'sourceUrl',''))
                    AND public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(citation.value->>'publishedAt',''))
                    AND public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(citation.value->>'collectedAt',''))
                    AND public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(citation.value->>'evaluatedAt',''))
                    AND (citation.value->>'publishedAt')::timestamptz
                      <=(citation.value->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz
                    AND (citation.value->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz
                      <=(citation.value->>'evaluatedAt')::timestamptz)))
          ))
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}')<>'array'
          OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'ref') FROM jsonb_array_elements(
            v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}') citation(value))
            <>jsonb_array_length(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}')
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}') citation(value)
            WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)<>'object' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'ref')<>'string'
              OR jsonb_typeof(value->'sourceKey')<>'string' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'sourceName')<>'string'
              OR jsonb_typeof(value->'sourceUrl')<>'string' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'publishedAt')<>'string'
              OR jsonb_typeof(value->'collectedAt')<>'string' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'evaluatedAt')<>'string'
              OR length(coalesce(value->>'ref',''))=0 OR value->>'ref'<>btrim(value->>'ref')
              OR length(coalesce(value->>'sourceKey',''))=0 OR value->>'sourceKey'<>btrim(value->>'sourceKey')
              OR length(coalesce(value->>'sourceName',''))=0 OR value->>'sourceName'<>btrim(value->>'sourceName')
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_https_url_v3_13(coalesce(value->>'sourceUrl',''))
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(value->>'publishedAt',''))
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(value->>'collectedAt',''))
              OR NOT public.legacy_valid_rfc3339_v3_13(coalesce(value->>'evaluatedAt',''))
              OR (value->>'publishedAt')::timestamptz>(value->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz
              OR (value->>'collectedAt')::timestamptz>(value->>'evaluatedAt')::timestamptz)
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance}')<>'object'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceKey}')<>'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceName}')<>'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceUrl}')<>'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,publishedAt}')<>'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,collectedAt}')<>'string'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,evaluatedAt}')<>'string'
          OR v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceKey}'
            <>btrim(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceKey}')
          OR v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceName}'
            <>btrim(v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceName}')
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_item#>'{bundle,json,citations}') citation(value)
            WHERE citation.value->>'sourceKey'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceKey}'
              AND citation.value->>'sourceName'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceName}'
              AND citation.value->>'sourceUrl'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,sourceUrl}'
              AND citation.value->>'publishedAt'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,publishedAt}'
              AND citation.value->>'collectedAt'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,collectedAt}'
              AND citation.value->>'evaluatedAt'=v_item#>>'{bundle,json,sourceProvenance,evaluatedAt}')
        )
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_integrity_failure';END IF;
      v_payload_bytes:=convert_to(v_item#>>'{bundle,canonical}','utf8');
      v_expected_payload_canonical:=public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(v_item#>'{bundle,json}');
      IF convert_from(v_payload_bytes,'utf8')::jsonb<>v_item#>'{bundle,json}'
        OR convert_from(v_payload_bytes,'utf8')<>v_expected_payload_canonical
        OR encode(extensions.digest(v_payload_bytes,'sha256'),'hex')<>v_item#>>'{bundle,hash}'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_integrity_failure';END IF;
      v_identity_bytes:=convert_to(v_item#>>'{identityBundle,canonical}','utf8');
      v_identity_json:=jsonb_build_array('decision-revision-v3.13.2',
        ((v_item#>'{bundle,json}')-'decisionRevisionId'::text)||jsonb_build_object('decisionEnvelope',
          (v_item#>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope}')-'decisionRevisionId'::text)
          ||CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_item#>'{bundle,json,researchDossier}')='object'
            THEN jsonb_build_object('researchDossier',
              ((v_item#>'{bundle,json,researchDossier}')-'dossierId'::text)-'decisionRevisionId'::text)
            ELSE '{}'::jsonb END);
      v_expected_identity_canonical:=public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(v_identity_json);
      IF convert_from(v_identity_bytes,'utf8')::jsonb<>v_identity_json
        OR convert_from(v_identity_bytes,'utf8')<>v_expected_identity_canonical
        OR encode(extensions.digest(v_identity_bytes,'sha256'),'hex')<>v_item#>>'{identityBundle,hash}'
        OR v_item->>'decisionRevisionId'<>(
          'decision-v3.'||CASE WHEN v_item#>>'{bundle,json,decisionEnvelope,version}'='decision-envelope-v3.14.0'
            THEN '14' ELSE '13' END||':'||(v_item#>>'{identityBundle,hash}'))
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_revision_identity_conflict';END IF;
      SELECT decision_payload_sha256 INTO v_existing_hash
      FROM public.legacy_decision_revisions_v3_13
      WHERE decision_revision_id=v_item->>'decisionRevisionId';
      IF v_existing_hash IS NOT NULL AND v_existing_hash<>v_item#>>'{bundle,hash}'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_revision_checksum_conflict';END IF;
      INSERT INTO public.legacy_decision_revisions_v3_13(decision_revision_id,symbol,
        decision_payload_canonical,decision_payload_json,decision_payload_sha256,recorded_at)
      VALUES(v_item->>'decisionRevisionId',v_item->>'symbol',v_payload_bytes,v_item#>'{bundle,json}',
        v_item#>>'{bundle,hash}',v_now)
      ON CONFLICT(decision_revision_id) DO NOTHING;
      v_evaluated_at:=(v_item#>>'{sourceLedCorrectness,evaluatedAt}')::timestamptz;
      SELECT evaluation.source_led_correctness INTO v_existing_correctness
      FROM public.legacy_decision_revision_evaluations_v3_13 evaluation
      WHERE evaluation.decision_revision_id=v_item->>'decisionRevisionId'
        AND evaluation.evaluated_at=v_evaluated_at FOR UPDATE;
      IF v_existing_correctness IS NOT NULL AND v_existing_correctness<>v_item->'sourceLedCorrectness'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_evaluation_checksum_conflict';END IF;
      INSERT INTO public.legacy_decision_revision_evaluations_v3_13(decision_revision_id,projection_id,
        source_led_correctness,evaluated_at,recorded_at)
      VALUES(v_item->>'decisionRevisionId',v_projection_id,v_item->'sourceLedCorrectness',
        v_evaluated_at,v_now)
      ON CONFLICT(decision_revision_id,evaluated_at) DO NOTHING;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  status:=v_status;next_job:=v_next;RETURN NEXT;
END $function$

functions.name: complete_legacy_producer_job_rest_v3_15(uuid,uuid,uuid,bytea,jsonb,text,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_legacy_producer_job_rest_v3_15(p_run_id uuid, p_job_id uuid, p_owner_token uuid, p_result bytea, p_json jsonb, p_hash text, p_authority_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(status text, next_job jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(p_authority_hash,'')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_producer_runs_v3_11 run
    WHERE run.run_id=p_run_id AND run.authority_hash=p_authority_hash
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='authentication_rejected';END IF;
  IF p_json#>>'{officialIngestion,schema}'='legacy-official-ingestion-v3.14' AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
    WHERE chunk.run_id=p_run_id AND chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind<>'terminal'
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_applications_v3_15 applied
        WHERE applied.run_id=chunk.run_id AND applied.job_id=chunk.job_id
          AND applied.chunk_kind=chunk.chunk_kind AND applied.chunk_ordinal=chunk.chunk_ordinal
          AND applied.chunk_hash=chunk.chunk_hash AND applied.producer_sha=chunk.producer_sha
          AND applied.source_cutoff=chunk.source_cutoff AND applied.item_count=chunk.item_count)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_preapply_incomplete';END IF;
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('stockinsider.legacy_authority_hash',p_authority_hash,true);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT completed.status,completed.next_job
  FROM public.complete_legacy_producer_job_v3_14(
    p_run_id,p_job_id,p_owner_token,p_result,p_json,p_hash) completed;
END $function$

functions.name: complete_legacy_producer_job_v3_11(uuid,uuid,uuid,bytea,jsonb,text)
complete_legacy_producer_job_v3_14(uuid,uuid,uuid,bytea,jsonb,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_legacy_producer_job_v3_14(p_run_id uuid, p_job_id uuid, p_owner_token uuid, p_result bytea, p_json jsonb, p_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(status text, next_job jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_status text;v_next_job jsonb;v_terminal text;v_summary jsonb;v_chunk record;v_manifest_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_json->'officialIngestion'->>'schema'='legacy-official-ingestion-v3.14' THEN
    v_summary:=p_json->'officialIngestion';v_terminal:=v_summary->>'terminalRoot';
    IF coalesce(v_terminal,'')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
      WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.run_id=p_run_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='terminal'
        AND chunk.chunk_hash=v_terminal AND chunk.producer_sha=(SELECT producer_commit_sha FROM public.legacy_producer_runs_v3_11 WHERE run_id=p_run_id)
    ) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
      WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind<>'terminal')<>jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_summary->'chunks','[]'::jsonb))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_summary->'chunks','[]'::jsonb)) member(value)
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind=value->>'kind'
            AND chunk.chunk_ordinal=(value->>'ordinal')::integer AND chunk.item_count=(value->>'itemCount')::integer
            AND chunk.chunk_hash=value->>'chunkHash'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_terminal_incomplete';END IF;
    SELECT count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(value->>'kind',value->>'ordinal',value->>'itemCount',value->>'chunkHash'))
      INTO v_manifest_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_summary->'chunks','[]'::jsonb)) member(value);
    IF v_manifest_count<>jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_summary->'chunks','[]'::jsonb))
      OR coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,trading_sessions}')::integer,0)>1200
      OR coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,financial_facts}')::integer,0)>3840
      OR coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,price_observations}')::integer,0)>5200
      OR coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,corporate_action_snapshots}')::integer,0)>260
      OR coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,reported_valuations}')::integer,0)>8000
      OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(chunk.item_count),0) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='trading_sessions')
          <>coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,trading_sessions}')::integer,-1)
      OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(chunk.item_count),0) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='financial_facts')
          <>coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,financial_facts}')::integer,-1)
      OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(chunk.item_count),0) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='price_observations')
          <>coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,price_observations}')::integer,-1)
      OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(chunk.item_count),0) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='corporate_action_snapshots')
          <>coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,corporate_action_snapshots}')::integer,-1)
      OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(chunk.item_count),0) FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14 chunk
          WHERE chunk.job_id=p_job_id AND chunk.chunk_kind='reported_valuations')
          <>coalesce((v_summary#>>'{counts,reported_valuations}')::integer,-1)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_conservation';END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT chunk_kind,chunk_ordinal,
        row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY chunk_kind ORDER BY chunk_ordinal)-1 expected_ordinal
      FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14
      WHERE run_id=p_run_id AND job_id=p_job_id AND chunk_kind<>'terminal') ordered
      WHERE chunk_ordinal<>expected_ordinal)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='official_ingestion_chunk_ordinal_gap';END IF;
  END IF;
  SELECT completed.status,completed.next_job INTO v_status,v_next_job FROM public.complete_legacy_producer_job_v3_11(
    p_run_id,p_job_id,p_owner_token,p_result,p_json,p_hash) completed;
  IF v_status IS NULL THEN RETURN;END IF;
  IF p_json->'officialIngestion'->>'schema'='legacy-official-ingestion-v3.14' THEN
    FOR v_chunk IN SELECT chunk_kind,chunk_ordinal,items_json,chunk_hash,producer_sha,source_cutoff
      FROM public.legacy_official_ingestion_chunks_v3_14
      WHERE run_id=p_run_id AND job_id=p_job_id AND chunk_kind<>'terminal'
      ORDER BY CASE chunk_kind WHEN 'trading_sessions' THEN 1 WHEN 'financial_facts' THEN 2
        WHEN 'price_observations' THEN 3 WHEN 'corporate_action_snapshots' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,chunk_ordinal
    LOOP
      PERFORM public.apply_legacy_official_ingestion_chunk_v3_14(p_run_id,p_job_id,p_owner_token,
        v_chunk.chunk_kind,v_chunk.chunk_ordinal,v_chunk.items_json,v_chunk.chunk_hash,
        v_chunk.producer_sha,v_chunk.source_cutoff);
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  status:=v_status;next_job:=v_next_job;RETURN NEXT;
END $function$

functions.name: complete_opportunity_job_v3(uuid,text,text,opportunity_job_counts_v3)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_opportunity_job_v3(job_id uuid, owner_token text, output_hash text, counts opportunity_job_counts_v3)
 RETURNS TABLE(status opportunity_job_status_v3)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_job public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3%ROWTYPE; v_stage public.opportunity_job_staging_v3%ROWTYPE;
  v_document jsonb; v_claim jsonb; v_mention jsonb; v_row jsonb; v_score jsonb;
  v_detail jsonb; v_warning jsonb; v_row_text text; v_row_hash text;
  v_ordinal integer := 0; v_success_count integer := 0; v_failure_count integer := 0;
  v_candidate jsonb; v_decision jsonb; v_reason text; v_action text;
  v_reason_index integer; v_prior_reason_index integer; v_cutoff_text text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j
  WHERE j.job_id=$1 AND j.status='leased'
    AND j.lease_expires_at >= clock_timestamp()
    AND j.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to($2,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_stage FROM public.opportunity_job_staging_v3 s
  WHERE s.job_id=$1 AND s.attempt=v_job.attempt AND s.output_hash=$3;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_stage.output_counts IS DISTINCT FROM $4 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='manifest_missing';
  END IF;
  IF v_stage.output_kind IN ('deep_candidate_batch','portfolio_allocation_batch') THEN
    SELECT to_char(run.source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    INTO STRICT v_cutoff_text FROM public.opportunity_runs run WHERE run.run_id=v_job.run_id;
    FOR v_candidate IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF v_stage.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch' AND v_candidate->14<>'null'::jsonb THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
      v_decision:=CASE WHEN v_stage.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch' THEN v_candidate->8 ELSE v_candidate->1 END;
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_decision)<>'object'
        OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_decision) key)
          <>ARRAY['blockReasons','confidence','decisionAuthority','entryTrigger','existingPositionAction',
            'existingReason','existingTargetExposurePct','initialPositionPct','invalidation',
            'maximumPositionPct','newPositionAction','primaryHorizon','publicationEligible']::text[]
        OR v_decision->>'decisionAuthority'<>'research_only'
        OR v_decision->'publicationEligible'<>'false'::jsonb
        OR v_decision->>'existingPositionAction'<>'no_position'
        OR v_decision->>'existingReason'<>'portfolio_context_unavailable'
        OR v_decision->'existingTargetExposurePct'<>'null'::jsonb
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'initialPositionPct')<>'number'
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'maximumPositionPct')<>'number'
        OR (v_decision->>'initialPositionPct')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        OR (v_decision->>'maximumPositionPct')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10
        OR (v_decision->>'initialPositionPct')::numeric>(v_decision->>'maximumPositionPct')::numeric
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'confidence')<>'number'
        OR (v_decision->>'confidence')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1
        OR NOT (v_decision->'primaryHorizon'='null'::jsonb
          OR v_decision->>'primaryHorizon' IN ('momentum_5_20d','swing_20_60d'))
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'blockReasons')<>'array'
        OR jsonb_array_length(v_decision->'blockReasons')>5
        OR NOT (v_decision->'entryTrigger'='null'::jsonb OR (
          jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'entryTrigger')='string'
          AND btrim(v_decision->>'entryTrigger')<>''
          AND char_length(v_decision->>'entryTrigger')<=160))
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'invalidation')<>'object'
        OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_decision->'invalidation') key)
          <>ARRAY['code','evidenceExpiresAt','stopPrice']::text[]
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      v_prior_reason_index:=0;
      FOR v_reason IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_decision->'blockReasons') LOOP
        v_reason_index:=array_position(ARRAY[
          'data_integrity','market_risk_off','capacity_exhausted','invalid_exposure_input',
          'score_below_threshold','confidence_below_threshold','valuation_unavailable',
          'valuation_reward_risk','entry_data_unavailable','entry_invalidated','entry_unconfirmed',
          'bias_observe_only','quality_insufficient','no_eligible_method','missing_required_inputs',
          'insufficient_series','insufficient_multiple_reference','cross_check_unavailable',
          'missing_financial_manifest','stale_financial_inputs','conflicting_point_in_time_fact',
          'invalid_unit','missing_bridge_inputs','nonconsecutive_quarters','operating_bridge_mismatch',
          'pretax_bridge_mismatch','net_income_bridge_mismatch','share_count_conflict',
          'reported_eps_mismatch','tax_rate_outlier','capital_structure_conflict','non_finite_bridge',
          'negative_equity_value','invalid_capital_structure','non_finite_distribution',
          'distribution_ordering','unverified_base_upside','unverified_scenario_upside',
          'consensus_divergence','method_divergence']::text[],v_reason);
        IF v_reason_index IS NULL OR v_reason_index<=v_prior_reason_index THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
        END IF;
        v_prior_reason_index:=v_reason_index;
      END LOOP;
      v_action:=v_decision->>'newPositionAction';
      IF v_action NOT IN ('avoid','valuation_review','wait_trigger','event_starter','starter_now') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      ELSIF v_decision->'primaryHorizon'='null'::jsonb AND NOT (
        v_action='avoid' AND v_decision->'blockReasons'='["data_integrity"]'::jsonb
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      ELSIF v_action='event_starter' AND v_decision->>'primaryHorizon'<>'momentum_5_20d' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      ELSIF v_action IN ('starter_now','event_starter') THEN
        IF (v_decision->>'initialPositionPct')::numeric<=0
          OR (v_decision->>'maximumPositionPct')::numeric<>10
          OR jsonb_array_length(v_decision->'blockReasons')<>0
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'entryTrigger')<>'string'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->>'code'<>'price_stop_or_evidence_expiry'
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'invalidation'->'stopPrice')<>'number'
          OR (v_decision->'invalidation'->>'stopPrice')::numeric<=0
          OR (v_decision->'invalidation'->>'evidenceExpiresAt')
            !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->>'evidenceExpiresAt'<=v_cutoff_text
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      ELSIF v_action='wait_trigger' THEN
        IF v_decision->'initialPositionPct'<>'0'::jsonb OR v_decision->'maximumPositionPct'<>'0'::jsonb
          OR v_decision->'blockReasons'<>'["entry_unconfirmed"]'::jsonb
          OR jsonb_typeof(v_decision->'entryTrigger')<>'string'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->>'code'<>'evidence_expiry_only'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->'stopPrice'<>'null'::jsonb
          OR (v_decision->'invalidation'->>'evidenceExpiresAt')
            !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->>'evidenceExpiresAt'<=v_cutoff_text
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      ELSE
        IF v_decision->'initialPositionPct'<>'0'::jsonb OR v_decision->'maximumPositionPct'<>'0'::jsonb
          OR v_decision->'entryTrigger'<>'null'::jsonb
          OR jsonb_array_length(v_decision->'blockReasons')=0
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->>'code'<>'data_integrity_review'
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->'stopPrice'<>'null'::jsonb
          OR v_decision->'invalidation'->'evidenceExpiresAt'<>'null'::jsonb
          OR (v_action='avoid' AND (
            jsonb_array_length(v_decision->'blockReasons')<>1
            OR v_decision->'blockReasons'->>0 NOT IN ('data_integrity','market_risk_off',
              'capacity_exhausted','invalid_exposure_input','score_below_threshold',
              'confidence_below_threshold','valuation_reward_risk','entry_data_unavailable',
              'entry_invalidated','entry_unconfirmed','bias_observe_only','quality_insufficient')
          ))
          OR (v_action='valuation_review' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_decision->'blockReasons') reason(value)
            WHERE reason.value NOT IN ('valuation_unavailable','no_eligible_method','missing_required_inputs',
              'insufficient_series','insufficient_multiple_reference','cross_check_unavailable',
              'missing_financial_manifest','stale_financial_inputs','conflicting_point_in_time_fact',
              'invalid_unit','missing_bridge_inputs','nonconsecutive_quarters','operating_bridge_mismatch',
              'pretax_bridge_mismatch','net_income_bridge_mismatch','share_count_conflict',
              'reported_eps_mismatch','tax_rate_outlier','capital_structure_conflict','non_finite_bridge',
              'negative_equity_value','invalid_capital_structure','non_finite_distribution',
              'distribution_ordering','unverified_base_upside','unverified_scenario_upside',
              'consensus_divergence','method_divergence')))
          OR (v_action='valuation_review'
            AND v_decision->'blockReasons' ? 'valuation_unavailable'
            AND jsonb_array_length(v_decision->'blockReasons')<>1)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      END IF;
      IF v_stage.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch' AND (
        v_decision->'initialPositionPct'<>v_candidate->9
        OR v_decision->'maximumPositionPct'<>v_candidate->10
      ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  IF v_stage.output_kind='source_parse_batch' THEN
    v_document:=v_stage.output_json->5->0->0;
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_document)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_document)<>9 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_source_document_outcomes(
      run_id,source_key,revision_id,selection_ordinal,canonical_document_id,effective_at,
      outcome,content_hash,extracted_claim_count,raw_mention_count
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,(v_document->>0)::public.source_key_v3,(v_document->>1)::uuid,
      (v_document->>2)::integer,v_document->>3,(v_document->>4)::timestamptz,
      (v_document->>5)::public.opportunity_document_outcome_v3,v_document->>6,
      (v_document->>7)::integer,(v_document->>8)::integer
    );
    FOR v_claim IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5->1) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_claim)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_claim)<>12
        OR (v_claim->>0)::uuid<>(v_document->>1)::uuid
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_source_claims(
        run_id,revision_id,claim_ordinal,canonical_claim_id,outcome,canonical_prior_claim_id,
        evidence_root_id,effective_at,claim_confidence,source_ref,verification_tier,claim_evidence_stance
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.run_id,(v_claim->>0)::uuid,(v_claim->>1)::integer,v_claim->>2,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_source_claims prior
          WHERE prior.canonical_claim_id=v_claim->>2
            AND prior.run_id=v_job.run_id
        ) THEN 'duplicate_claim'::public.opportunity_claim_outcome_v3
        ELSE (v_claim->>3)::public.opportunity_claim_outcome_v3 END,
        coalesce(
          CASE WHEN v_claim->>4 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
            SELECT prior.claim_id FROM public.opportunity_source_claims prior
            WHERE prior.run_id=v_job.run_id
              AND prior.revision_id=(v_claim->>4)::uuid
              AND prior.claim_ordinal=(v_claim->>5)::integer
          ) END,
          (
            SELECT prior.claim_id FROM public.opportunity_source_claims prior
            JOIN public.opportunity_source_document_outcomes prior_document
              ON prior_document.run_id=prior.run_id
              AND prior_document.revision_id=prior.revision_id
            WHERE prior.canonical_claim_id=v_claim->>2
              AND prior.run_id=v_job.run_id
            ORDER BY prior.effective_at,prior_document.canonical_document_id,
              prior.claim_ordinal
            LIMIT 1
          )
        ),
        v_claim->>6,(v_claim->>7)::timestamptz,(v_claim->>8)::double precision,
        v_claim->>9,(v_claim->>10)::public.opportunity_evidence_verification_tier_v3,
        (v_claim->>11)::public.opportunity_claim_evidence_stance_v3
      );
    END LOOP;
    FOR v_mention IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5->2) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_mention)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_mention)<>15
        OR (v_mention->>0)::uuid<>(v_document->>1)::uuid
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_source_mentions(
        run_id,revision_id,claim_ordinal,mention_ordinal,normalized_token,start_offset,end_offset,
        review_context,review_mention_start_offset,review_mention_end_offset,link_mode,stock_id,
        symbol,outcome,reason,confidence
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.run_id,(v_mention->>0)::uuid,(v_mention->>1)::integer,(v_mention->>2)::integer,
        v_mention->>3,(v_mention->>4)::integer,(v_mention->>5)::integer,v_mention->>6,
        (v_mention->>7)::integer,(v_mention->>8)::integer,
        (v_mention->>9)::public.opportunity_link_mode_v3,
        CASE WHEN v_mention->>10 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (v_mention->>10)::uuid END,
        v_mention->>11,
        CASE WHEN (v_mention->>12) IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh')
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_source_claims claim
            WHERE claim.run_id=v_job.run_id
              AND claim.revision_id=(v_mention->>0)::uuid
              AND claim.claim_ordinal=(v_mention->>1)::integer
              AND claim.outcome='duplicate_claim'
          )
          THEN 'linked_duplicate_claim'::public.opportunity_mention_outcome_v3
          WHEN (v_mention->>12)='linked_new'
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions prior
              JOIN public.opportunity_runs prior_run ON prior_run.run_id=prior.run_id
              WHERE prior.run_id<>v_job.run_id
                AND prior.stock_id=(v_mention->>10)::uuid
                AND prior.symbol=v_mention->>11
                AND prior.outcome IN (
                  'linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim'
                )
                AND prior_run.source_cutoff<=(
                  SELECT current_run.source_cutoff
                  FROM public.opportunity_runs current_run
                  WHERE current_run.run_id=v_job.run_id
                )
            )
          THEN 'linked_refresh'::public.opportunity_mention_outcome_v3
          ELSE (v_mention->>12)::public.opportunity_mention_outcome_v3 END,
        CASE WHEN (v_mention->>12) IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh')
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_source_claims claim
            WHERE claim.run_id=v_job.run_id
              AND claim.revision_id=(v_mention->>0)::uuid
              AND claim.claim_ordinal=(v_mention->>1)::integer
              AND claim.outcome='duplicate_claim'
          )
          THEN 'duplicate_claim_link'::public.opportunity_mention_reason_v3
          ELSE (v_mention->>13)::public.opportunity_mention_reason_v3 END,
        (v_mention->>14)::double precision
      );
    END LOOP;
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_source_claims c
        WHERE c.run_id=v_job.run_id AND c.revision_id=(v_document->>1)::uuid)
        <>(v_document->>7)::integer
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions m
        WHERE m.run_id=v_job.run_id AND m.revision_id=(v_document->>1)::uuid)
        <>(v_document->>8)::integer
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
    SELECT jsonb_build_array(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
        document.source_key,document.revision_id,document.selection_ordinal,
        document.canonical_document_id,document.effective_at,document.outcome,
        document.content_hash,document.extracted_claim_count,document.raw_mention_count
      ) ORDER BY document.selection_ordinal)
      FROM public.opportunity_source_document_outcomes document
      WHERE document.run_id=v_job.run_id
        AND document.revision_id=(v_document->>1)::uuid),
      (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
        claim.revision_id,claim.claim_ordinal,claim.canonical_claim_id,claim.outcome,
        prior.revision_id,prior.claim_ordinal,claim.evidence_root_id,claim.effective_at,
        claim.claim_confidence,claim.source_ref,claim.verification_tier,
        claim.claim_evidence_stance
      ) ORDER BY claim.claim_ordinal),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.opportunity_source_claims claim
      LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_source_claims prior
        ON prior.claim_id=claim.canonical_prior_claim_id
      WHERE claim.run_id=v_job.run_id
        AND claim.revision_id=(v_document->>1)::uuid),
      (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
        mention.revision_id,mention.claim_ordinal,mention.mention_ordinal,
        mention.normalized_token,mention.start_offset,mention.end_offset,
        mention.review_context,mention.review_mention_start_offset,
        mention.review_mention_end_offset,mention.link_mode,mention.stock_id,
        mention.symbol,mention.outcome,mention.reason,mention.confidence
      ) ORDER BY mention.claim_ordinal,mention.mention_ordinal),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions mention
      WHERE mention.run_id=v_job.run_id
        AND mention.revision_id=(v_document->>1)::uuid)
    ) INTO v_row;
    v_stage.output_json:=jsonb_set(v_stage.output_json,'{5}',v_row,false);
    v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_stage.output_json::text, ', ', ',', 'g');
    v_stage.output_canonical:=convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8');
    v_stage.output_hash:=encode(
      extensions.digest(v_stage.output_canonical,'sha256'),'hex'
    );
    UPDATE public.opportunity_job_staging_v3 staging SET
      output_canonical=v_stage.output_canonical,
      output_json=v_stage.output_json,
      output_hash=v_stage.output_hash
    WHERE staging.job_id=v_job.job_id AND staging.attempt=v_job.attempt;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='source_connector_summary' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_source_connector_accounting(
      run_id,source_key,eligible_document_count,selected_document_count,deferred_due_scan_cap_count,
      duplicate_document_count,expired_document_count,parse_failure_count,processed_no_claim_count,
      processed_with_claims_count,unique_claim_count,duplicate_claim_count,linked_new_count,
      linked_refresh_count,linked_duplicate_claim_count,ambiguous_symbol_count,
      rejected_low_confidence_count,unsupported_instrument_count,mention_reason_counts,
      linked_candidate_count,status,failure_reason
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,(v_stage.output_json->5->>'sourceKey')::public.source_key_v3,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->>'eligibleDocuments')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->>'selectedDocuments')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->>'deferredDueScanCap')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'documentOutcomes'->>'duplicate_document')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'documentOutcomes'->>'expired_document')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'documentOutcomes'->>'parse_failure')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'documentOutcomes'->>'processed_no_claim')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'documentOutcomes'->>'processed_with_claims')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'claimOutcomes'->>'unique_claim')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'claimOutcomes'->>'duplicate_claim')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'linked_new')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'linked_refresh')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'linked_duplicate_claim')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'ambiguous_symbol')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'rejected_low_confidence')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionOutcomes'->>'unsupported_instrument')::integer,
      v_stage.output_json->5->'mentionReasonCounts',
      (v_stage.output_json->5->>'linkedCandidateCount')::integer,
      (v_stage.output_json->5->>'status')::public.opportunity_source_connector_status_v3,
      CASE WHEN v_stage.output_json->5->>'failureReason' IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (v_stage.output_json->5->>'failureReason')::public.opportunity_failure_code_v3 END
    );
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='market_context_snapshot' THEN
    v_row:=v_stage.output_json->5;
    v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
    v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_market_context_snapshots(
      run_id,contract_version,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,'market-context-v3.6',convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
    );
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='shallow_candidate_batch' THEN
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row)<>13
        OR (v_row->>1) !~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
        OR (v_row->>5)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        OR (v_row->>6)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        OR (v_row->>7)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        OR (v_row->>8)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->12)<>'array'
        OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->12)>12
        OR (
          ((v_row->>3)='direct_candidate') IS DISTINCT FROM (v_row->>2)::boolean
        )
        OR (
          (v_row->>3)='direct_candidate' AND v_row->4='null'::jsonb
        )
        OR (
          (v_row->>3)='comparison_only' AND v_row->4<>'null'::jsonb
        )
        OR (
          (v_row->>10)='failed' AND v_row->11='null'::jsonb
        )
        OR (
          (v_row->>10)<>'failed' AND v_row->11<>'null'::jsonb
        )
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_shallow_candidate_results_v3(
        job_id,run_id,candidate_ordinal,stock_id,symbol,direct_source,candidate_origin,
        anchor_claim_id,canonical_sector_key,shallow_status,failure_code,
        payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.job_id,v_job.run_id,v_ordinal,(v_row->>0)::uuid,v_row->>1,
        (v_row->>2)::boolean,(v_row->>3)::public.opportunity_candidate_origin_v3,
        CASE WHEN v_row->4='null'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE (v_row->>4)::uuid END,
        (v_row->>9)::public.canonical_sector_key_v3,
        (v_row->>10)::public.opportunity_shallow_status_v3,
        CASE WHEN v_row->11='null'::jsonb THEN NULL
          ELSE (v_row->>11)::public.opportunity_failure_code_v3 END,
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
      );
      v_ordinal:=v_ordinal+1;
    END LOOP;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='sector_cycle_batch' THEN
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row)<>2 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace((v_row->1)::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_sector_cycle_snapshots(
        run_id,canonical_sector_key,contract_version,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.run_id,(v_row->>0)::public.canonical_sector_key_v3,'sector-cycle-v3.0',
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row->1,v_row_hash
      );
    END LOOP;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch' THEN
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row)<>15 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      END IF;
      IF v_row->14='null'::jsonb AND (
        jsonb_typeof(v_row->8)<>'object'
        OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_row->8) key)
          <>ARRAY['blockReasons','confidence','decisionAuthority','entryTrigger','existingPositionAction',
            'existingReason','existingTargetExposurePct','initialPositionPct','invalidation',
            'maximumPositionPct','newPositionAction','primaryHorizon','publicationEligible']::text[]
        OR v_row->8->'initialPositionPct'<>v_row->9
        OR v_row->8->'maximumPositionPct'<>v_row->10
      ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3(
        job_id,run_id,candidate_ordinal,stock_id,symbol,anchor_claim_id,
        canonical_sector_key,deep_status,failure_code,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.job_id,v_job.run_id,v_ordinal,(v_row->>0)::uuid,v_row->>1,
        (v_row->>4)::uuid,(v_row->>5)::public.canonical_sector_key_v3,
        CASE WHEN v_row->14='null'::jsonb
          THEN 'succeeded'::public.opportunity_deep_status_v3
          ELSE 'failed'::public.opportunity_deep_status_v3 END,
        CASE WHEN v_row->14='null'::jsonb THEN NULL
          ELSE (v_row->>14)::public.opportunity_failure_code_v3 END,
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
      );
      IF v_row->14='null'::jsonb THEN
        IF jsonb_typeof(v_row->13)<>'object' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
        END IF;
        v_success_count:=v_success_count+1;
        IF jsonb_typeof(v_row->11)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->11)<>3 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
        END IF;
        FOR v_score IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_row->11) LOOP
          IF jsonb_typeof(v_score)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_score)<>6 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
          END IF;
          IF (v_score->>0) NOT IN ('momentum_5_20d','swing_20_60d','thesis_120_250d')
            OR (v_score->>2)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            OR (v_score->>3)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1
            OR (v_score->>4)::double precision NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
        END LOOP;
      ELSE
        v_failure_count:=v_failure_count+1;
      END IF;
      v_ordinal:=v_ordinal+1;
    END LOOP;
    IF v_success_count<>(v_stage.output_counts).deep_success_candidate_count
      OR v_failure_count<>(v_stage.output_counts).deep_failure_candidate_count
      OR (v_stage.output_counts).score_snapshot_count<>0
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='portfolio_allocation_batch' THEN
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row)<>2
        OR (v_row->>0) !~ '^[0-9]{4}$' OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->1)<>'object'
        OR NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3 d
          WHERE d.run_id=v_job.run_id AND d.symbol=v_row->>0 AND d.deep_status='succeeded'
        )
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace((v_row->1)::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_portfolio_allocations_v3(
        job_id,run_id,allocation_ordinal,symbol,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.job_id,v_job.run_id,v_ordinal,v_row->>0,
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row->1,v_row_hash
      );
      v_ordinal:=v_ordinal+1;
    END LOOP;
    IF v_ordinal<>(
      SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3 d
      WHERE d.run_id=v_job.run_id AND d.deep_status='succeeded'
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='projection_bundle' THEN
    IF jsonb_array_length(v_stage.output_json->5)<>3 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
    WITH score_source AS (
      SELECT deep.stock_id,deep.symbol,score.value,
        (score.value->>0)::public.opportunity_horizon_v3 AS horizon,
        (score.value->>2)::double precision AS score_value,
        (score.value->>3)::double precision AS confidence_value
      FROM public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3 deep
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(deep.payload_json->11) score(value)
      WHERE deep.run_id=v_job.run_id AND deep.deep_status='succeeded'
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT *,row_number() OVER(
        PARTITION BY horizon ORDER BY score_value DESC,confidence_value DESC,symbol ASC
      )::integer AS global_rank
      FROM score_source
    ), normalized AS (
      SELECT *,jsonb_build_array(
        value->0,to_jsonb(global_rank),value->2,value->3,value->4,value->5
      ) AS payload
      FROM ranked
    )
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_score_snapshots(
      run_id,stock_id,symbol,horizon,rank,score,score_confidence,available_weight,
      payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
    )
    SELECT v_job.run_id,stock_id,symbol,horizon,global_rank,score_value,confidence_value,
      (value->>4)::double precision,
      convert_to(regexp_replace(payload::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),payload,
      encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(payload::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    FROM normalized;
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_score_snapshots WHERE run_id=v_job.run_id)
      <>3*(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3
        WHERE run_id=v_job.run_id AND deep_status='succeeded')
      OR (v_stage.output_counts).score_snapshot_count
        <>3*(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_deep_candidate_results_v3
          WHERE run_id=v_job.run_id AND deep_status='succeeded')
      OR (v_stage.output_counts).score_snapshot_count
        <>3*jsonb_array_length(v_stage.output_json->5->2)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5->0) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row)<>8 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_candidate_snapshots(
        run_id,stock_id,symbol,direct_source,candidate_origin,anchor_claim_id,
        shallow_status,deep_status,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.run_id,(v_row->>0)::uuid,v_row->>1,(v_row->>2)::boolean,
        (v_row->>3)::public.opportunity_candidate_origin_v3,
        CASE WHEN v_row->>4 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (v_row->>4)::uuid END,
        CASE v_row->7->>'state'
          WHEN 'deferred_before_shallow' THEN 'deferred'::public.opportunity_shallow_status_v3
          WHEN 'shallow_failed' THEN 'failed'::public.opportunity_shallow_status_v3
          ELSE 'succeeded'::public.opportunity_shallow_status_v3 END,
        CASE v_row->7->>'state'
          WHEN 'deep_failed' THEN 'failed'::public.opportunity_deep_status_v3
          WHEN 'deep_succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'::public.opportunity_deep_status_v3
          ELSE 'not_reached'::public.opportunity_deep_status_v3 END,
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
      );
    END LOOP;
    v_row:=v_stage.output_json->5->1;
    v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
    v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_public_projections_v3(
      run_id,contract_version,acceptance_version,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,'source-led-opportunity-v3.6','1.46.0',
      convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
    );
    FOR v_detail IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5->2) LOOP
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_detail::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_detail_projections_v3(
        run_id,symbol,contract_version,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        v_job.run_id,v_detail->>'symbol','opportunity-detail-v3.3',
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_detail,v_row_hash
      );
    END LOOP;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='outcome_batch' THEN
    FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->5) LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'object' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      END IF;
      v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
      v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
      INSERT INTO public.opportunity_outcomes(
        score_snapshot_id,maturity_horizon,entry_session,entry_session_authority_hash,
        maturity_session,maturity_session_authority_hash,entry_price_ref,outcome_price_ref,
        sector_benchmark_manifest_id,return_pct,sector_relative_return_pct,mfe_pct,mae_pct,
        sector_relative_mfe_pct,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
      ) VALUES(
        (v_row->>'scoreSnapshotId')::uuid,(v_row->>'maturityHorizon')::public.opportunity_outcome_maturity_v3,
        (v_row->>'entrySession')::date,v_row->>'entrySessionAuthorityHash',
        (v_row->>'maturitySession')::date,v_row->>'maturitySessionAuthorityHash',
        v_row->>'entryPriceRef',v_row->>'outcomePriceRef',(v_row->>'sectorBenchmarkManifestId')::uuid,
        (v_row->>'returnPct')::double precision,(v_row->>'sectorRelativeReturnPct')::double precision,
        (v_row->>'mfePct')::double precision,(v_row->>'maePct')::double precision,
        CASE WHEN v_row->>'sectorRelativeMfePct' IS NULL THEN NULL
          ELSE (v_row->>'sectorRelativeMfePct')::double precision END,
        convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
      );
    END LOOP;
  ELSIF v_stage.output_kind='evaluation_bundle' THEN
    v_row:=v_stage.output_json->5;
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'object' OR v_row->>'status' NOT IN ('pass','fail')
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'strategyRows')<>'array'
      OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->'strategyRows')<>3
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
    v_row_text:=regexp_replace(v_row::text,', ', ',', 'g');
    v_row_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_evaluation_results_v3(
      run_id,job_id,status,payload_canonical,payload_json,payload_hash
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,v_job.job_id,v_row->>'status',
      convert_to(v_row_text,'utf8'),v_row,v_row_hash
    );
  END IF;
  FOR v_warning IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_stage.output_json->6) LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_warning_facts_v3(
      run_id,warning,producing_job_id,evidence_ref
    ) VALUES(
      v_job.run_id,(v_warning#>>'{}')::public.opportunity_engine_warning_v3,
      v_job.job_id,'job:'||v_job.job_id::text
    );
  END LOOP;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_job_results_v3(
    job_id,run_id,output_kind,output_canonical,output_json,output_hash,output_counts
  ) VALUES(v_job.job_id,v_job.run_id,v_stage.output_kind,v_stage.output_canonical,v_stage.output_json,v_stage.output_hash,v_stage.output_counts);
  UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 SET status='succeeded',output_kind=v_stage.output_kind,
    output_hash=v_stage.output_hash,output_counts=v_stage.output_counts,terminal_at=clock_timestamp(),
    owner_token_hash=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,heartbeat_at=NULL
  WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=$1;
  PERFORM public.enqueue_next_opportunity_job_v3_internal(v_job.run_id,$1);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT 'succeeded'::public.opportunity_job_status_v3;
END
$function$

functions.name: complete_opportunity_manifest_v3(uuid,text,uuid,bigint,bytea,jsonb,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_opportunity_manifest_v3(job_id uuid, owner_token text, requested_manifest_id uuid, requested_row_count bigint, root_canonical bytea, root_json jsonb, requested_manifest_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(status opportunity_manifest_status_v3, manifest_hash text, row_count bigint, terminal_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_job public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3%ROWTYPE; v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp(); v_actual bigint;
  v_kind public.opportunity_manifest_kind_v3; v_ordinal integer;
  v_manifest public.opportunity_manifests_v3%ROWTYPE; v_read jsonb; v_expected_root jsonb;
  v_run public.opportunity_runs%ROWTYPE; v_header jsonb;
  v_audited_session date; v_audited_hash text; v_previous_hash text; v_plan_hash text;
  v_close timestamptz; v_source_dataset_id uuid; v_source_dataset_hash text;
  v_audit_id uuid; v_audit_name text; v_bytes bytea; v_hex text;
  v_mover_count integer; v_eligible_universe_count integer; v_later_mentioned_count integer;
  v_recall_pct double precision;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j
  WHERE j.job_id=$1 AND j.status='leased' AND j.lease_expires_at>=v_now
    AND j.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to($2,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO v_manifest FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 m
  WHERE m.manifest_id=$3 AND m.status='building' FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT read_json->5 INTO v_read
  FROM public.opportunity_worker_read_units_v3
  WHERE opportunity_worker_read_units_v3.job_id=$1
    AND input_hash=v_job.input_hash;
  IF v_manifest.manifest_id IS NOT NULL AND v_read IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_expected_root:=jsonb_build_array(
      'opportunity-manifest-root-v3.3',v_manifest.manifest_kind,v_manifest.contract_version,
      v_manifest.source_cutoff,v_read->0,v_read->1
    );
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_actual FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 r WHERE r.manifest_id=$3;
  IF v_job.job_id IS NULL OR v_manifest.manifest_id IS NULL OR v_expected_root IS NULL
    OR v_actual<>$4 OR octet_length($5)>3145728
    OR $7!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR encode(extensions.digest($5,'sha256'),'hex')<>$7
    OR $6 IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_root
    OR $5<>convert_to(regexp_replace($6::text, ', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='manifest_hash_mismatch'; END IF;
  IF v_manifest.manifest_kind='evaluation_input' AND (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='attempt_roster')<>252
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT row.payload_json->>0)
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='attempt_roster')<>252
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='backtest_rows')
      <>coalesce((SELECT (pair->>1)::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_manifest.header_json) pair
        WHERE pair->>0='backtestCount'),-1)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='live_rows')
      <>coalesce((SELECT (pair->>1)::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_manifest.header_json) pair
        WHERE pair->>0='liveCount'),-1)
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT row.payload_json->>0)
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='backtest_rows')
      <>(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='backtest_rows')
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT row.payload_json->>0)
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='live_rows')
      <>(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='live_rows')
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
      WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='conservation')
      <>(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key IN ('backtest_rows','live_rows'))
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 conservation
      WHERE conservation.manifest_id=$3 AND conservation.section_key='conservation'
        AND (
          (conservation.payload_json->>2)::integer
            <>(conservation.payload_json->>3)::integer+(conservation.payload_json->>4)::integer
          OR (conservation.payload_json->>6)::boolean
            IS DISTINCT FROM ((conservation.payload_json->>3)::integer>=10)
        )
    )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.opportunity_manifests_v3 m SET status='complete',row_count=$4,root_canonical=$5,
    root_json=$6,manifest_hash=$7,terminal_at=v_now
  WHERE m.manifest_id=$3 AND m.status='building';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 SET status='succeeded',output_manifest_id=$3,
    output_kind='manifest_reference',output_hash=$7,terminal_at=v_now,
    owner_token_hash=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,heartbeat_at=NULL
  WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=$1;
  SELECT m.manifest_kind,(p.payload_json->5->>0)::integer INTO v_kind,v_ordinal
  FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 m
  JOIN public.opportunity_job_payloads_v3 p ON p.job_id=$1
  WHERE m.manifest_id=$3;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs(run_id,manifest_id,input_role,ordinal)
  VALUES(v_job.run_id,$3,v_kind,v_ordinal)
  ON CONFLICT(run_id,input_role,ordinal) DO NOTHING;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs
    WHERE run_id=v_job.run_id AND manifest_id=$3 AND input_role=v_kind AND ordinal=v_ordinal
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
  IF v_kind='link_audit_sample' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_link_audit_samples(
      sample_manifest_id,sample_id,run_id,claim_id,mention_id,connector,link_mode,
      outcome_family,mention_ordinal,selection_ordinal,selection_hash,evidence_ref,
      review_context,review_mention_start_offset,review_mention_end_offset,
      normalized_token,engine_outcome,engine_reason,engine_canonical_symbol,
      review_evidence_hash,recorded_at
    )
    SELECT
      $3,row.payload_json->>0,(row.payload_json->>4)::uuid,
      (row.payload_json->>5)::uuid,mention.mention_id,row.payload_json->>1,
      (row.payload_json->>2)::public.opportunity_link_mode_v3,
      (row.payload_json->>3)::public.opportunity_link_outcome_family_v3,
      (row.payload_json->>6)::integer,row.row_ordinal::integer,row.payload_json->>7,
      row.payload_json->8->>1,row.payload_json->8->>2,
      (row.payload_json->8->>3)::integer,(row.payload_json->8->>4)::integer,
      row.payload_json->8->>5,(row.payload_json->8->>7)::public.opportunity_mention_outcome_v3,
      (row.payload_json->8->>8)::public.opportunity_mention_reason_v3,
      row.payload_json->8->>9,row.payload_json->>9,v_now
    FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
    JOIN public.opportunity_source_claims claim
      ON claim.claim_id=(row.payload_json->>5)::uuid
      AND claim.run_id=(row.payload_json->>4)::uuid
    JOIN public.opportunity_source_mentions mention
      ON mention.run_id=claim.run_id AND mention.revision_id=claim.revision_id
      AND mention.claim_ordinal=claim.claim_ordinal
      AND mention.mention_ordinal=(row.payload_json->>6)::integer
    WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='samples';
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_link_audit_samples sample
      WHERE sample.sample_manifest_id=$3) <> (
        SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=$3 AND row.section_key='samples'
      )
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF v_kind='mover_price_reference' THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT v_run FROM public.opportunity_runs r
    WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT m.header_json INTO STRICT v_header FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 m
    WHERE m.manifest_id=$3;
    SELECT (pair->>1)::date INTO STRICT v_audited_session
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_header) pair WHERE pair->>0='auditedSession';
    SELECT pair->>1 INTO STRICT v_audited_hash
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_header) pair WHERE pair->>0='auditedSessionAuthorityHash';
    SELECT pair->>1 INTO STRICT v_previous_hash
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_header) pair WHERE pair->>0='previousSessionAuthorityHash';
    SELECT pair->>1 INTO STRICT v_plan_hash
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_header) pair WHERE pair->>0='recentSessionPlanHash';
    SELECT s.canonical_cutoff INTO STRICT v_close
    FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3 s
    WHERE s.session_id=v_audited_session
      AND s.taiwan_session_authority_hash=v_audited_hash;
    SELECT m.manifest_id,m.manifest_hash INTO STRICT v_source_dataset_id,v_source_dataset_hash
    FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs i
    JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 m ON m.manifest_id=i.manifest_id
    WHERE i.run_id=v_job.run_id AND i.input_role='source_dataset' AND i.ordinal=0
      AND m.status='complete';
    v_audit_name:=regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
      'opportunity-mover-audit-v3.3',v_audited_session,v_audited_hash,v_previous_hash,
      v_plan_hash,to_char(v_run.source_cutoff AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
      $7,v_source_dataset_hash
    )::text, ', ', ',', 'g');
    v_bytes:=substring(extensions.digest(
      decode(replace('0e7d59d4-cebe-5bb1-91b7-a737c0e709d8','-',''),'hex')
        ||convert_to(v_audit_name,'utf8'),'sha1') FROM 1 FOR 16);
    v_bytes:=set_byte(v_bytes,6,(get_byte(v_bytes,6)&15)|80);
    v_bytes:=set_byte(v_bytes,8,(get_byte(v_bytes,8)&63)|128);
    v_hex:=encode(v_bytes,'hex');
    v_audit_id:=(substr(v_hex,1,8)||'-'||substr(v_hex,9,4)||'-'||substr(v_hex,13,4)||'-'
      ||substr(v_hex,17,4)||'-'||substr(v_hex,21,12))::uuid;
    SELECT count(*)::integer,least(20,count(*))::integer
    INTO v_eligible_universe_count,v_mover_count
    FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 mr
    WHERE mr.manifest_id=$3 AND mr.section_key='included_rows';
    SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_later_mentioned_count
    FROM (
      SELECT ranked.symbol
      FROM (
        SELECT mr.payload_json->>0 AS symbol,
          row_number() OVER (
            ORDER BY (
              100*((mr.payload_json->>8)::double precision/(mr.payload_json->>9)::double precision-1)
            ) DESC,
            (mr.payload_json->>10)::double precision DESC,
            mr.payload_json->>0
          ) AS mover_rank
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 mr
        WHERE mr.manifest_id=$3 AND mr.section_key='included_rows'
      ) ranked
      WHERE ranked.mover_rank<=20
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions sm
          JOIN public.source_document_revisions_v3 sr ON sr.revision_id=sm.revision_id
          WHERE sm.run_id=v_run.upstream_run_id
            AND sm.symbol=ranked.symbol
            AND sm.outcome IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim')
            AND sr.published_at>v_close
            AND sr.collected_at>v_close
            AND sr.published_at<=least(v_run.source_cutoff,v_close+interval '72 hours')
            AND sr.collected_at<=least(v_run.source_cutoff,v_close+interval '72 hours')
        )
    ) later_mentions;
    v_recall_pct:=CASE
      WHEN v_run.source_cutoff<v_close+interval '72 hours' OR v_mover_count=0 THEN NULL
      ELSE 100.0*v_later_mentioned_count/v_mover_count
    END;
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_mover_audits_v3(
      audit_id,session_id,audited_session_authority_hash,previous_session_authority_hash,
      recent_session_plan_hash,source_cutoff,audit_window_closes_at,source_collection_cutoff,
      status,mover_count,eligible_universe_count,recall_pct,price_manifest_id,
      source_dataset_manifest_id,upstream_source_run_id,recorded_at
    ) VALUES(
      v_audit_id,v_audited_session,v_audited_hash,v_previous_hash,v_plan_hash,v_run.source_cutoff,
      v_close+interval '72 hours',least(v_run.source_cutoff,v_close+interval '72 hours'),
      CASE WHEN v_run.source_cutoff<v_close+interval '72 hours'
        THEN 'pending'::public.opportunity_mover_audit_status_v3
        ELSE 'matured'::public.opportunity_mover_audit_status_v3 END,
      v_mover_count,v_eligible_universe_count,v_recall_pct,
      $3,v_source_dataset_id,v_run.upstream_run_id,v_now
    ) ON CONFLICT(audit_id) DO NOTHING;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_mover_audits_v3 a
      WHERE a.audit_id=v_audit_id AND a.price_manifest_id=$3
        AND a.source_dataset_manifest_id=v_source_dataset_id
        AND a.audited_session_authority_hash=v_audited_hash
        AND a.previous_session_authority_hash=v_previous_hash
        AND a.recent_session_plan_hash=v_plan_hash
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.opportunity_mover_audit_symbols_v3(
      audit_id,rank,stock_id,symbol,one_session_return_pct,turnover_twd,
      end_price_ref,prior_price_ref,corporate_action_version,later_mentioned,recorded_at
    )
    SELECT v_audit_id,ranked.mover_rank,ranked.stock_id,ranked.symbol,
      ranked.one_session_return_pct,ranked.turnover_twd,
      ranked.end_price_ref,ranked.prior_price_ref,ranked.corporate_action_version,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions sm
        JOIN public.source_document_revisions_v3 sr ON sr.revision_id=sm.revision_id
        WHERE sm.run_id=v_run.upstream_run_id
          AND sm.symbol=ranked.symbol
          AND sm.outcome IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim')
          AND sr.published_at>v_close
          AND sr.collected_at>v_close
          AND sr.published_at<=least(v_run.source_cutoff,v_close+interval '72 hours')
          AND sr.collected_at<=least(v_run.source_cutoff,v_close+interval '72 hours')
      ),
      v_now
    FROM (
      SELECT
        mr.payload_json->>0 AS symbol,
        (mr.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,
        100*((mr.payload_json->>8)::double precision/(mr.payload_json->>9)::double precision-1)
          AS one_session_return_pct,
        (mr.payload_json->>10)::double precision AS turnover_twd,
        mr.payload_json->>13 AS end_price_ref,
        mr.payload_json->>14 AS prior_price_ref,
        mr.payload_json->>17 AS corporate_action_version,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY (
            100*((mr.payload_json->>8)::double precision/(mr.payload_json->>9)::double precision-1)
          ) DESC,
          (mr.payload_json->>10)::double precision DESC,
          mr.payload_json->>0
        )::integer AS mover_rank
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 mr
      WHERE mr.manifest_id=$3 AND mr.section_key='included_rows'
    ) ranked
    WHERE ranked.mover_rank<=20
    ON CONFLICT(audit_id,rank) DO NOTHING;
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_mover_audit_symbols_v3 s
        WHERE s.audit_id=v_audit_id)<>v_mover_count
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.opportunity_mover_audit_symbols_v3 s
        WHERE s.audit_id=v_audit_id
          AND s.rank NOT BETWEEN 1 AND v_mover_count
      )
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure'; END IF;
    IF v_ordinal=0 THEN
      UPDATE public.opportunity_runs SET selected_mover_audit_id=v_audit_id
      WHERE run_id=v_job.run_id AND selected_mover_audit_id IS NULL;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
      END IF;
    ELSIF v_run.selected_mover_audit_id IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.enqueue_next_opportunity_job_v3_internal(v_job.run_id,$1);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT 'complete'::public.opportunity_manifest_status_v3,$7,$4,v_now;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_candidate_shadow_manifest_immutable_v4()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.session_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.session_date
    OR NEW.policy_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.policy_version
    OR NEW.ruleset_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ruleset_version
    OR NEW.model_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.model_version
    OR NEW.cohort_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cohort_key
    OR NEW.candidate_symbols IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_symbols
    OR NEW.input_versions IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.input_versions
    OR NEW.canonical_input_hashes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.canonical_input_hashes
    OR NEW.manifest_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.manifest_hash
    OR NEW.frozen_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.frozen_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_shadow_manifest_immutable_v4' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_candidate_shadow_replay_payload_immutable_v5()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.manifest_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.manifest_id
    OR NEW.final_publication_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.final_publication_id
    OR NEW.session_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.session_date
    OR NEW.ruleset_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ruleset_version
    OR NEW.model_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.model_version
    OR NEW.publication_phase IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_phase
    OR NEW.session_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.session_kind
    OR NEW.manifest_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.manifest_hash
    OR NEW.final_publication_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.final_publication_hash
    OR NEW.payload IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload
    OR NEW.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload_hash
    OR NEW.verifier_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verifier_version
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_shadow_replay_payload_immutable_v5' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.verified_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_shadow_replay_payload_already_verified_v5' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
