CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_opportunity_candidate_anchor_v3()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.candidate_origin='direct_candidate' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.opportunity_source_claims c
    JOIN public.opportunity_source_mentions m
      ON m.run_id=c.run_id AND m.revision_id=c.revision_id AND m.claim_ordinal=c.claim_ordinal
    WHERE c.claim_id=NEW.anchor_claim_id
      AND c.run_id=(
        SELECT r.upstream_run_id FROM public.opportunity_runs r WHERE r.run_id=NEW.run_id
      )
      AND m.stock_id=NEW.stock_id
      AND m.symbol=NEW.symbol
      AND m.outcome IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enrich_legacy_retained_candidate_authority_v3_19_11_internal(p_prior_run uuid, p_prior_ledger jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_enriched jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_prior_ledger)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_prior_ledger)>60 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_retention_prior_ledger_bound';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(p_prior_ledger)=0 THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb;END IF;
  IF p_prior_run IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_retention_authority_run_missing';END IF;

  IF EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_prior_ledger) candidate(value)
    WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.legacy_candidate_discovery_ledger_v3_11 ledger
      WHERE ledger.source_run_id=p_prior_run
        AND ledger.stock_id::text=candidate.value->>'stockId')=0
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_retention_authority_missing';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_prior_ledger) candidate(value)
    WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.legacy_candidate_discovery_ledger_v3_11 ledger
      WHERE ledger.source_run_id=p_prior_run
        AND ledger.stock_id::text=candidate.value->>'stockId')<>1
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_retention_authority_cardinality';END IF;

  IF EXISTS(
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_prior_ledger) candidate(value)
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ledger.* FROM public.legacy_candidate_discovery_ledger_v3_11 ledger
      WHERE ledger.source_run_id=p_prior_run
        AND ledger.stock_id::text=candidate.value->>'stockId'
      ORDER BY ledger.recorded_at DESC,ledger.discovery_id DESC LIMIT 1
    ) authority ON true
    WHERE (nullif(candidate.value->>'sourceKey','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'sourceKey','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.source_key::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'revisionId','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'revisionId','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.document_revision_id::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'claimId','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'claimId','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.claim_id::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'mentionId','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'mentionId','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.mention_id::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'stockId','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'stockId','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.stock_id::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'symbol','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'symbol','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.symbol)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'materialEvidenceHash','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'materialEvidenceHash','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.material_evidence_hash)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'disposition','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'disposition','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.disposition::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'reason','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'reason','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.reason::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'researchDisposition','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'researchDisposition','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.research_disposition::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'researchReason','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'researchReason','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.research_reason::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'seedMembership','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'seedMembership','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.seed_membership::text)
      OR (nullif(candidate.value->>'legacySeedSetHash','') IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(candidate.value->>'legacySeedSetHash','') IS DISTINCT FROM authority.legacy_seed_set_hash)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_retention_authority_conflict';END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    candidate.value||jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'sourceKey',authority.source_key::text,
      'revisionId',authority.document_revision_id,
      'claimId',authority.claim_id,
      'mentionId',authority.mention_id,
      'stockId',authority.stock_id,
      'symbol',authority.symbol,
      'disposition',authority.disposition::text,
      'reason',authority.reason::text,
      'researchDisposition',authority.research_disposition::text,
      'researchReason',authority.research_reason::text,
      'seedMembership',authority.seed_membership::text,
      'legacySeedSetHash',authority.legacy_seed_set_hash,
      'materialEvidenceHash',authority.material_evidence_hash
    )) ORDER BY candidate.ordinality),'[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_enriched
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_prior_ledger) WITH ORDINALITY candidate(value,ordinality)
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ledger.* FROM public.legacy_candidate_discovery_ledger_v3_11 ledger
    WHERE ledger.source_run_id=p_prior_run
      AND ledger.stock_id::text=candidate.value->>'stockId'
    ORDER BY ledger.recorded_at DESC,ledger.discovery_id DESC LIMIT 1
  ) authority ON true;
  RETURN v_enriched;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fail_candidate_financial_acquisition_job_v6(p_job_id uuid, p_owner text, p_error text, p_collected_at timestamp with time zone, p_mops_failed boolean, p_finmind_failed boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(status text, terminal_reason financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_job public.candidate_financial_acquisition_jobs_v4%ROWTYPE;
  v_reason public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4;
  v_mops_failures integer;
  v_finmind_failures integer;
  v_terminal boolean;
BEGIN
  IF char_length(COALESCE(p_error,'')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500
    OR p_collected_at IS NULL
    OR p_collected_at>clock_timestamp()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_candidate_financial_failure'; END IF;

  SELECT job.* INTO v_job
  FROM public.candidate_financial_acquisition_jobs_v4 AS job
  WHERE job.job_id=p_job_id
    AND job.status='running'
    AND job.lease_owner=p_owner
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.lease_expires_at<clock_timestamp()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_financial_job_lease_lost'; END IF;

  v_reason:=CASE
    WHEN p_error~*'write_failed|completion_failed' THEN 'write_failed'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'timeout' THEN 'timeout'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'security|captcha|forbidden|waf' THEN 'security_blocked'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'html' THEN 'html_rejected'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'schema|empty' THEN 'schema_unrecognized'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'404|not_found' THEN 'http_not_found'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'429|rate' THEN 'http_rate_limited'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    WHEN p_error~*'5[0-9]{2}|server' THEN 'http_server_error'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
    ELSE 'network_error'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
  END;
  v_mops_failures:=CASE WHEN p_mops_failed
    THEN LEAST(v_job.mops_consecutive_failures+1,5)
    ELSE v_job.mops_consecutive_failures END;
  v_finmind_failures:=CASE WHEN p_finmind_failed
    THEN LEAST(v_job.finmind_consecutive_failures+1,5)
    ELSE v_job.finmind_consecutive_failures END;
  v_terminal:=v_mops_failures>=5 OR v_finmind_failures>=5;

  UPDATE public.candidate_financial_acquisition_jobs_v4 AS job SET
    status=CASE WHEN v_terminal THEN 'terminal' ELSE 'queued' END,
    attempts=LEAST(job.attempts+1,20),
    consecutive_failures=v_mops_failures,
    mops_attempts=LEAST(job.mops_attempts+CASE WHEN p_mops_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,20),
    mops_consecutive_failures=v_mops_failures,
    finmind_attempts=LEAST(job.finmind_attempts+CASE WHEN p_finmind_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,20),
    finmind_consecutive_failures=v_finmind_failures,
    lease_owner=NULL,
    lease_expires_at=NULL,
    terminal_reason=CASE WHEN v_terminal THEN v_reason ELSE NULL END,
    terminal_detail=p_error,
    collected_at=CASE WHEN v_terminal THEN p_collected_at ELSE job.collected_at END,
    next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN v_terminal THEN NULL ELSE p_collected_at + make_interval(
      hours => (2 ^ GREATEST(v_mops_failures,v_finmind_failures,1))::integer
    ) END,
    updated_at=p_collected_at
  WHERE job.job_id=p_job_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    CASE WHEN v_terminal THEN 'terminal' ELSE 'queued' END::text,
    v_reason;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fail_opportunity_job_v3(job_id uuid, owner_token text, failure_code opportunity_failure_code_v3)
 RETURNS TABLE(status opportunity_job_status_v3)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_attempt integer; v_run_id uuid; v_status public.opportunity_job_status_v3;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 SET
    status=CASE WHEN $3 IN ('provider_unavailable','v3_service_role_unavailable') AND attempt < 5
      THEN 'retryable'::public.opportunity_job_status_v3 ELSE 'failed'::public.opportunity_job_status_v3 END,
    failure_code=$3, terminal_at=CASE WHEN attempt >= 5 OR $3 NOT IN ('provider_unavailable','v3_service_role_unavailable') THEN clock_timestamp() END,
    owner_token_hash=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, heartbeat_at=NULL
  WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=$1 AND status='leased'
    AND owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to($2,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    AND lease_expires_at>=clock_timestamp()
  RETURNING attempt,run_id,status INTO v_attempt,v_run_id,v_status;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409', MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure'; END IF;
  IF v_status='failed' THEN
    UPDATE public.opportunity_runs
    SET status='failed',failure_code=$3,terminal_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE run_id=v_run_id AND status IN ('preparing','running');
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT j.status FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j WHERE j.job_id=$1;
END
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_candidate_financial_document_validation_v8(p_receipt_id uuid, p_caller_principal uuid, p_completed_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(validation_status text, validated_fact_count integer, rejected_fact_count integer, pending_fact_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_receipt public.candidate_financial_document_receipts_v6%ROWTYPE;
  v_total integer; v_validated integer; v_rejected integer; v_pending integer; v_status text; v_receipt_status text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal(p_caller_principal,'opportunity_runner',clock_timestamp())
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'principal_role_unavailable'; END IF;
  IF p_completed_at IS NULL OR p_completed_at>clock_timestamp()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_financial_validation_time_invalid'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_receipt FROM public.candidate_financial_document_receipts_v6
    WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_receipt.parser_status<>'complete'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_financial_validation_receipt_unavailable'; END IF;
  -- Mutable fact columns and unbound V1 receipts are predecessor state. Only
  -- the latest principal-bound V2 transition for this exact document counts.
  SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE latest.effective_validation->>'validation_status'='validated'
      AND (latest.effective_validation->>'schema_valid')::boolean IS TRUE
      AND (latest.effective_validation->>'unit_valid')::boolean IS TRUE
      AND (latest.effective_validation->>'point_in_time_valid')::boolean IS TRUE
      AND (latest.effective_validation->>'consistency_valid')::boolean IS TRUE),
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE latest.effective_validation->>'validation_status' IN ('rejected','conflict','stale'))
  INTO v_total,v_validated,v_rejected
  FROM public.candidate_financial_document_fact_links_v8 link
  JOIN public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
    ON fact.fact_id=link.fact_id AND fact.recorded_at=link.fact_recorded_at
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT validation_receipt.effective_validation
    FROM public.official_financial_validation_receipts validation_receipt
    WHERE validation_receipt.fact_id=fact.fact_id
      AND validation_receipt.source_sha256=v_receipt.document_sha256
      AND validation_receipt.validator_version='official-financial-v2'
      AND validation_receipt.validator_principal IS NOT NULL
      AND validation_receipt.validated_at<=p_completed_at
    ORDER BY validation_receipt.validated_at DESC,validation_receipt.receipt_sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest ON true
  WHERE link.receipt_id=p_receipt_id;
  v_pending:=v_total-v_validated-v_rejected;
  IF v_total=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate_financial_validation_fact_set_empty'; END IF;
  -- Terminal validation is immutable. A repeated scheduler call is an
  -- idempotent observation, not a new attempt and cannot resurrect a receipt.
  IF v_receipt.financial_validation_status IN ('validated','rejected') THEN
    validation_status:=v_receipt.financial_validation_status;
    validated_fact_count:=v_validated;
    rejected_fact_count:=CASE WHEN v_receipt.financial_validation_status='rejected'
      THEN GREATEST(v_rejected,v_total-v_validated) ELSE v_rejected END;
    pending_fact_count:=CASE WHEN v_receipt.financial_validation_status='validated' THEN v_pending ELSE 0 END;
    RETURN NEXT; RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF v_pending>0 AND v_receipt.financial_validation_attempts>=19 THEN
    UPDATE public.candidate_financial_document_receipts_v6 SET
      financial_validation_status='rejected',receipt_status='partial',
      financial_validation_attempts=financial_validation_attempts+1,
      financial_validation_next_attempt_at=NULL,
      financial_validation_terminal_reason='validation_retry_exhausted',
      missing_requirements=CASE WHEN missing_requirements ? 'official_fact_validation_retry_exhausted'
        THEN missing_requirements ELSE missing_requirements||jsonb_build_array('official_fact_validation_retry_exhausted') END
    WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt_id;
    IF v_receipt.acquisition_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.candidate_financial_acquisition_jobs_v4 SET status='terminal',
        terminal_reason='schema_unrecognized'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4,
        terminal_detail='official_fact_validation_retry_exhausted',lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,
        collected_at=p_completed_at,next_attempt_at=NULL,updated_at=p_completed_at
      WHERE job_id=v_receipt.acquisition_job_id AND status IN ('queued','running');
    END IF;
    validation_status:='rejected'; validated_fact_count:=v_validated;
    rejected_fact_count:=v_rejected+v_pending; pending_fact_count:=0; RETURN NEXT; RETURN;
  ELSIF v_pending>0 THEN
    UPDATE public.candidate_financial_document_receipts_v6 SET
      financial_validation_attempts=financial_validation_attempts+1,
      financial_validation_next_attempt_at=p_completed_at+LEAST(interval '6 hours',
        interval '5 minutes' * power(2,LEAST(financial_validation_attempts,6)))
    WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt_id;
    validation_status:='pending'; validated_fact_count:=v_validated;
    rejected_fact_count:=v_rejected; pending_fact_count:=v_pending; RETURN NEXT; RETURN;
  END IF;
  v_status:=CASE WHEN v_rejected=0 THEN 'validated' ELSE 'rejected' END;
  v_receipt_status:=CASE WHEN v_status='validated'
    AND jsonb_array_length(v_receipt.missing_requirements)=0
    AND jsonb_array_length(v_receipt.rejection_reasons)=0 THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'partial' END;
  UPDATE public.candidate_financial_document_receipts_v6 SET
    financial_validation_status=v_status,
    financial_validation_next_attempt_at=NULL,
    financial_validation_terminal_reason=CASE WHEN v_status='validated' THEN NULL ELSE 'official_fact_validation_rejected' END,
    receipt_status=v_receipt_status,
    missing_requirements=CASE WHEN v_status='rejected' AND NOT (missing_requirements ? 'official_fact_validation_rejected')
      THEN missing_requirements||jsonb_build_array('official_fact_validation_rejected') ELSE missing_requirements END
  WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt_id;
  IF v_receipt.acquisition_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.candidate_financial_acquisition_jobs_v4 SET status='terminal',
      terminal_reason=CASE WHEN v_receipt_status='accepted'
        THEN 'complete'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4
        ELSE 'schema_unrecognized'::public.financial_acquisition_terminal_reason_v4 END,
      terminal_detail=CASE WHEN v_receipt_status='accepted' THEN NULL
        WHEN v_status='validated' THEN 'document_requirements_incomplete'
        ELSE 'official_fact_validation_rejected' END,
      lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,collected_at=p_completed_at,
      next_attempt_at=NULL,updated_at=p_completed_at
    WHERE job_id=v_receipt.acquisition_job_id AND status IN ('queued','running');
  END IF;
  validation_status:=v_status; validated_fact_count:=v_validated;
  rejected_fact_count:=v_rejected; pending_fact_count:=v_pending; RETURN NEXT;
END $function$

functions.name: finalize_opportunity_run_v3(uuid,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_opportunity_run_v3(job_id uuid, owner_token text)
 RETURNS TABLE(run_id uuid, status opportunity_run_status_v3, failure_code opportunity_failure_code_v3, terminal_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_job public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3%ROWTYPE; v_terminal timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_mode public.opportunity_mode_v3;
  v_failure public.opportunity_failure_code_v3;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j
  WHERE j.job_id=$1 AND j.stage='finalize' AND j.status='leased'
    AND j.lease_expires_at >= v_terminal
    AND j.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to($2,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j WHERE j.run_id=v_job.run_id AND j.job_id<>v_job.job_id AND j.status NOT IN ('succeeded','cancelled')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409', MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
    END IF;
    SELECT r.mode INTO STRICT v_mode FROM public.opportunity_runs r
    WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.status='running' FOR UPDATE;
    IF v_mode='source_scan' AND (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
      WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='source_parse_batch')
      <>(SELECT coalesce(sum(a.selected_document_count),0)
        FROM public.opportunity_source_connector_accounting a WHERE a.run_id=v_job.run_id)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
      WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='source_connector_summary')<>11
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_source_connector_accounting a
      WHERE a.run_id=v_job.run_id)<>11
    OR (SELECT coalesce(sum((r.output_counts).connector_accounting_count),0)
      FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id)<>11
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
    ELSIF v_mode='enrich_rank' AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES
        ('market_context_snapshot'::public.opportunity_job_output_kind_v3),
        ('portfolio_allocation_batch'::public.opportunity_job_output_kind_v3),
        ('projection_bundle'::public.opportunity_job_output_kind_v3)
      ) required(kind)
      WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
        WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind=required.kind)<>1
    )
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
      WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='shallow_candidate_batch')>6
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
      WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch')>4
    OR (SELECT coalesce(sum((r.output_counts).public_projection_count),0)
      FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id)<>1
    OR (SELECT coalesce(sum((r.output_counts).candidate_count),0)
      FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
      WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='deep_candidate_batch')
      > (SELECT coalesce(sum((r.output_counts).candidate_count),0)
        FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
        WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='shallow_candidate_batch')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
    ELSIF v_mode='label_outcomes' AND (
    SELECT coalesce(sum((r.output_counts).outcome_count),0)
      <>(SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 mr
        JOIN public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs i ON i.manifest_id=mr.manifest_id
        WHERE i.run_id=v_job.run_id AND i.input_role='outcome_input'
          AND mr.section_key='input_rows')
    FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
    WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='outcome_batch'
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
    ELSIF v_mode='shadow_evaluate' AND (
    SELECT count(*)<>1 FROM public.opportunity_job_results_v3 r
    WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id AND r.output_kind='evaluation_bundle'
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='conservation_failure';
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN SQLSTATE 'PT409' OR no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN
      v_failure := CASE
        WHEN SQLERRM='conservation_failure' THEN 'conservation_failure'::public.opportunity_failure_code_v3
        ELSE 'data_integrity_failure'::public.opportunity_failure_code_v3
      END;
      v_terminal := clock_timestamp();
      UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3
      SET status='failed',failure_code=v_failure,terminal_at=v_terminal,
        owner_token_hash=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,heartbeat_at=NULL
      WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=v_job.job_id;
      UPDATE public.opportunity_runs
      SET status='failed',failure_code=v_failure,terminal_at=v_terminal
      WHERE opportunity_runs.run_id=v_job.run_id AND status='running';
      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT r.run_id,r.status,r.failure_code,r.terminal_at
      FROM public.opportunity_runs r WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id;
      RETURN;
  END;
  UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 SET status='succeeded',terminal_at=v_terminal,
    owner_token_hash=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,heartbeat_at=NULL WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=v_job.job_id;
  UPDATE public.opportunity_runs SET status='success', terminal_at=v_terminal
    WHERE opportunity_runs.run_id=v_job.run_id AND opportunity_runs.status='running';
  RETURN QUERY SELECT r.run_id,r.status,r.failure_code,r.terminal_at FROM public.opportunity_runs r WHERE r.run_id=v_job.run_id;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_research_deep_job_v2(p_job_id uuid, p_owner text, p_attempt integer, p_success boolean, p_receipt_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_job public.research_deep_jobs_v1;
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(2409, 6002);
  SELECT * INTO v_job FROM public.research_deep_jobs_v1 WHERE job_id=p_job_id AND research_scope='formal_v1' FOR UPDATE;
  IF FOUND AND p_success AND v_job.status='completed' AND v_job.receipt_id=p_receipt_id
    AND v_job.attempts=p_attempt AND v_job.completion_owner=p_owner THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.status <> 'running' OR v_job.lease_owner IS DISTINCT FROM p_owner
    OR v_job.attempts<>p_attempt OR v_job.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'research_deep_job_lease_lost';
  END IF;
  IF p_success THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'research_deep_publication_receipt_required'; END IF;
  -- Release the publication lease with the same deep attempt; a reported
  -- failure must not strand the next attempt behind an active old lease.
  UPDATE public.candidate_dossier_outbox_v5 SET
    status=CASE WHEN v_job.attempts<3 THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    lease_owner=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, next_attempt_at=NULL,
    last_error=left(coalesce(p_reason,'research_failed'),500), updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE publication_kind='deep' AND deep_job_id=p_job_id AND deep_attempt=p_attempt
      AND status='running';
  UPDATE public.research_deep_jobs_v1 SET
    status=CASE WHEN attempts < 3 THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,
    receipt_id=NULL,
    terminal_reason=left(coalesce(p_reason,'research_failed'),500),
    finished_at=CASE WHEN attempts >= 3 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END
  WHERE research_deep_jobs_v1.job_id=p_job_id;
  PERFORM public.finish_research_model_v1(r.reservation_id,p_owner,
    CASE WHEN p_success THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(p_receipt_id::text,p_reason),'UTF8')),'hex'))
  FROM public.research_model_reservations_v1 r WHERE r.role='company_research'
    AND r.work_key='deep:'||p_job_id||':'||p_attempt::text
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.research_model_completions_v1 c WHERE c.reservation_id=r.reservation_id);
  RETURN TRUE;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.freeze_legacy_source_authorities_v3_13()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE conflict_count integer;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.opportunity_authority_selected_stream_count_v3_internal('discovery_identity',NEW.source_cutoff);
  WITH heads AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON(authority.source_identity_id) authority.*
    FROM public.source_identity_authorities_v3 authority
    WHERE authority.recorded_at<=NEW.source_cutoff AND authority.approved_at<=NEW.source_cutoff
      AND authority.valid_from<=NEW.source_cutoff
    ORDER BY authority.source_identity_id,authority.recorded_at DESC,authority.authority_id
  ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT profile.profile_id,source.source_key AS requested_source_key,heads.authority_id
    FROM public.legacy_approved_source_profiles_v3_13 profile
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('threads'::public.source_key_v3),('podcast'::public.source_key_v3),
      ('youtube'::public.source_key_v3),('telegram'::public.source_key_v3),('investanchors'::public.source_key_v3)) source(source_key)
    JOIN heads ON heads.source_key=source.source_key
      AND heads.distribution_identity=source.source_key::text||':'||profile.profile_id
    WHERE heads.status='active' AND (heads.valid_to IS NULL OR NEW.source_cutoff<heads.valid_to)
  ) SELECT count(*) INTO conflict_count FROM (
    SELECT profile_id,requested_source_key FROM eligible
    GROUP BY profile_id,requested_source_key HAVING count(*)<>1
  ) conflicts;
  IF conflict_count>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authority_revision_conflict';END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.legacy_frozen_source_authorities_v3_13(source_run_id,profile_id,source_key,
    distribution_identity,source_identity_id,source_identity_authority_id,authority_cutoff)
  SELECT NEW.run_id,profile.profile_id,source.source_key,heads.distribution_identity,
    heads.source_identity_id,heads.authority_id,NEW.source_cutoff
  FROM public.legacy_approved_source_profiles_v3_13 profile
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES('threads'::public.source_key_v3),('podcast'::public.source_key_v3),
    ('youtube'::public.source_key_v3)) source(source_key)
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT authority.* FROM public.source_identity_authorities_v3 authority
    WHERE authority.source_key=source.source_key
      AND authority.distribution_identity=source.source_key::text||':'||profile.profile_id
      AND authority.recorded_at<=NEW.source_cutoff AND authority.approved_at<=NEW.source_cutoff
      AND authority.valid_from<=NEW.source_cutoff
    ORDER BY authority.recorded_at DESC,authority.authority_id LIMIT 1
  ) heads ON heads.status='active' AND (heads.valid_to IS NULL OR NEW.source_cutoff<heads.valid_to);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.heartbeat_opportunity_job_v3(job_id uuid, owner_token text)
 RETURNS TABLE(lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_heartbeat_at timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_expires timestamptz;
BEGIN
  SELECT LEAST(
    v_heartbeat_at + interval '90 seconds',
    j.attempt_started_at + interval '15 minutes'
  ) INTO v_expires
  FROM public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3 j
  WHERE j.job_id=$1 AND j.status='leased'
    AND j.lease_expires_at >= v_heartbeat_at
    AND j.owner_token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to($2,'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.opportunity_run_jobs_v3
  SET heartbeat_at=v_heartbeat_at,lease_expires_at=v_expires
  WHERE opportunity_run_jobs_v3.job_id=$1;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_expires;
END
$function$

functions.name: legacy_relative_valuation_authority_v3_13(text,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.legacy_relative_valuation_authority_v3_13(p_symbol text, p_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_stock uuid;v_plane jsonb;v_current jsonb;v_history jsonb;v_peers jsonb;
  v_history_count integer;v_peer_count integer;v_history_median numeric;v_peer_median numeric;
  v_current_multiple numeric;v_current_root text;v_history_root text;v_sector_root text;v_evidence_root text;
BEGIN
  SELECT selected.stock_id INTO STRICT v_stock
  FROM public.resolve_legacy_instrument_symbol_authority_v3_13(p_symbol,p_source_cutoff) selected
  WHERE selected.instrument_type='common_stock' AND selected.listing_status='active'
    AND (selected.valid_to IS NULL OR p_source_cutoff<selected.valid_to);
  v_plane:=public.read_legacy_candidate_fact_plane_v3_11(p_source_cutoff,
    jsonb_build_object('candidates',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'stockId',v_stock::text,'symbol',p_symbol,'deepSelected',true))));
  WITH parsed AS MATERIALIZED(
    SELECT value->>0 symbol,value->>1 sector,value->>2 exchange,value->>3 session_date,
      (value->>5)::numeric reported_pe,value->>10 source_ref,value->>11 stock_id,
      value->>12 authority_hash,value->>18 authority_status
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_plane->'reportedPeRows','[]'::jsonb)) item(value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(value->5)='number' AND (value->>5)::numeric>0 AND (value->>5)::numeric<=200
      AND jsonb_typeof(value->10)='string' AND coalesce(value->>18,'')<>'authority_conflict'
      AND ((value->>2='TWSE' AND value->>10
          ~ '^(twse-openapi:BWIBBU_ALL|twse-rwd:BWIBBU_d):[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{4}$')
        OR (value->>2='TPEX' AND value->>10
          ~ '^(tpex-openapi:peratio|tpex-rwd:peratio):[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{4}$'))
  ), current_row AS MATERIALIZED(
    SELECT * FROM parsed WHERE stock_id=v_stock::text
      AND ((exchange='TWSE' AND source_ref ~ '^twse-openapi:BWIBBU_ALL:')
        OR (exchange='TPEX' AND source_ref ~ '^tpex-openapi:peratio:'))
    ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1
  ), history_rows AS MATERIALIZED(
    SELECT * FROM parsed WHERE stock_id=v_stock::text ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 252
  ), peer_rows AS MATERIALIZED(
    SELECT peer.* FROM parsed peer CROSS JOIN current_row current
    WHERE peer.stock_id<>v_stock::text AND peer.exchange=current.exchange
      AND peer.sector=current.sector AND peer.session_date=current.session_date
      AND ((peer.exchange='TWSE' AND peer.source_ref ~ '^twse-openapi:BWIBBU_ALL:')
        OR (peer.exchange='TPEX' AND peer.source_ref ~ '^tpex-openapi:peratio:'))
    ORDER BY peer.stock_id,peer.source_ref
  )
  SELECT (SELECT jsonb_build_array(stock_id,exchange,session_date,reported_pe,authority_hash,source_ref)
      FROM current_row),
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(stock_id,exchange,session_date,reported_pe,
      authority_hash,source_ref) ORDER BY session_date),'[]'::jsonb) FROM history_rows),
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(stock_id,exchange,session_date,reported_pe,
      authority_hash,source_ref) ORDER BY stock_id,source_ref),'[]'::jsonb) FROM peer_rows),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM history_rows),(SELECT count(*) FROM peer_rows),
    (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY reported_pe) FROM history_rows),
    (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY reported_pe) FROM peer_rows),
    (SELECT reported_pe FROM current_row)
  INTO v_current,v_history,v_peers,v_history_count,v_peer_count,v_history_median,v_peer_median,v_current_multiple;
  IF v_current IS NULL OR v_history_count<>252 OR v_peer_count<8
    OR v_history_median IS NULL OR v_peer_median IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  v_current_root:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(v_current),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  v_history_root:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(v_history),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  v_sector_root:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(v_peers),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  v_evidence_root:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(public.legacy_canonical_json_v3_13(jsonb_build_array(
    'official-relative-pe-evidence-v1',v_current,v_history,v_peers)),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('algorithm','official-relative-pe-evidence-v1',
    'currentMultiple',v_current_multiple,'referenceMultiple',least(v_history_median,v_peer_median),
    'historySessions',v_history_count,'sectorPeers',v_peer_count,'currentObservationRoot',v_current_root,
    'historyMembershipRoot',v_history_root,'sectorMembershipRoot',v_sector_root,'evidenceRoot',v_evidence_root);
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND OR TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_connector_retention_archive_candidates_v2(p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT run.id,run.finished_at
    FROM public.connector_runs run
    WHERE run.status IN ('success','skipped') AND run.finished_at<p_now-interval '90 days'
      AND NOT coalesce(run.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
      AND NOT coalesce(run.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
    ORDER BY run.finished_at,run.id LIMIT greatest(0,least(p_limit,1000))
  ), pins AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pin.relation_name,pin.row_key FROM public.retention_archive_active_pins_v1() pin
    WHERE pin.relation_name IN ('public.connector_runs','public.source_audits')
  ), audits AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT audit.connector_run_id,count(*) audit_count,
      bool_or(audit.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success'
        OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
        OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"security_event":true}'::jsonb) incident,
      bool_or(pin.row_key IS NOT NULL) pinned
    FROM public.source_audits audit JOIN candidates ON candidates.id=audit.connector_run_id
    LEFT JOIN pins pin ON pin.relation_name='public.source_audits' AND pin.row_key=audit.id::TEXT
    GROUP BY audit.connector_run_id
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'rootKind','connector_run','rootId',candidate.id,'observedAt',candidate.finished_at,
    'eligible',NOT coalesce(audits.incident,FALSE) AND NOT coalesce(audits.pinned,FALSE)
      AND run_pin.row_key IS NULL,
    'blockers',CASE WHEN coalesce(audits.incident,FALSE) THEN '[{"code":"incident"}]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
      || CASE WHEN coalesce(audits.pinned,FALSE) OR run_pin.row_key IS NOT NULL THEN '[{"code":"active_pin"}]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
    'rowCount',1+coalesce(audits.audit_count,0)
  ) ORDER BY candidate.finished_at,candidate.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM candidates candidate LEFT JOIN audits ON audits.connector_run_id=candidate.id
  LEFT JOIN pins run_pin ON run_pin.relation_name='public.connector_runs' AND run_pin.row_key=candidate.id::TEXT;
$function$

functions.name: list_retention_archive_candidates_v1(text,timestamp with time zone,integer)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_retention_archive_candidates_v1(p_root_kind text, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF p_limit<1 OR p_limit>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retention_candidate_limit_invalid'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.retention_archive_policies_v1 WHERE root_kind=p_root_kind AND enabled) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retention_policy_disabled_or_unknown';
  END IF;
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT id,finished_at observed_at FROM public.candidate_research_runs
      WHERE p_root_kind='candidate_research_run' AND status='success'
        AND finished_at<p_now-interval '90 days'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.candidate_research_run_items item
          WHERE item.run_id=candidate_research_runs.id AND item.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success'
        )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,finished_at FROM public.connector_runs
      WHERE p_root_kind='connector_run' AND status IN ('success','skipped')
        AND finished_at<p_now-interval '90 days'
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.source_audits audit
          WHERE audit.connector_run_id=connector_runs.id AND (
            audit.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success'
            OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
            OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
            OR coalesce(audit.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"security_event":true}'::jsonb
          )
        )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,attempted_at FROM public.source_run_ledger
      WHERE p_root_kind='source_run_ledger' AND terminal_reason IN ('successful_empty','duplicate_only')
        AND attempted_at<p_now-interval '30 days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,finished_at FROM public.worker_job_runs
      WHERE p_root_kind='worker_job_run' AND status='success'
        AND finished_at<p_now-interval '90 days'
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"security_event":true}'::jsonb
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,created_at FROM public.source_audits
      WHERE p_root_kind='source_audit' AND status='success'
        AND created_at<p_now-interval '30 days'
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"security_event":true}'::jsonb
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,created_at FROM public.worker_logs
      WHERE p_root_kind='worker_log'
        AND lower(level) NOT IN ('warn','warning','error','critical','security','audit')
        AND created_at<p_now-interval '30 days'
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,created_at FROM public.runtime_artifacts
      WHERE p_root_kind='runtime_artifact' AND created_at<p_now-interval '90 days'
        AND artifact_key !~* '(latest|release|recovery)'
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"pinned":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"unresolved":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"recovery_required":true}'::jsonb
        AND NOT coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb) @> '{"security_event":true}'::jsonb
  ), bounded AS (
    SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY observed_at,id LIMIT p_limit
  ), evaluated AS (
    SELECT bounded.id,bounded.observed_at,
      public.retention_archive_eligibility_v1(p_root_kind,bounded.id,p_now) eligibility
    FROM bounded
  )
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'rootKind',p_root_kind,'rootId',id,'observedAt',observed_at,
    'eligible',(eligibility->>'eligible')::BOOLEAN,'blockers',eligibility->'blockers',
    'rowCount',jsonb_array_length(eligibility->'rows')
  ) ORDER BY observed_at,id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result FROM evaluated;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_radar_publication_failed(p_terminal_reason text, p_attempted_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

functions.name: opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(uuid,date,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(requested_observation_id uuid, requested_anchor_session date, requested_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_observation public.opportunity_price_observations_v3%ROWTYPE;
  v_symbol text;
  v_session_count integer;
  v_action_days jsonb;
  v_factor double precision;
  v_evidence jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_observation
  FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.observation_id=requested_observation_id
    AND observation.source_timestamp<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.collected_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff;
  IF v_observation.session_id>requested_anchor_session THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_anchor_session'; END IF;
  SELECT selected.symbol INTO STRICT v_symbol
  FROM (
    SELECT instrument.symbol,row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY instrument.stock_id
      ORDER BY instrument.recorded_at DESC,instrument.source_timestamp DESC,
        instrument.instrument_authority_id
    ) AS authority_rank
    FROM public.stock_instruments_v3 instrument
    WHERE instrument.stock_id=v_observation.stock_id
      AND instrument.exchange=v_observation.exchange
      AND instrument.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
      AND instrument.source_timestamp<=requested_source_cutoff
      AND instrument.valid_from<=requested_source_cutoff
      AND (instrument.valid_to IS NULL OR requested_source_cutoff<instrument.valid_to)
  ) selected
  WHERE selected.authority_rank=1;
  WITH bounded_sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT session.session_id
    FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3 session
    WHERE session.session_id>v_observation.session_id
      AND session.session_id<=requested_anchor_session
      AND session.canonical_cutoff<=requested_source_cutoff
    ORDER BY session.session_id
    LIMIT 253
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_session_count FROM bounded_sessions;
  IF v_session_count=253 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation'; END IF;
  WITH bounded_sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT session.session_id
    FROM public.opportunity_effective_taiwan_sessions_v3 session
    WHERE session.session_id>v_observation.session_id
      AND session.session_id<=requested_anchor_session
      AND session.canonical_cutoff<=requested_source_cutoff
    ORDER BY session.session_id
    LIMIT 253
  ), resolved AS (
    SELECT bounded_sessions.session_id,exchange_session.session_authority_id,
      snapshot.snapshot_id,snapshot.dataset_hash,
      CASE WHEN event.snapshot_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_array(
        event.event_kind,event.pre_action_reference_price,event.post_action_reference_price,
        event.feed_identity,event.source_row_ref
      ) END AS event_json,
      coalesce(event.daily_adjustment_factor,1.0) AS daily_factor
    FROM bounded_sessions
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT session.session_authority_id
      FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
      WHERE session.session_id=bounded_sessions.session_id
        AND session.market::text=v_observation.exchange::text
        AND session.status='completed'
        AND session.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
        AND session.source_timestamp<=requested_source_cutoff
      ORDER BY session.recorded_at DESC,session.source_timestamp DESC,
        session.session_authority_id
      LIMIT 1
    ) exchange_session ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT candidate.snapshot_id,candidate.dataset_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_corporate_action_snapshots_v3 candidate
      WHERE candidate.exchange=v_observation.exchange
        AND candidate.session_id=bounded_sessions.session_id
        AND candidate.session_authority_id=exchange_session.session_authority_id
        AND candidate.corporate_action_version='tw-corporate-action-v3.1'
        AND candidate.collected_at<=requested_source_cutoff
        AND candidate.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.opportunity_corporate_action_snapshots_v3 tied
          WHERE tied.exchange=candidate.exchange
            AND tied.session_id=candidate.session_id
            AND tied.session_authority_id=candidate.session_authority_id
            AND tied.corporate_action_version=candidate.corporate_action_version
            AND tied.collected_at=candidate.collected_at
            AND tied.recorded_at=candidate.recorded_at
            AND tied.dataset_hash<>candidate.dataset_hash
        )
      ORDER BY candidate.collected_at DESC,candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.snapshot_id
      LIMIT 1
    ) snapshot ON true
    LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_corporate_action_events_v3 event
      ON event.snapshot_id=snapshot.snapshot_id AND event.symbol=v_symbol
  )
  SELECT
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
      session_id,session_authority_id,snapshot_id,dataset_hash,event_json,daily_factor
    ) ORDER BY session_id),'[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(exp(sum(ln(daily_factor))),1.0)
  INTO v_action_days,v_factor
  FROM resolved;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_action_days)<>v_session_count
    OR v_factor<=0 OR v_factor='Infinity'::double precision
  THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  v_evidence:=jsonb_build_array(
    'adjusted-price-evidence-v3.1',requested_anchor_session,
    v_observation.observation_id,v_observation.source_ref,
    v_observation.session_authority_id,v_observation.raw_open,v_observation.raw_high,
    v_observation.raw_low,v_observation.raw_close,v_action_days,v_factor,
    v_observation.raw_open*v_factor,v_observation.raw_high*v_factor,
    v_observation.raw_low*v_factor,v_observation.raw_close*v_factor
  );
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'evidence',v_evidence,
    'ref',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(
      regexp_replace(v_evidence::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'
    ),'sha256'),'hex')
  );
END
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_authority_selected_stream_count_v3_internal(authority_stream_family_v3,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_authority_selected_stream_count_v3_internal(requested_family authority_stream_family_v3, requested_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_registry_count bigint := 0;
  v_stream_count bigint := 0;
  v_semantic_count bigint := 0;
  v_selected_count bigint := 0;
  v_bound bigint := 0;
  v_overflow text := 'identity_manifest_overflow';
BEGIN
  IF requested_family='discovery_identity' THEN
    v_bound:=10000;
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='discovery_identity'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 10001
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM bounded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.source_identity_authorities_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.source_identity_id=(
          convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
        )::uuid
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND approved_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        source_identity_id,source_key,source_class,distribution_identity,
        valid_from,valid_to,status,approved_at,approving_principal_id
      )) semantic_count,min(authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='publisher_verification' THEN
    v_bound:=10000;
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='publisher_verification'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 10001
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM bounded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.publisher_verification_authorities_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.publisher_identity_id=(
          convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
        )::uuid
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND approved_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        publisher_identity_id,source_class,domains,feed_identity,institution_identity,
        valid_from,valid_to,approved_at,approving_principal_id,status
      )) semantic_count,min(authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='instrument_roster' THEN
    v_bound:=20000; v_overflow:='roster_volume_exceeded';
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='instrument_roster'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 20001
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM bounded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_instruments_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.stock_id=(
          convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
        )::uuid
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.instrument_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND source_timestamp<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        stock_id,symbol,exchange,instrument_type,listing_status,official_legal_name,
        official_short_name,provider,source_timestamp,valid_from,valid_to,roster_version
      )) semantic_count,min(instrument_authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.instrument_authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='stock_alias' THEN
    v_bound:=100000;
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='stock_alias'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 100001
    ), decoded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1)::uuid stock_id,
        convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2 normalized_alias,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>3)::public.alias_source_v3 source
      FROM bounded_registry
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM decoded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_aliases_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.stock_id=registry.stock_id
          AND retained.normalized_alias=registry.normalized_alias
          AND retained.source=registry.source
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.alias_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND source_timestamp<=requested_cutoff
        AND approved_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        stock_id,normalized_alias,source,source_timestamp,approved_by_principal_id,
        approved_at,valid_from,valid_to,status,normalization_version
      )) semantic_count,min(alias_authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.alias_authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='sector_assignment' THEN
    v_bound:=20000; v_overflow:='roster_volume_exceeded';
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='sector_assignment'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 20001
    ), decoded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1)::uuid stock_id,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2)::public.tw_market_v3 market
      FROM bounded_registry
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM decoded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_sector_assignments_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.stock_id=registry.stock_id
          AND retained.market=registry.market
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.assignment_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND source_timestamp<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        stock_id,market,official_industry_code,canonical_sector_key,provider,
        source_timestamp,valid_from,valid_to,taxonomy_version,status
      )) semantic_count,min(assignment_authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.assignment_authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='peer_reviewer' THEN
    v_bound:=1000;
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='peer_reviewer'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 1001
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM bounded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_peer_relationship_reviewers_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.reviewer_principal_id=(
          convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
        )::uuid
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.reviewer_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND approved_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        reviewer_principal_id,approving_principal_id,approved_at,
        valid_from,valid_to,status
      )) semantic_count,min(reviewer_authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.reviewer_authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSIF requested_family='peer_relationship' THEN
    v_bound:=100000;
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='peer_relationship'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 100001
    ), decoded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1)::uuid supplier_stock_id,
        (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2)::uuid customer_stock_id
      FROM bounded_registry
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,authority.*
      FROM decoded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_peer_relationships_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.supplier_stock_id=registry.supplier_stock_id
          AND retained.customer_stock_id=registry.customer_stock_id
          AND retained.relationship_kind='supply_chain'
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.relationship_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) authority
    ), raw_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(*) retained_count FROM raw GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), cutoff_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM raw
      WHERE recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND source_timestamp<=requested_cutoff
        AND approved_at<=requested_cutoff
        AND valid_from<=requested_cutoff
    ), greatest_times AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) greatest_recorded_at
      FROM cutoff_rows GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), greatest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT cutoff_rows.*
      FROM cutoff_rows JOIN greatest_times USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE cutoff_rows.recorded_at=greatest_times.greatest_recorded_at
    ), tie_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        supplier_instrument_authority_id,supplier_stock_id,
        customer_instrument_authority_id,customer_stock_id,relationship_kind,
        source_timestamp,approved_at,valid_from,valid_to,status,evidence_ref,
        reviewer_principal_id
      )) semantic_count,min(relationship_authority_id::text)::uuid retained_id
      FROM greatest GROUP BY stream_key_hash
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT greatest.*
      FROM greatest JOIN tie_stats USING(stream_key_hash)
      WHERE greatest.relationship_authority_id=tie_stats.retained_id
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded_registry),
      coalesce((SELECT max(retained_count) FROM raw_counts),0),
      coalesce((SELECT max(semantic_count) FROM tie_stats),0),
      (SELECT count(*) FROM selected)
    INTO v_registry_count,v_stream_count,v_semantic_count,v_selected_count;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;

  IF v_registry_count>v_bound OR v_stream_count>64 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE=v_overflow;
  END IF;
  IF v_semantic_count>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='authority_revision_conflict';
  END IF;
  RETURN coalesce(v_selected_count,0);
END
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_candidate_plan_v3_internal(uuid,text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_candidate_plan_v3_internal(requested_run_id uuid, requested_phase text)
 RETURNS TABLE(candidate_ordinal integer, stock_id uuid, symbol text, anchor_claim_id uuid, source_key source_key_v3, canonical_sector_key canonical_sector_key_v3, priority_score double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_cutoff timestamptz; v_upstream uuid;
BEGIN
  IF requested_phase NOT IN ('active','shallow','deep') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
  END IF;
  SELECT run.source_cutoff,run.upstream_run_id INTO STRICT v_cutoff,v_upstream
  FROM public.opportunity_runs run
  WHERE run.run_id=requested_run_id AND run.mode='enrich_rank';
  IF requested_phase='deep' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT shallow.stock_id,shallow.symbol,shallow.anchor_claim_id,
        revision.source_key,shallow.canonical_sector_key,
        greatest(0,least(100,
          0.60*(shallow.payload_json->>5)::double precision+
          0.20*(shallow.payload_json->>6)::double precision+
          0.10*(shallow.payload_json->>7)::double precision+
          0.10*(shallow.payload_json->>8)::double precision
        )) AS priority_score
      FROM public.opportunity_shallow_candidate_results_v3 shallow
      JOIN public.opportunity_source_claims claim
        ON claim.claim_id=shallow.anchor_claim_id
      JOIN public.source_document_revisions_v3 revision
        ON revision.revision_id=claim.revision_id
      WHERE shallow.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND shallow.direct_source
        AND shallow.candidate_origin='direct_candidate'
        AND shallow.shallow_status='succeeded'
        AND shallow.symbol IN (
          SELECT symbol_value.value
          FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
          JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
            ON manifest.manifest_id=input.manifest_id
            AND manifest.manifest_kind='candidate_financial'
            AND manifest.status='complete'
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(pair->1) symbol_value(value)
          WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
            AND input.input_role='candidate_financial' AND input.ordinal=0
            AND pair->>0='orderedSymbols'
        )
      ORDER BY priority_score DESC,shallow.symbol
      LIMIT 31
    ), parameters AS (
      SELECT least(20,count(*))::integer AS target,
        count(DISTINCT eligible.canonical_sector_key)::integer AS group_count
      FROM eligible
    ), quota AS (
      SELECT eligible.*,
        row_number() OVER (
          PARTITION BY eligible.canonical_sector_key
          ORDER BY eligible.priority_score DESC,eligible.symbol
        ) AS group_ordinal,
        parameters.target,parameters.group_count
      FROM eligible CROSS JOIN parameters
    ), selected AS (
      SELECT quota.*
      FROM quota
      WHERE quota.group_ordinal<=ceil(
        quota.target*greatest(0.35,1.0/greatest(1,quota.group_count))
      )
      ORDER BY quota.priority_score DESC,quota.symbol
      LIMIT 20
    )
    SELECT (row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY selected.priority_score DESC,selected.symbol
      )-1)::integer,
      selected.stock_id,selected.symbol,selected.anchor_claim_id,
      selected.source_key,selected.canonical_sector_key,selected.priority_score
    FROM selected ORDER BY selected.priority_score DESC,selected.symbol;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
        WHERE input.input_role='source_identity_allowlist'
      )::uuid AS source_identity_manifest_id,
      min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
        WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment'
      )::uuid AS taxonomy_manifest_id
    FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
    JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      ON manifest.manifest_id=input.manifest_id
      AND manifest.status='complete'
    WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
      AND input.ordinal=0
      AND input.input_role IN (
        'source_identity_allowlist','taxonomy_assignment'
      )
    HAVING count(*)=2
  ), ranked_anchor AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (mention.symbol)
      mention.stock_id,mention.symbol,claim.claim_id,revision.source_key,
      coalesce(sector.canonical_sector_key,'unknown'::public.canonical_sector_key_v3)
        AS canonical_sector_key,
      greatest(0,least(100,
        100*CASE authority_row.payload_json->>3
          WHEN 'official' THEN 1.0
          WHEN 'public_research' THEN 0.8
          WHEN 'curated_thesis' THEN 0.6
          ELSE 0.4 END*
        claim.claim_confidence*mention.confidence*
        greatest(0,1-extract(epoch FROM (v_cutoff-claim.effective_at))/
          CASE authority_row.payload_json->>3
            WHEN 'official' THEN 3024000.0
            WHEN 'public_research' THEN 604800.0
            WHEN 'curated_thesis' THEN 604800.0
            ELSE 259200.0 END)
      )) AS priority_score
    FROM public.opportunity_source_mentions mention
    JOIN public.opportunity_source_claims claim
      ON claim.run_id=mention.run_id
      AND claim.revision_id=mention.revision_id
      AND claim.claim_ordinal=mention.claim_ordinal
    JOIN public.source_document_revisions_v3 revision
      ON revision.revision_id=claim.revision_id
    CROSS JOIN dependencies dependency
    JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 authority_row
      ON authority_row.manifest_id=dependency.source_identity_manifest_id
      AND authority_row.section_key='rows'
      AND (authority_row.payload_json->>0)::uuid=revision.source_identity_authority_id
      AND (authority_row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=revision.approved_source_identity_id
      AND authority_row.payload_json->>2=revision.source_key::text
      AND authority_row.payload_json->>7='active'
      AND (authority_row.payload_json->>5)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
      AND (
        authority_row.payload_json->6='null'::jsonb
        OR v_cutoff<(authority_row.payload_json->>6)::timestamptz
      )
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT (taxonomy_row.payload_json->>4)::public.canonical_sector_key_v3
        AS canonical_sector_key
      FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 taxonomy_row
      WHERE taxonomy_row.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_manifest_id
        AND taxonomy_row.section_key='rows'
        AND (taxonomy_row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=mention.stock_id
        AND taxonomy_row.payload_json->>10='active'
        AND (taxonomy_row.payload_json->>7)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (
          taxonomy_row.payload_json->8='null'::jsonb
          OR v_cutoff<(taxonomy_row.payload_json->>8)::timestamptz
        )
      ORDER BY taxonomy_row.row_ordinal
      LIMIT 2
    ) sector ON true
    WHERE mention.run_id=v_upstream
      AND mention.outcome IN ('linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim')
      AND claim.effective_at<=v_cutoff
    ORDER BY mention.symbol,priority_score DESC,claim.effective_at DESC,
      revision.source_key,claim.claim_id,authority_row.row_ordinal
  ), active AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ranked_anchor.*
    FROM ranked_anchor
    ORDER BY priority_score DESC,claim_id,symbol
    LIMIT 60
    ), parameters AS (
      SELECT least(30,count(*))::integer AS target,
        count(DISTINCT active.source_key)::integer AS group_count
      FROM active
  ), quota AS (
    SELECT active.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY active.source_key
        ORDER BY active.priority_score DESC,active.claim_id,active.symbol
      ) AS group_ordinal,
      parameters.target,parameters.group_count
    FROM active CROSS JOIN parameters
  ), selected AS (
    SELECT quota.*
    FROM quota
      WHERE requested_phase='active' OR quota.group_ordinal<=ceil(
        quota.target*greatest(0.40,1.0/greatest(1,quota.group_count))
      )
      ORDER BY quota.priority_score DESC,quota.claim_id,quota.symbol
    LIMIT CASE requested_phase WHEN 'active' THEN 60 ELSE 30 END
  )
  SELECT (row_number() OVER (
      ORDER BY selected.priority_score DESC,selected.claim_id,selected.symbol
    )-1)::integer,
    selected.stock_id,selected.symbol,selected.claim_id,
    selected.source_key,selected.canonical_sector_key,selected.priority_score
  FROM selected ORDER BY priority_score DESC,claim_id,symbol;
END
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_global_observation_v3_internal(market_fact_key_v3,market_scope_key_v3,text,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_global_observation_v3_internal(requested_fact market_fact_key_v3, requested_scope market_scope_key_v3, requested_provider_identity text, requested_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
WITH raw_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT observation.*
  FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.fact_key=requested_fact
    AND observation.scope_key=requested_scope
    AND observation.provider='global_allowlisted'
    AND observation.provider_identity=requested_provider_identity
    AND observation.observed_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.collected_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
  ORDER BY observation.provider_session_date DESC,observation.recorded_at DESC,
    observation.observation_id
  LIMIT 193
), ranked AS (
  SELECT raw_dates.*,
    dense_rank() OVER (
      PARTITION BY provider_session_date
      ORDER BY observed_at DESC,collected_at DESC,recorded_at DESC,source_ref
    ) AS authority_rank,
    dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY provider_session_date DESC) AS date_rank
  FROM raw_dates
), resolved AS (
  SELECT provider_session_date,min(value) AS value,max(observed_at) AS observed_at,
    min(source_ref) AS source_ref
  FROM ranked
  WHERE date_rank<=3 AND authority_rank=1
  GROUP BY provider_session_date
  HAVING count(DISTINCT value)=1
  ORDER BY provider_session_date DESC
), selectable AS (
  SELECT * FROM resolved ORDER BY provider_session_date DESC LIMIT 2
)
SELECT coalesce((
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'status',CASE
      WHEN requested_source_cutoff-observed_at<=interval '96 hours' THEN 'fresh'
      ELSE 'stale' END,
    'value',CASE
      WHEN requested_source_cutoff-observed_at<=interval '96 hours' THEN value
      ELSE NULL END,
    'observedAt',observed_at,
    'sourceRef',source_ref,
    'providerSessionDate',provider_session_date
  )
  FROM selectable
  ORDER BY provider_session_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),jsonb_build_object(
  'status','missing','value',NULL,'observedAt',NULL,'sourceRef',NULL,
  'providerSessionDate',NULL
))
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_levenshtein_v3_internal(text,text)
opportunity_manifest_native_rows_v3_internal(uuid,uuid,opportunity_manifest_kind_v3,opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3,integer,integer)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_manifest_native_rows_v3_internal(requested_run_id uuid, requested_manifest_id uuid, requested_kind opportunity_manifest_kind_v3, requested_section opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3, requested_offset integer, requested_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(native_ordinal bigint, terminal_code text, native_row jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cutoff timestamptz;
  v_symbol_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF requested_offset<0 OR requested_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2001 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='bound_violation';
  END IF;
  SELECT run.source_cutoff INTO STRICT v_cutoff
  FROM public.opportunity_runs run
  JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
    ON manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    AND manifest.manifest_kind=requested_kind
    AND manifest.source_cutoff=run.source_cutoff
  WHERE run.run_id=requested_run_id;

  IF requested_kind='candidate_financial' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_symbol_count
    FROM (
      SELECT symbol_value.value
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(pair->1) symbol_value(value)
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
        AND pair->>0='orderedSymbols'
      ORDER BY symbol_value.value
      LIMIT 21
    ) bounded_symbols;
    IF v_symbol_count>20 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='deep_candidate_bound_exceeded';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM (
        SELECT instrument.stock_id,fact.observation_family,
          count(*) AS selected_count
        FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT (roster.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id
          FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(pair->1) symbol_value(value)
