          JOIN public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs roster_binding
            ON roster_binding.run_id=requested_run_id
            AND roster_binding.input_role='instrument_roster'
            AND roster_binding.ordinal=0
          JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 roster
            ON roster.manifest_id=roster_binding.manifest_id
            AND roster.section_key='rows'
            AND roster.payload_json->>2=symbol_value.value
          WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
            AND pair->>0='orderedSymbols'
          ORDER BY (roster.payload_json->>1)::uuid
          LIMIT 21
        ) instrument
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          (
            SELECT 'analyst_estimate'::text AS observation_family
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 candidate
            JOIN public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
              ON verification.evidence_ref=candidate.source_ref
              AND verification.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND verification.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
            WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
              AND candidate.fact_key IN (
                'quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda','quarterly_revenue',
                'book_value_per_share'
              )
              AND candidate.estimate_kind='analyst_estimate'
              AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY candidate.source_timestamp DESC,
              verification.institution_identity,candidate.source_ref,candidate.fact_id
            LIMIT 101
          )
          UNION ALL
          (
            SELECT 'broker_consensus'::text AS observation_family
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 candidate
            JOIN public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
              ON verification.evidence_ref=candidate.source_ref
              AND verification.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND verification.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
            WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
              AND candidate.fact_key='broker_target_price'
              AND candidate.estimate_kind='broker_consensus'
              AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY candidate.source_timestamp DESC,
              verification.institution_identity,candidate.source_ref,candidate.fact_id
            LIMIT 101
          )
        ) fact
        GROUP BY instrument.stock_id,fact.observation_family
      ) bounded_public_research
      WHERE bounded_public_research.selected_count>100
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH symbols AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT symbol_value.value AS symbol,
        (symbol_value.ordinal-1)::integer AS symbol_ordinal
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(pair->1)
        WITH ORDINALITY symbol_value(value,ordinal)
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
        AND pair->>0='orderedSymbols'
      ORDER BY symbol_value.ordinal
      LIMIT 21
    ), instruments AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT symbol.symbol,symbol.symbol_ordinal,instrument.stock_id
      FROM symbols symbol
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT selected.stock_id
        FROM (
          SELECT authority.stock_id,authority.listing_status,authority.instrument_type,
            authority.valid_to,row_number() OVER (
              PARTITION BY authority.stock_id
              ORDER BY authority.recorded_at DESC,authority.source_timestamp DESC,
                authority.instrument_authority_id
            ) AS authority_rank
          FROM public.stock_instruments_v3 authority
          WHERE authority.symbol=symbol.symbol
            AND authority.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND authority.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND authority.valid_from<=v_cutoff
        ) selected
        WHERE selected.authority_rank=1
          AND selected.listing_status='active'
          AND selected.instrument_type='common_stock'
          AND (selected.valid_to IS NULL OR v_cutoff<selected.valid_to)
        ORDER BY selected.stock_id
        LIMIT 2
      ) instrument ON true
    ), raw_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT instrument.symbol,instrument.symbol_ordinal,fact.*
      FROM instruments instrument
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 observation
          WHERE observation.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
            AND observation.fact_key='monthly_revenue'
            AND observation.estimate_kind='reported'
            AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY observation.period_end DESC,observation.filing_published_at DESC,
            observation.source_timestamp DESC,observation.collected_at DESC,
            observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.fact_id
          LIMIT 17
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 observation
          JOIN public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
            ON verification.evidence_ref=observation.source_ref
            AND verification.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND verification.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
          WHERE observation.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
            AND observation.fact_key IN (
              'quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda','quarterly_revenue',
              'book_value_per_share'
            )
            AND observation.estimate_kind='analyst_estimate'
            AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY observation.source_timestamp DESC,
            verification.institution_identity,observation.source_ref,
            observation.fact_id
          LIMIT 101
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 observation
          JOIN public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
            ON verification.evidence_ref=observation.source_ref
            AND verification.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND verification.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
          WHERE observation.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
            AND observation.fact_key='broker_target_price'
            AND observation.estimate_kind='broker_consensus'
            AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY observation.source_timestamp DESC,
            verification.institution_identity,observation.source_ref,
            observation.fact_id
          LIMIT 101
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM (VALUES
            ('quarterly_revenue'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_gross_profit'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_operating_income'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_net_income'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_diluted_eps'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_ebitda'::public.financial_fact_key_v3)
          ) requested_fact(fact_key)
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT candidate.*
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 candidate
            WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
              AND candidate.fact_key=requested_fact.fact_key
              AND candidate.estimate_kind='reported'
              AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY candidate.period_end DESC,candidate.filing_published_at DESC,
              candidate.source_timestamp DESC,candidate.collected_at DESC,
              candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.fact_id
            LIMIT 13
          ) observation
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM (VALUES
            ('pe_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('pb_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('ev_ebitda_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('ev_sales_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3)
          ) requested_fact(fact_key)
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT candidate.*
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 candidate
            WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
              AND candidate.fact_key=requested_fact.fact_key
              AND candidate.estimate_kind='reported'
              AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY candidate.period_end DESC,candidate.filing_published_at DESC,
              candidate.source_timestamp DESC,candidate.collected_at DESC,
              candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.fact_id
            LIMIT 21
          ) observation
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM (VALUES
            ('quarterly_operating_expense'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_non_operating_income'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_pretax_income'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_income_tax_expense'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_noncontrolling_interest'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('quarterly_net_income_attributable_to_common'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('diluted_weighted_average_shares'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('cash_and_equivalents'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('total_debt'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('total_equity'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('total_assets'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('invested_capital'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('net_asset_value'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('operating_cash_flow'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('capital_expenditure'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('interest_expense'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('shares_outstanding'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('depreciation_amortization'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('diluted_shares'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('roe'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
            ('net_debt'::public.financial_fact_key_v3)
          ) requested_fact(fact_key)
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT candidate.*
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 candidate
            WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
              AND candidate.fact_key=requested_fact.fact_key
              AND candidate.estimate_kind='reported'
              AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY candidate.period_end DESC,candidate.filing_published_at DESC,
              candidate.source_timestamp DESC,candidate.collected_at DESC,
              candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.fact_id
            LIMIT 2
          ) observation
        )
        UNION ALL
        (
          SELECT observation.*
          FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 observation
          WHERE observation.stock_id=instrument.stock_id
            AND observation.fact_key='book_value_per_share'
            AND observation.estimate_kind='reported'
            AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY observation.period_end DESC,observation.filing_published_at DESC,
            observation.source_timestamp DESC,observation.collected_at DESC,
            observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.fact_id
          LIMIT 10
        )
      ) fact
    ), normalized AS (
      SELECT raw_facts.*,verification.institution_identity,
        CASE unit
          WHEN 'TWD_thousand' THEN value*1000
          WHEN 'TWD_million' THEN value*1000000
          WHEN 'thousand_shares' THEN value*1000
          ELSE value
        END AS normalized_value,
        CASE unit
          WHEN 'TWD_thousand' THEN 'TWD'
          WHEN 'TWD_million' THEN 'TWD'
          WHEN 'thousand_shares' THEN 'share'
          ELSE unit::text
        END AS normalized_unit,
        dense_rank() OVER (
          PARTITION BY symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
            estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,coalesce(verification.institution_identity,'')
          ORDER BY
            CASE authority_tier WHEN 'official_filing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            filing_published_at DESC,source_timestamp DESC,collected_at DESC,
            recorded_at DESC,coalesce(filing_restatement_id,'') DESC
        ) AS precedence_rank
      FROM raw_facts
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT candidate.institution_identity
        FROM public.source_publication_verifications_v3 candidate
        WHERE candidate.evidence_ref=raw_facts.source_ref
          AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.verification_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) verification ON true
    ), top_rows AS (
      SELECT normalized.*,
        count(*) OVER (
          PARTITION BY symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
            estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,coalesce(institution_identity,'')
        ) AS tied_count
      FROM normalized
      WHERE precedence_rank=1
    ), conflicts AS (
      SELECT symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
        estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,institution_identity,
        count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(normalized_value,normalized_unit)) AS value_count
      FROM top_rows
      GROUP BY symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
        estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,institution_identity
    ), terminal_head AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (
        top.symbol,top.fact_key,top.period_start,top.period_end,top.duration_kind
        ,top.estimate_kind,top.estimate_horizon,top.institution_identity
      )
        top.*,conflict.value_count
      FROM top_rows top
      JOIN conflicts conflict USING(
        symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
        estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,institution_identity
      )
      ORDER BY top.symbol,top.fact_key,top.period_start,top.period_end,
        top.duration_kind,top.estimate_kind,top.estimate_horizon,
        top.institution_identity,top.source_ref
    ), terminal AS (
      SELECT terminal_head.*,
        row_number() OVER (
          PARTITION BY terminal_head.symbol,terminal_head.fact_key,
            terminal_head.estimate_kind,terminal_head.estimate_horizon,
            terminal_head.institution_identity
          ORDER BY terminal_head.period_end DESC,
            terminal_head.period_start DESC NULLS LAST,
            terminal_head.duration_kind,terminal_head.source_ref
        ) AS history_rank
      FROM terminal_head
    ), bounded AS (
      SELECT terminal.*,
        CASE
          WHEN fact_key='monthly_revenue' THEN history_rank<=16
          WHEN fact_key IN (
            'quarterly_revenue','quarterly_gross_profit','quarterly_operating_income',
            'quarterly_net_income','quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda'
          ) THEN history_rank<=12
          WHEN fact_key IN (
            'pe_multiple','pb_multiple','ev_ebitda_multiple','ev_sales_multiple'
          ) THEN history_rank<=20
          WHEN fact_key='broker_target_price' THEN history_rank<=100
          WHEN fact_key IN (
            'quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda','quarterly_revenue',
            'book_value_per_share'
          ) AND estimate_kind<>'reported' THEN history_rank<=100
          WHEN fact_key='book_value_per_share' THEN history_rank<=9
          ELSE history_rank<=1
        END AS within_history_bound
      FROM terminal
    ), rows_by_section AS (
      SELECT 'selected_facts'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        symbol_ordinal,fact_key,period_end,period_start,duration_kind,source_ref,
        NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
          normalized_value,normalized_unit,authority_tier,filing_published_at,
          source_timestamp,collected_at,recorded_at,source_ref,filing_restatement_id,
          estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,institution_identity,
          CASE WHEN estimate_kind='reported' THEN 'reported_fact'
            ELSE 'eligible_verified_estimate' END
        ) AS row_payload
      FROM bounded
      WHERE within_history_bound AND value_count=1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_facts',symbol_ordinal,fact_key,period_end,period_start,
        duration_kind,source_ref,'conflicting_point_in_time_fact',
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,
          normalized_value,normalized_unit,authority_tier,filing_published_at,
          source_timestamp,collected_at,recorded_at,source_ref,filing_restatement_id,
          estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,institution_identity,
          CASE WHEN estimate_kind='reported' THEN 'reported_fact'
            ELSE 'eligible_verified_estimate' END,
          'conflicting_point_in_time_fact'
        )
      FROM bounded
      WHERE within_history_bound AND value_count>1
    ), candidate_conservation AS (
      SELECT symbol.symbol_ordinal,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol.symbol,
          count(rows_by_section.row_payload),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_by_section.section_key='selected_facts'),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_by_section.section_key='excluded_facts'),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'conflicting_point_in_time_fact',
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_by_section.reason='conflicting_point_in_time_fact'),
            'invalid_unit',0
          )
        ) AS row_payload
      FROM symbols symbol
      LEFT JOIN rows_by_section ON rows_by_section.symbol_ordinal=symbol.symbol_ordinal
      GROUP BY symbol.symbol_ordinal,symbol.symbol
    ), ordered AS (
      SELECT row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY symbol_ordinal,fact_key,period_end DESC,period_start,
            duration_kind,source_ref
        )-1 AS ordinal,section_key,reason,row_payload
      FROM rows_by_section
      WHERE section_key=requested_section
      UNION ALL
      SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY symbol_ordinal)-1,
        'conservation'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3,NULL,row_payload
      FROM candidate_conservation
      WHERE requested_section='conservation'
    )
    SELECT ordered.ordinal::bigint,ordered.reason,ordered.row_payload
    FROM ordered
    ORDER BY ordered.ordinal
    OFFSET requested_offset
    LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='peer_authority' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_symbol_count
    FROM (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3 registry
      WHERE registry.family='peer_relationship'
      ORDER BY registry.stream_key_hash,registry.stream_key_canonical
      LIMIT 100001
    ) bounded_registry;
    IF v_symbol_count>100000 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='identity_manifest_overflow';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3 registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*) AS retained_count
        FROM (
          SELECT relationship.relationship_authority_id
          FROM public.stock_peer_relationships_v3 relationship
          WHERE relationship.supplier_stock_id=(
              convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
            )::uuid
            AND relationship.customer_stock_id=(
              convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2
            )::uuid
            AND relationship.relationship_kind='supply_chain'
          ORDER BY relationship.recorded_at DESC,relationship.relationship_authority_id
          LIMIT 65
        ) bounded
      ) stream
      WHERE registry.family='peer_relationship' AND stream.retained_count>64
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='data_integrity_failure';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
      WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
        FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
        WHERE family='peer_relationship'
        ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 100001
      ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,relationship.*
        FROM bounded_registry registry
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT retained.*
          FROM public.stock_peer_relationships_v3 retained
          WHERE retained.supplier_stock_id=(
              convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
            )::uuid
            AND retained.customer_stock_id=(
              convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2
            )::uuid
            AND retained.relationship_kind='supply_chain'
          ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.relationship_authority_id LIMIT 65
        ) relationship
      ), greatest_time AS (
        SELECT stream_key_hash,max(recorded_at) AS recorded_at
        FROM raw
        WHERE recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
          AND approved_at<=v_cutoff AND valid_from<=v_cutoff
        GROUP BY stream_key_hash
      )
      SELECT 1
      FROM raw JOIN greatest_time USING(stream_key_hash,recorded_at)
      GROUP BY stream_key_hash
      HAVING count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(
        supplier_instrument_authority_id,supplier_stock_id,
        customer_instrument_authority_id,customer_stock_id,relationship_kind,
        source_timestamp,approved_at,valid_from,valid_to,status,evidence_ref,
        reviewer_principal_id
      ))>1
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='authority_revision_conflict';
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
      FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
      WHERE family='peer_relationship'
      ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 100001
    ), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,relationship.*
      FROM bounded_registry registry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT retained.*
        FROM public.stock_peer_relationships_v3 retained
        WHERE retained.supplier_stock_id=(
            convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1
          )::uuid
          AND retained.customer_stock_id=(
            convert_from(registry.stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2
          )::uuid
          AND retained.relationship_kind='supply_chain'
        ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.relationship_authority_id LIMIT 65
      ) relationship
    ), dependencies AS (
      SELECT
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster')::uuid
          AS roster_manifest_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='peer_reviewer_allowlist'
        )::uuid AS reviewer_manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
    ), latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw.stream_key_hash) raw.*
      FROM raw
      WHERE raw.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND raw.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
        AND raw.approved_at<=v_cutoff AND raw.valid_from<=v_cutoff
      ORDER BY raw.stream_key_hash,raw.recorded_at DESC,raw.relationship_authority_id
    ), classified AS (
      SELECT latest.*,supplier.instrument_authority_id AS supplier_authority_id,
        supplier.symbol AS roster_supplier,
        customer.instrument_authority_id AS customer_authority_id,
        customer.symbol AS roster_customer,
        CASE
          WHEN latest.source_timestamp>latest.approved_at THEN 'source_after_approval'
          WHEN latest.status<>'active' THEN 'inactive_status'
          WHEN latest.valid_from>v_cutoff THEN 'not_yet_valid'
          WHEN latest.valid_to IS NOT NULL AND latest.valid_to<=v_cutoff THEN 'expired'
          WHEN latest.supplier_stock_id=latest.customer_stock_id THEN 'self_edge'
          WHEN supplier.symbol IS NULL THEN 'ineligible_supplier'
          WHEN customer.symbol IS NULL THEN 'ineligible_customer'
          WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dependencies dependency
            JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 reviewer
              ON reviewer.manifest_id=dependency.reviewer_manifest_id
              AND reviewer.section_key='rows'
            WHERE reviewer.payload_json->>1=latest.reviewer_principal_id::text
              AND reviewer.payload_json->>5='active'
              AND (reviewer.payload_json->>3)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
              AND (
                reviewer.payload_json->>4 IS NULL
                OR v_cutoff<(reviewer.payload_json->>4)::timestamptz
              )
          ) THEN 'reviewer_not_allowed'
          WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
            WHERE verification.evidence_ref=latest.evidence_ref
              AND verification.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND verification.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ) THEN 'unverified_evidence'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS exclusion_reason
      FROM latest CROSS JOIN dependencies
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (row.payload_json->>0)::uuid AS instrument_authority_id,
          row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=dependencies.roster_manifest_id
          AND row.section_key='rows'
          AND (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=latest.supplier_stock_id
          AND row.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
          AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
          AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
          AND (row.payload_json->>10 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz)
        ORDER BY row.row_ordinal LIMIT 2
      ) supplier ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (row.payload_json->>0)::uuid AS instrument_authority_id,
          row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        WHERE row.manifest_id=dependencies.roster_manifest_id
          AND row.section_key='rows'
          AND (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=latest.customer_stock_id
          AND row.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
          AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
          AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
          AND (row.payload_json->>10 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz)
        ORDER BY row.row_ordinal LIMIT 2
      ) customer ON true
    ), payloads AS (
      SELECT classified.*,
        jsonb_build_array(
          relationship_authority_id,supplier_instrument_authority_id,
          supplier_stock_id,roster_supplier,customer_instrument_authority_id,
          customer_stock_id,roster_customer,'supply_chain',source_timestamp,
          approved_at,valid_from,valid_to,status,evidence_ref,
          reviewer_principal_id,recorded_at
        ) AS selected_payload,
        jsonb_build_array(
          relationship_authority_id,supplier_instrument_authority_id,
          supplier_stock_id,roster_supplier,customer_instrument_authority_id,
          customer_stock_id,roster_customer,'supply_chain',source_timestamp,
          approved_at,valid_from,valid_to,status,evidence_ref,
          reviewer_principal_id,recorded_at,exclusion_reason
        ) AS excluded_payload
      FROM classified
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'selected_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY roster_supplier,roster_customer,source_timestamp DESC,
            approved_at DESC,recorded_at DESC,evidence_ref,relationship_authority_id
        )-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,selected_payload AS payload
      FROM payloads WHERE exclusion_reason IS NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY exclusion_reason,relationship_authority_id
        )-1,exclusion_reason,excluded_payload
      FROM payloads WHERE exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='sector_valuation_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS (
      SELECT
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='rosterManifestHash') AS roster_hash,
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='taxonomyAssignmentManifestHash')
          AS taxonomy_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), dependencies AS (
      SELECT
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster'
        )::uuid AS roster_manifest_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment'
        )::uuid AS taxonomy_manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol
      FROM dependencies dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.roster_manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
      WHERE row.payload_json->>4='common_stock' AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
        AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (row.payload_json->>10 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz)
      ORDER BY row.payload_json->>2
      LIMIT 20001
    ), sectors AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.*,coalesce(sector.canonical_sector,'unknown') AS canonical_sector
      FROM roster
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT row.payload_json->>4 AS canonical_sector
        FROM dependencies dependency
        JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
          ON row.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
        WHERE (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=roster.stock_id
          AND row.payload_json->>10='active'
          AND (row.payload_json->>7)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
          AND (row.payload_json->>8 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>8)::timestamptz)
        ORDER BY row.row_ordinal LIMIT 2
      ) sector ON true
    ), methods AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'pe','pe_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
        (2,'pb_roe','pb_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
        (3,'ev_ebitda','ev_ebitda_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3),
        (4,'ev_sales','ev_sales_multiple'::public.financial_fact_key_v3)
      ) method(method_ordinal,method,fact_key)
    ), observations AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT sector.stock_id,sector.symbol,sector.canonical_sector,method.*,
        selected.value,selected.source_timestamp,selected.recorded_at,
        selected.source_ref,selected.filing_restatement_id,selected.value_count,
        roe.value AS roe
      FROM sectors sector CROSS JOIN methods method
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ranked.*,count(*) OVER () AS value_count
        FROM (
          SELECT fact.*,dense_rank() OVER (
            ORDER BY CASE fact.authority_tier WHEN 'official_filing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
              fact.filing_published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,
              fact.collected_at DESC,fact.recorded_at DESC,
              coalesce(fact.filing_restatement_id,'') DESC
          ) AS precedence_rank
          FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
          WHERE fact.stock_id=sector.stock_id AND fact.fact_key=method.fact_key
            AND fact.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
            AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY fact.period_end DESC,fact.filing_published_at DESC,
            fact.source_timestamp DESC,fact.recorded_at DESC,fact.fact_id
          LIMIT 101
        ) ranked
        WHERE ranked.precedence_rank=1
        ORDER BY ranked.source_ref LIMIT 1
      ) selected ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT fact.value
        FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
        WHERE fact.stock_id=sector.stock_id AND fact.fact_key='roe'
          AND fact.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
          AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY CASE fact.authority_tier WHEN 'official_filing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
          fact.period_end DESC,fact.filing_published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,
          fact.recorded_at DESC,fact.fact_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) roe ON true
    ), terminal AS (
      SELECT observations.*,
        CASE
          WHEN canonical_sector='unknown' THEN 'unknown_sector'
          WHEN value_count>1 THEN 'provider_conflict'
          WHEN value IS NULL THEN 'missing_observation'
          WHEN NOT (value>'-Infinity'::double precision AND value<'Infinity'::double precision)
            THEN 'non_finite_value'
          WHEN value<=0 THEN 'non_positive_multiple'
          WHEN method='pb_roe' AND (roe IS NULL OR roe<=0) THEN 'missing_positive_roe'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS exclusion_reason
      FROM observations
    ), included AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT terminal.*
      FROM terminal WHERE exclusion_reason IS NULL
    ), aggregate_values AS (
      SELECT canonical_sector,method,count(*)::integer AS included_count,
        percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS p10,
        percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS p50,
        percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS p90
      FROM included GROUP BY canonical_sector,method
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'included_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY method_ordinal,canonical_sector,symbol,source_timestamp,recorded_at,source_ref
        )-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,canonical_sector,method,value,
          CASE WHEN method='pb_roe' THEN roe ELSE NULL END,
          source_timestamp,recorded_at,source_ref,filing_restatement_id,
          (SELECT roster_hash FROM header),(SELECT taxonomy_hash FROM header)
        ) AS payload
      FROM included
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY exclusion_reason,method_ordinal,canonical_sector,symbol
        )-1,exclusion_reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,canonical_sector,method,exclusion_reason,
          source_timestamp,recorded_at,source_ref
        )
      FROM terminal WHERE exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'aggregate_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY canonical_sector,method
        )-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(canonical_sector,method,included_count,p10,p50,p90)
      FROM aggregate_values
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',method_ordinal-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          method,(SELECT count(*) FROM sectors),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason IS NULL),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'unknown_sector',count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason='unknown_sector'),
            'provider_conflict',count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason='provider_conflict'),
            'missing_observation',count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_observation'),
            'non_finite_value',count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason='non_finite_value'),
            'non_positive_multiple',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='non_positive_multiple'
            ),
            'missing_positive_roe',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_positive_roe'
            )
          )
        )
      FROM methods JOIN terminal USING(method_ordinal,method,fact_key)
      GROUP BY method_ordinal,method
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='factor_scoring_reference' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_symbol_count
    FROM (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=input.manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND input.input_role='instrument_roster' AND input.ordinal=0
        AND row.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
        AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
        AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (
          row.payload_json->10='null'::jsonb
          OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz
        )
      ORDER BY row.payload_json->>2,(row.payload_json->>1)::uuid
      LIMIT 20001
    ) bounded_roster;
    IF v_symbol_count>20000 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT409',MESSAGE='roster_volume_exceeded';
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS (
      SELECT
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='rosterManifestHash') AS roster_hash,
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='taxonomyAssignmentManifestHash')
          AS taxonomy_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster'
        )::uuid AS roster_manifest_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment'
        )::uuid AS taxonomy_manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
        ON manifest.manifest_id=input.manifest_id
        AND manifest.status='complete'
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND input.ordinal=0
        AND input.input_role IN ('instrument_roster','taxonomy_assignment')
      HAVING count(*)=2
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (instrument.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,
        instrument.payload_json->>2 AS symbol,
        (instrument.payload_json->>3)::public.stock_exchange_v3 AS exchange,
        coalesce(sector.canonical_sector_key,'unknown'::public.canonical_sector_key_v3)
          AS canonical_sector_key
      FROM dependencies dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 instrument
        ON instrument.manifest_id=dependency.roster_manifest_id
        AND instrument.section_key='rows'
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (taxonomy.payload_json->>4)::public.canonical_sector_key_v3
          AS canonical_sector_key
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 taxonomy
        WHERE taxonomy.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_manifest_id
          AND taxonomy.section_key='rows'
          AND (taxonomy.payload_json->>1)::uuid=(instrument.payload_json->>1)::uuid
          AND taxonomy.payload_json->>10='active'
          AND (taxonomy.payload_json->>7)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
          AND (
            taxonomy.payload_json->8='null'::jsonb
            OR v_cutoff<(taxonomy.payload_json->>8)::timestamptz
          )
        ORDER BY taxonomy.row_ordinal
        LIMIT 2
      ) sector ON true
      WHERE instrument.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
        AND instrument.payload_json->>5='active'
        AND (instrument.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (
          instrument.payload_json->10='null'::jsonb
          OR v_cutoff<(instrument.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz
        )
      ORDER BY instrument.payload_json->>2
      LIMIT 20000
    ), feature_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'volume_ratio_20d'),(2,'ma20_slope_5d'),
        (3,'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),(4,'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (5,'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (6,'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (7,'monthly_revenue_yoy'),(8,'revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'),
        (9,'quarterly_eps_yoy'),(10,'operating_margin_yoy_delta'),
        (11,'avg_turnover_20d'),(12,'zero_volume_sessions_20d')
      ) feature(feature_ordinal,feature_key)
    ), price_history AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.stock_id,history.observation_count,history.slope_observation_count,
        history.average_turnover,history.turnover_5d,
        history.zero_volume_count,history.volume_ratio_20d,history.ma20_slope_5d,
        history.latest_close,history.observed_at,history.source_ref,
        history.price_evidence
      FROM roster
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE selected.history_rank<=20)::integer
            AS observation_count,
          count(selected.adjusted_close)::integer AS slope_observation_count,
          avg(selected.turnover_twd) FILTER (
            WHERE selected.history_rank<=20
          )::double precision AS average_turnover,
          sum(selected.turnover_twd) FILTER (
            WHERE selected.history_rank<=5
          )::double precision AS turnover_5d,
          count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE selected.history_rank<=20 AND selected.volume=0
          )::double precision AS zero_volume_count,
          max(selected.volume) FILTER (WHERE selected.history_rank=1)
            / nullif(avg(selected.volume) FILTER (
              WHERE selected.history_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 21
            ),0) AS volume_ratio_20d,
          (
            avg(selected.adjusted_close) FILTER (
              WHERE selected.history_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            )
            / nullif(avg(selected.adjusted_close) FILTER (
              WHERE selected.history_rank BETWEEN 6 AND 25
            ),0)-1
          )*100 AS ma20_slope_5d,
          max(selected.adjusted_close) FILTER (WHERE selected.history_rank=1)
            AS latest_close,
          max(selected.source_timestamp) AS observed_at,
          encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_array(
              selected.session_id,selected.observation_id,selected.source_ref,
              selected.price_ref
            ) ORDER BY selected.history_rank
          )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS source_ref,
          jsonb_agg(selected.price_evidence ORDER BY selected.history_rank)
            FILTER (WHERE selected.price_evidence IS NOT NULL)
            AS price_evidence
        FROM (
          SELECT ranked.*,
            (adjusted.payload->'evidence'->>14)::double precision
              AS adjusted_close,
            adjusted.payload->'evidence' AS price_evidence,
            adjusted.payload->>'ref' AS price_ref
          FROM (
            SELECT terminal.*,
              row_number() OVER (ORDER BY terminal.session_id DESC) AS history_rank,
              max(terminal.session_id) OVER () AS anchor_session
            FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (price.session_id)
              price.observation_id,price.session_id,price.turnover_twd,price.volume,
              price.source_timestamp,price.source_ref
            FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 price
            WHERE price.stock_id=roster.stock_id
              AND price.exchange=roster.exchange
              AND price.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND price.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND price.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY price.session_id DESC,
              CASE WHEN price.provider::text=lower(roster.exchange::text)
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
              price.source_timestamp DESC,price.collected_at DESC,
              price.recorded_at DESC,price.source_ref,price.observation_id
            LIMIT 25
            ) terminal
          ) ranked
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
              ranked.observation_id,ranked.anchor_session,v_cutoff
            ) AS payload
          ) adjusted ON true
        ) selected
      ) history ON true
    ), chip_history AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.stock_id,feature.feature_key,selected.observed_at,
        CASE
          WHEN feature.feature_key='sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          THEN encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
            jsonb_build_array(selected.source_ref,history.source_ref)::text,
            ', ', ',', 'g'
          ),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
          ELSE selected.source_ref
        END AS source_ref,
        CASE feature.feature_key
          WHEN 'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN
            CASE WHEN selected.foreign_count=5
              THEN 100.0*selected.foreign_net_5d/nullif(history.turnover_5d,0) END
          WHEN 'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN
            CASE WHEN selected.trust_count=5
              THEN 100.0*selected.trust_net_5d/nullif(history.turnover_5d,0) END
          WHEN 'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN
            CASE WHEN selected.margin_count=6
              THEN 100.0*selected.margin_change_5d/nullif(history.turnover_5d,0) END
          WHEN 'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN
            CASE WHEN selected.sbl_count=6
              THEN 100.0*selected.sbl_change_5d*history.latest_close
                /nullif(history.turnover_5d,0) END
        END AS value
      FROM roster
      JOIN price_history history ON history.stock_id=roster.stock_id
      CROSS JOIN (VALUES
        ('foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        ('trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        ('margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        ('sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d')
      ) feature(feature_key)
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        WITH ranked_sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT session.session_id,session.session_authority_id,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY session.session_id DESC) AS session_rank
          FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (authority.session_id)
              authority.session_id,authority.session_authority_id
            FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 authority
            WHERE authority.market::text=roster.exchange::text
              AND authority.status='completed'
              AND authority.close_at<=v_cutoff
              AND authority.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND authority.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND authority.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY authority.session_id DESC,authority.recorded_at DESC,
              authority.source_timestamp DESC,authority.session_authority_id
            LIMIT 6
          ) session
        ), terminal AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT selected.*,expected.session_rank
          FROM ranked_sessions expected
          JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (observation.fact_key)
              observation.fact_key,observation.value,observation.source_timestamp,
              observation.source_ref,observation.provider,observation.recorded_at
            FROM public.opportunity_stock_flow_observations_v3 observation
            WHERE observation.stock_id=roster.stock_id
              AND observation.exchange=roster.exchange
              AND observation.session_id=expected.session_id
              AND observation.session_authority_id=expected.session_authority_id
              AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY observation.fact_key,
              CASE WHEN observation.provider::text=lower(roster.exchange::text)
                THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
              observation.source_timestamp DESC,observation.collected_at DESC,
              observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.source_ref,
              observation.observation_id
          ) selected ON true
        )
        SELECT
          count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='foreign_net_twd' AND session_rank<=5
          )::integer AS foreign_count,
          sum(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='foreign_net_twd' AND session_rank<=5
          )::double precision AS foreign_net_5d,
          count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='trust_net_twd' AND session_rank<=5
          )::integer AS trust_count,
          sum(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='trust_net_twd' AND session_rank<=5
          )::double precision AS trust_net_5d,
          count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='margin_financing_balance_twd'
          )::integer AS margin_count,
          max(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='margin_financing_balance_twd' AND session_rank=1
          ) - max(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='margin_financing_balance_twd' AND session_rank=6
          ) AS margin_change_5d,
          count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='sbl_short_balance_shares'
          )::integer AS sbl_count,
          max(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='sbl_short_balance_shares' AND session_rank=1
          ) - max(value) FILTER (
            WHERE fact_key='sbl_short_balance_shares' AND session_rank=6
          ) AS sbl_change_5d,
          max(source_timestamp) AS observed_at,
          encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_array(fact_key,session_rank,provider,source_ref)
            ORDER BY fact_key,session_rank,provider,source_ref
          )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS source_ref
        FROM terminal
      ) selected ON true
    ), financial_history AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.stock_id,computed.monthly_revenue_yoy,
        computed.revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m,computed.quarterly_eps_yoy,
        computed.operating_margin_yoy_delta,computed.monthly_count,
        computed.quarterly_eps_count,computed.margin_period_count,
        computed.monthly_observed_at,computed.quarterly_observed_at,
        computed.monthly_source_ref,computed.quarterly_source_ref
      FROM roster
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        WITH monthly AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT selected.*,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY selected.period_end DESC) AS history_rank
          FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (fact.period_end)
              fact.period_end,
              CASE fact.unit
                WHEN 'TWD_thousand' THEN fact.value*1000
                WHEN 'TWD_million' THEN fact.value*1000000
                ELSE fact.value END AS normalized_value,
              fact.source_timestamp,fact.source_ref
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
            WHERE fact.stock_id=roster.stock_id
              AND fact.fact_key='monthly_revenue'
              AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY fact.period_end DESC,
              CASE fact.authority_tier WHEN 'official_filing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
              fact.filing_published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,
              fact.collected_at DESC,fact.recorded_at DESC,
              coalesce(fact.filing_restatement_id,'') DESC,
              fact.source_ref,fact.fact_id
            LIMIT 16
          ) selected
        ), monthly_yoy AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT current.history_rank,
            100*(current.normalized_value/prior.normalized_value-1) AS yoy,
            current.source_timestamp,current.source_ref
          FROM monthly current
          JOIN monthly prior ON prior.history_rank=current.history_rank+12
          WHERE current.history_rank<=4 AND prior.normalized_value>0
        ), quarterly AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT selected.*,
            row_number() OVER (
              PARTITION BY selected.fact_key ORDER BY selected.period_end DESC
            ) AS history_rank
          FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (fact.fact_key,fact.period_end)
              fact.fact_key,fact.period_end,
              CASE fact.unit
                WHEN 'TWD_thousand' THEN fact.value*1000
                WHEN 'TWD_million' THEN fact.value*1000000
                ELSE fact.value END AS normalized_value,
              fact.source_timestamp,fact.source_ref
            FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
            WHERE fact.stock_id=roster.stock_id
              AND fact.fact_key IN (
                'quarterly_revenue','quarterly_operating_income',
                'quarterly_diluted_eps'
              )
              AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY fact.fact_key,fact.period_end DESC,
              CASE fact.authority_tier WHEN 'official_filing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
              fact.filing_published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,
              fact.collected_at DESC,fact.recorded_at DESC,
              coalesce(fact.filing_restatement_id,'') DESC,
              fact.source_ref,fact.fact_id
            LIMIT 18
          ) selected
        )
        SELECT
          max(monthly_yoy.yoy) FILTER (WHERE monthly_yoy.history_rank=1)
            AS monthly_revenue_yoy,
          max(monthly_yoy.yoy) FILTER (WHERE monthly_yoy.history_rank=1)
            - avg(monthly_yoy.yoy) FILTER (
              WHERE monthly_yoy.history_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 4
            ) AS revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m,
          100*(
            max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_diluted_eps'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=1
            )
            / nullif(max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_diluted_eps'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=5
            ),0)-1
          ) AS quarterly_eps_yoy,
          100*(
            max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_operating_income'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=1
            )
            / nullif(max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_revenue'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=1
            ),0)
            - max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_operating_income'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=5
            )
            / nullif(max(quarterly.normalized_value) FILTER (
              WHERE quarterly.fact_key='quarterly_revenue'
                AND quarterly.history_rank=5
            ),0)
          ) AS operating_margin_yoy_delta,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM monthly_yoy)::integer AS monthly_count,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM quarterly
            WHERE fact_key='quarterly_diluted_eps')::integer
            AS quarterly_eps_count,
          count(DISTINCT quarterly.period_end) FILTER (
            WHERE quarterly.fact_key IN (
              'quarterly_revenue','quarterly_operating_income'
            )
          )::integer AS margin_period_count,
          (SELECT max(source_timestamp) FROM monthly_yoy) AS monthly_observed_at,
          max(quarterly.source_timestamp) AS quarterly_observed_at,
          (SELECT min(source_ref) FROM monthly_yoy) AS monthly_source_ref,
          min(quarterly.source_ref) AS quarterly_source_ref
        FROM monthly_yoy FULL JOIN quarterly ON true
      ) computed ON true
    ), terminal AS (
      SELECT feature.feature_ordinal,feature.feature_key,roster.symbol,
        roster.canonical_sector_key,
        CASE WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
          'monthly_revenue_yoy','revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'
        ) THEN financial.monthly_observed_at
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'quarterly_eps_yoy','operating_margin_yoy_delta'
          ) THEN financial.quarterly_observed_at
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          ) THEN chip.observed_at
          ELSE history.observed_at END AS observed_at,
        CASE WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
          'monthly_revenue_yoy','revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'
        ) THEN financial.monthly_source_ref
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'quarterly_eps_yoy','operating_margin_yoy_delta'
          ) THEN financial.quarterly_source_ref
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          ) THEN chip.source_ref
          ELSE history.source_ref END AS source_ref,
        CASE
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'ma20_slope_5d','sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          ) THEN history.price_evidence
          ELSE NULL
        END AS price_evidence,
        CASE feature.feature_key
          WHEN 'volume_ratio_20d' THEN
            CASE WHEN history.observation_count=20 THEN history.volume_ratio_20d END
          WHEN 'ma20_slope_5d' THEN
            CASE WHEN history.slope_observation_count=25 THEN history.ma20_slope_5d END
          WHEN 'avg_turnover_20d' THEN
            CASE WHEN history.observation_count=20 THEN history.average_turnover END
          WHEN 'zero_volume_sessions_20d' THEN
            CASE WHEN history.observation_count=20 THEN history.zero_volume_count END
          WHEN 'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN chip.value
          WHEN 'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN chip.value
          WHEN 'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN chip.value
          WHEN 'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d' THEN chip.value
          WHEN 'monthly_revenue_yoy' THEN
            CASE WHEN financial.monthly_count>=1
              THEN financial.monthly_revenue_yoy END
          WHEN 'revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m' THEN
            CASE WHEN financial.monthly_count=4
              THEN financial.revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m END
          WHEN 'quarterly_eps_yoy' THEN
            CASE WHEN financial.quarterly_eps_count>=5
              THEN financial.quarterly_eps_yoy END
          WHEN 'operating_margin_yoy_delta' THEN
            CASE WHEN financial.margin_period_count>=2
              THEN financial.operating_margin_yoy_delta END
          ELSE NULL
        END AS value,
        CASE
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'volume_ratio_20d','ma20_slope_5d',
            'avg_turnover_20d','zero_volume_sessions_20d'
          )
            AND (
              CASE WHEN feature.feature_key='ma20_slope_5d'
                THEN coalesce(history.slope_observation_count,0)<25
                ELSE coalesce(history.observation_count,0)<20
              END
            ) THEN 'insufficient_history'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'volume_ratio_20d','ma20_slope_5d',
            'avg_turnover_20d','zero_volume_sessions_20d'
          ) AND (
            CASE feature.feature_key
              WHEN 'volume_ratio_20d' THEN history.volume_ratio_20d
              WHEN 'ma20_slope_5d' THEN history.ma20_slope_5d
              WHEN 'avg_turnover_20d' THEN history.average_turnover
              ELSE history.zero_volume_count
            END
          ) IS NULL THEN 'non_positive_denominator'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'volume_ratio_20d','ma20_slope_5d',
            'avg_turnover_20d','zero_volume_sessions_20d'
          )
            THEN NULL
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          ) AND chip.value IS NULL THEN 'missing_observation'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d',
            'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'
          ) THEN NULL
          WHEN feature.feature_key='monthly_revenue_yoy'
            AND coalesce(financial.monthly_count,0)<1 THEN 'insufficient_history'
          WHEN feature.feature_key='revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'
            AND coalesce(financial.monthly_count,0)<4 THEN 'insufficient_history'
          WHEN feature.feature_key='quarterly_eps_yoy'
            AND coalesce(financial.quarterly_eps_count,0)<5 THEN 'insufficient_history'
          WHEN feature.feature_key='operating_margin_yoy_delta'
            AND coalesce(financial.margin_period_count,0)<2 THEN 'insufficient_history'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'monthly_revenue_yoy','revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'
          ) AND financial.monthly_observed_at<v_cutoff-interval '45 days'
            THEN 'stale_observation'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'quarterly_eps_yoy','operating_margin_yoy_delta'
          ) AND financial.quarterly_observed_at<v_cutoff-interval '135 days'
            THEN 'stale_observation'
          WHEN feature.feature_key IN (
            'monthly_revenue_yoy','revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m',
            'quarterly_eps_yoy','operating_margin_yoy_delta'
          ) THEN NULL
          ELSE 'missing_observation'
        END AS reason
      FROM feature_keys feature CROSS JOIN roster
      LEFT JOIN price_history history ON history.stock_id=roster.stock_id
      LEFT JOIN chip_history chip ON chip.stock_id=roster.stock_id
        AND chip.feature_key=feature.feature_key
      LEFT JOIN financial_history financial ON financial.stock_id=roster.stock_id
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'included_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY terminal.feature_ordinal,terminal.symbol
        )-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          terminal.feature_key,terminal.symbol,terminal.canonical_sector_key,
          terminal.value,terminal.observed_at,terminal.source_ref,
          'official',(SELECT roster_hash FROM header),(SELECT taxonomy_hash FROM header),
          terminal.price_evidence
        ) AS payload
      FROM terminal WHERE terminal.value IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY terminal.feature_ordinal,terminal.symbol
        )-1,
        terminal.reason,jsonb_build_array(
          terminal.feature_key,terminal.symbol,terminal.reason,
          terminal.observed_at,terminal.source_ref
        )
      FROM terminal WHERE terminal.value IS NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',feature.feature_ordinal-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          feature.feature_key,(SELECT count(*) FROM roster),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE terminal.value IS NOT NULL),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE terminal.value IS NULL),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'provider_conflict',0,'future_observation',0,'stale_observation',0,
            'insufficient_history',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE terminal.reason='insufficient_history'
            ),
            'missing_observation',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE terminal.reason='missing_observation'
            ),
            'non_finite_value',0,'non_positive_denominator',0
          )
        )
      FROM feature_keys feature
      LEFT JOIN terminal ON terminal.feature_key=feature.feature_key
      GROUP BY feature.feature_ordinal,feature.feature_key
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='bias_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT max((pair->>1)::date) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='asOfSession') AS as_of_session
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster')::uuid AS roster_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment')::uuid AS taxonomy_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id AND input.ordinal=0
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol,
        (row.payload_json->>3)::public.stock_exchange_v3 AS exchange,
        coalesce(sector.canonical_sector,'unknown') AS canonical_sector
      FROM dependencies dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row ON row.manifest_id=dependency.roster_id
        AND row.section_key='rows' AND row.terminal_code='effective_active'
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT taxonomy.payload_json->>4 AS canonical_sector
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 taxonomy
        WHERE taxonomy.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_id AND taxonomy.section_key='rows'
          AND taxonomy.terminal_code='effective_active'
          AND taxonomy.payload_json->>1=row.payload_json->>1
        ORDER BY taxonomy.row_ordinal LIMIT 1
      ) sector ON true
      WHERE row.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
      ORDER BY canonical_sector,row.payload_json->>2,row.payload_json->>1
      LIMIT 20001
    ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.*,history.observation_count,history.ma20,history.atr14,
        history.adjusted_close,history.price_ref
      FROM roster
      CROSS JOIN header
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*)::integer AS observation_count,
          avg((sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision) FILTER (WHERE sample.history_rank<=20) AS ma20,
          avg(greatest(
            (sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,12}')::double precision-(sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,13}')::double precision,
            abs((sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,12}')::double precision-lag_close),
            abs((sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,13}')::double precision-lag_close)
          )) FILTER (WHERE sample.history_rank<=14) AS atr14,
          max((sample.evidence#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision) FILTER (WHERE sample.history_rank=1) AS adjusted_close,
          max(sample.evidence->>'ref') FILTER (WHERE sample.history_rank=1) AS price_ref
        FROM (
          SELECT terminal.*,adjusted.payload AS evidence,
            lag((adjusted.payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY terminal.session_id) AS lag_close
          FROM (
            SELECT chosen.*,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY chosen.session_id DESC) AS history_rank,
              max(chosen.session_id) OVER () AS anchor_session
            FROM (
              SELECT DISTINCT ON (price.session_id) price.*
              FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 price
              WHERE price.stock_id=roster.stock_id AND price.exchange=roster.exchange
                AND price.session_id<=header.as_of_session AND price.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
                AND price.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND price.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              ORDER BY price.session_id DESC,price.source_timestamp DESC,price.collected_at DESC,
                price.recorded_at DESC,price.source_ref,price.observation_id
              LIMIT 120
            ) chosen
          ) terminal
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
            terminal.observation_id,terminal.anchor_session,v_cutoff) AS payload) adjusted ON true
        ) sample
      ) history ON true
    ), included AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT *,100.0*(adjusted_close/nullif(ma20,0)-1.0) AS bias20_pct,
        (adjusted_close-ma20)/nullif(atr14,0) AS bias20_atr
      FROM selected WHERE observation_count=120 AND ma20>0 AND atr14>0 AND adjusted_close>0
        AND price_ref IS NOT NULL
    ), sector_aggregate AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT canonical_sector,count(*)::integer AS member_count,
        percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY bias20_pct) AS p10,
        percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY bias20_pct) AS p25,
        percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY bias20_pct) AS p50,
        percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY bias20_pct) AS p75,
        percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY bias20_pct) AS p90
      FROM included GROUP BY canonical_sector
    ), rows_by_section AS (
      SELECT 'current_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        canonical_sector AS sort_a,symbol AS sort_b,
        jsonb_build_array(stock_id,symbol,canonical_sector,header.as_of_session,bias20_pct,bias20_atr,
          ma20,atr14,price_ref,'tw-corporate-action-v3.1') AS payload,
        NULL::text AS terminal_code
      FROM included CROSS JOIN header
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',canonical_sector,symbol,
        jsonb_build_array(stock_id,symbol,CASE WHEN observation_count<120 THEN 'insufficient_technical_history'
          ELSE 'invalid_adjusted_history' END),
        CASE WHEN observation_count<120 THEN 'insufficient_technical_history' ELSE 'invalid_adjusted_history' END
      FROM selected WHERE NOT (observation_count=120 AND ma20>0 AND atr14>0 AND adjusted_close>0 AND price_ref IS NOT NULL)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_rows',canonical_sector,'',jsonb_build_array(canonical_sector,header.as_of_session,
        member_count,p10,p25,p50,p75,p90),NULL
      FROM sector_aggregate CROSS JOIN header
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation','1','',jsonb_build_array('roster_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM roster)),NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation','2','',jsonb_build_array('included_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM included)),NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation','3','',jsonb_build_array('excluded_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected)-(SELECT count(*) FROM included)),NULL
    ), ordered AS (
      SELECT rows_by_section.section_key,rows_by_section.terminal_code,rows_by_section.payload,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY section_key ORDER BY sort_a,sort_b,payload::text)-1 AS ordinal
      FROM rows_by_section
    )
    SELECT ordered.ordinal,ordered.terminal_code,ordered.payload FROM ordered
    WHERE ordered.section_key=requested_section AND ordered.ordinal>=requested_offset
    ORDER BY ordered.ordinal LIMIT requested_limit;
  ELSIF requested_kind='technical_history_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT max((pair->>1)::date) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='asOfSession') AS as_of_session,
        (max((pair->1)::text) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='orderedDeepSymbols'))::jsonb AS symbols
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), symbols AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT value AS symbol,(ordinal-1)::integer AS symbol_ordinal
      FROM header CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(header.symbols) WITH ORDINALITY item(value,ordinal)
      ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 21
    ), instruments AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT symbols.*,instrument.stock_id,instrument.exchange
      FROM symbols
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT selected.stock_id,selected.exchange
        FROM public.stock_instruments_v3 selected
        WHERE selected.symbol=symbols.symbol AND selected.instrument_type='common_stock'
          AND selected.listing_status='active' AND selected.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          AND selected.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND selected.valid_from<=v_cutoff
          AND (selected.valid_to IS NULL OR v_cutoff<selected.valid_to)
        ORDER BY selected.recorded_at DESC,selected.source_timestamp DESC,selected.instrument_authority_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) instrument ON true
    ), terminal_prices AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT instrument.symbol,instrument.symbol_ordinal,instrument.stock_id,instrument.exchange,
        price.observation_id,price.session_id,price.volume,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument.symbol ORDER BY price.session_id)-1 AS chronological_ordinal,
        count(price.observation_id) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument.symbol) AS observation_count
      FROM instruments instrument CROSS JOIN header
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT bounded.* FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT ON (candidate.session_id) candidate.*
          FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 candidate
          WHERE candidate.stock_id=instrument.stock_id AND candidate.exchange=instrument.exchange
            AND candidate.session_id<header.as_of_session AND candidate.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            AND candidate.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND candidate.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY candidate.session_id DESC,candidate.source_timestamp DESC,candidate.collected_at DESC,
            candidate.recorded_at DESC,candidate.source_ref,candidate.observation_id
          LIMIT 877
        ) bounded ORDER BY bounded.session_id
      ) price ON true
    ), blocked AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT symbol,symbol_ordinal,max(observation_count)::integer AS observation_count
      FROM terminal_prices GROUP BY symbol,symbol_ordinal
      HAVING max(observation_count)<371 OR count(observation_id)=0
    ), owner_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT terminal_prices.*,
        (((observation_count-1)/132)-((observation_count-1-chronological_ordinal)/132))::integer AS block_ordinal
      FROM terminal_prices WHERE symbol NOT IN (SELECT symbol FROM blocked)
    ), block_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT symbol,block_ordinal,min(chronological_ordinal) AS owner_start_ordinal,
        max(chronological_ordinal) AS owner_end_ordinal,max(session_id) AS anchor_session
      FROM owner_rows GROUP BY symbol,block_ordinal
    ), block_members AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT price.*,definition.block_ordinal,definition.owner_start_ordinal,
        definition.owner_end_ordinal,definition.anchor_session,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY price.symbol,definition.block_ordinal ORDER BY price.session_id)-1 AS within_block
      FROM block_definitions definition
      JOIN terminal_prices price ON price.symbol=definition.symbol
        AND price.chronological_ordinal BETWEEN greatest(0,definition.owner_start_ordinal-120)
          AND definition.owner_end_ordinal
    ), adjusted AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT block_members.*,price.payload,
        (price.payload#>>'{evidence,11}')::double precision AS adjusted_open,
        (price.payload#>>'{evidence,12}')::double precision AS adjusted_high,
        (price.payload#>>'{evidence,13}')::double precision AS adjusted_low,
        (price.payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision AS adjusted_close,
        block_members.volume/nullif((price.payload#>>'{evidence,10}')::double precision,0) AS adjusted_volume
      FROM block_members
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
        block_members.observation_id,block_members.anchor_session,v_cutoff) AS payload) price ON true
    ), invalid_symbols AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM adjusted WHERE payload IS NULL OR adjusted_open<=0 OR adjusted_high<=0
        OR adjusted_low<=0 OR adjusted_close<=0 OR adjusted_volume IS NULL OR adjusted_volume<0
    ), valid AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT adjusted.*,
        avg(adjusted_close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol,block_ordinal ORDER BY session_id ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma20,
        avg(adjusted_close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol,block_ordinal ORDER BY session_id ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma60,
        avg(adjusted_close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol,block_ordinal ORDER BY session_id ROWS BETWEEN 119 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma120,
        avg(greatest(adjusted_high-adjusted_low,
          abs(adjusted_high-lag_close),abs(adjusted_low-lag_close))) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol,block_ordinal ORDER BY session_id ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS atr14
      FROM (
        SELECT adjusted.*,lag(adjusted_close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol,block_ordinal ORDER BY session_id) AS lag_close
        FROM adjusted WHERE symbol NOT IN (SELECT symbol FROM invalid_symbols)
      ) adjusted
    ), benchmark_ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT observation.session_id,observation.value,observation.source_ref,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY observation.session_id ORDER BY observation.observed_at DESC,
          observation.collected_at DESC,observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.source_ref,observation.observation_id) AS precedence
      FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation CROSS JOIN header
      WHERE observation.fact_key='taiex_close' AND observation.scope_key='TAIEX'
        AND observation.session_id<header.as_of_session AND observation.value>0
        AND observation.observed_at<=v_cutoff AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff
        AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
    ), benchmark AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT selected.* FROM (
        SELECT * FROM benchmark_ranked WHERE precedence=1 ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 122
      ) selected ORDER BY selected.session_id
    ), rows_by_section AS (
      SELECT 'market_benchmark_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
