        -1 AS sort_a,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY session_id)::integer AS sort_b,
        jsonb_build_array(session_id,value,source_ref) AS payload,NULL::text AS terminal_code
      FROM benchmark
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'raw_adjusted_rows',
        symbol_ordinal AS sort_a,chronological_ordinal AS sort_b,
        jsonb_build_array(symbol,block_ordinal,anchor_session,within_block,session_id,
          adjusted_open,adjusted_high,adjusted_low,adjusted_close,payload->'evidence',adjusted_volume) AS payload,
        NULL::text AS terminal_code
      FROM valid
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'history_rows',symbol_ordinal,chronological_ordinal,
        jsonb_build_array(symbol,chronological_ordinal-119,session_id,
          100.0*(adjusted_close/nullif(ma20,0)-1.0),100.0*(adjusted_close/nullif(ma60,0)-1.0),
          100.0*(adjusted_close/nullif(ma120,0)-1.0),(adjusted_close-ma20)/nullif(atr14,0)),NULL
      FROM valid WHERE chronological_ordinal BETWEEN owner_start_ordinal AND owner_end_ordinal
        AND within_block>=119 AND ma20>0 AND ma60>0 AND ma120>0 AND atr14>0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',symbol_ordinal,0,jsonb_build_array(symbol,'insufficient_technical_history',observation_count),
        'insufficient_technical_history' FROM blocked
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',instrument.symbol_ordinal,0,jsonb_build_array(instrument.symbol,'invalid_adjusted_history',0),
        'invalid_adjusted_history' FROM instruments instrument WHERE instrument.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM invalid_symbols)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',1,0,jsonb_build_array('planned_symbol_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM symbols)),NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',2,0,jsonb_build_array('terminal_symbol_count',(SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol) FROM valid)
        +(SELECT count(*) FROM blocked)+(SELECT count(*) FROM invalid_symbols)),NULL
    ), ordered AS (
      SELECT rows_by_section.section_key,rows_by_section.terminal_code,rows_by_section.payload,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY section_key ORDER BY sort_a,sort_b,payload::text)-1 AS ordinal
      FROM rows_by_section
    )
    SELECT ordered.ordinal,ordered.terminal_code,ordered.payload FROM ordered
    WHERE ordered.section_key=requested_section AND ordered.ordinal>=requested_offset
    ORDER BY ordered.ordinal LIMIT requested_limit;
  ELSIF requested_kind='reported_pe_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT max((pair->>1)::date) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='asOfSession') AS as_of_session,
        (max((pair->1)::text) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='orderedDeepSymbols'))::jsonb AS symbols
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster')::uuid AS roster_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment')::uuid AS taxonomy_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id AND input.ordinal=0
    ), deep_symbols AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT value AS symbol,(ordinal-1)::integer AS symbol_ordinal
      FROM header CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(header.symbols) WITH ORDINALITY item(value,ordinal)
      ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 21
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol,
        row.payload_json->>3 AS exchange,coalesce(sector.canonical_sector,'unknown') AS canonical_sector
      FROM dependencies dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row ON row.manifest_id=dependency.roster_id
        AND row.section_key='rows' AND row.terminal_code='effective_active'
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT taxonomy.payload_json->>4 AS canonical_sector
        FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 taxonomy
        WHERE taxonomy.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_id AND taxonomy.section_key='rows'
          AND taxonomy.terminal_code='effective_active' AND taxonomy.payload_json->>1=row.payload_json->>1
        ORDER BY taxonomy.row_ordinal LIMIT 1
      ) sector ON true
      WHERE row.payload_json->>4='common_stock'
      ORDER BY canonical_sector,row.payload_json->>2,row.payload_json->>1 LIMIT 20001
    ), own_history AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.stock_id,roster.symbol,roster.exchange,fact.session_date AS session,
        session.session_authority_id,fact.reported_pe,price.adjusted_close AS close,
        fact.source_ref,fact.published_at AS filing_published_at,fact.source_timestamp,fact.collected_at,fact.recorded_at,
        deep.symbol_ordinal,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY roster.symbol ORDER BY fact.session_date DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,fact.reported_pe_id) AS history_rank
      FROM deep_symbols deep
      JOIN roster ON roster.symbol=deep.symbol
      JOIN public.opportunity_exchange_reported_pe_v3 fact ON fact.stock_id=roster.stock_id
        AND fact.exchange::text=roster.exchange AND fact.reported_pe>0
        AND fact.session_date<=(SELECT as_of_session FROM header)
        AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.published_at<=v_cutoff
        AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT selected.session_authority_id FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 selected
        WHERE selected.session_id=fact.session_date AND selected.market::text=roster.exchange
          AND selected.status='completed' AND selected.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND selected.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY selected.recorded_at DESC,selected.source_timestamp DESC,selected.session_authority_id LIMIT 1
      ) session ON true
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (adjusted.payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision AS adjusted_close
        FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 observation
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
          observation.observation_id,fact.session_date,v_cutoff) AS payload) adjusted
        WHERE observation.stock_id=roster.stock_id AND observation.session_id=fact.session_date
          AND observation.session_authority_id=session.session_authority_id AND adjusted.payload IS NOT NULL
          AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff ORDER BY observation.source_timestamp DESC,
          observation.collected_at DESC,observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.observation_id LIMIT 1
      ) price ON true
    ), own_bounded AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM own_history WHERE history_rank<=1260
    ), current_plane AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.*,pe.reported_pe,pe.source_ref AS pe_source_ref,pe.recorded_at AS pe_recorded_at,
        price.adjusted_close AS close,price.session_authority_id,
        shares.value AS shares_outstanding,shares.period_end AS shares_period_end,
        shares.source_ref AS shares_source_ref,shares.source_timestamp AS shares_source_timestamp
      FROM roster CROSS JOIN header
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT fact.reported_pe,fact.source_ref,fact.recorded_at
        FROM public.opportunity_exchange_reported_pe_v3 fact
        WHERE fact.stock_id=roster.stock_id AND fact.exchange::text=roster.exchange
          AND fact.reported_pe>0 AND fact.session_date=header.as_of_session
          AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.published_at<=v_cutoff
          AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY fact.published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,fact.collected_at DESC,
          fact.recorded_at DESC,fact.source_ref,fact.reported_pe_id LIMIT 1
      ) pe ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (adjusted.payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision AS adjusted_close,
          observation.session_authority_id
        FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 observation
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
          observation.observation_id,header.as_of_session,v_cutoff) AS payload) adjusted
        WHERE observation.stock_id=roster.stock_id AND observation.session_id=header.as_of_session
          AND observation.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND observation.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
          AND observation.collected_at<=v_cutoff AND adjusted.payload IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY observation.source_timestamp DESC,observation.collected_at DESC,
          observation.recorded_at DESC,observation.observation_id LIMIT 1
      ) price ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT fact.value,fact.period_end,fact.source_ref,fact.source_timestamp
        FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
        WHERE fact.stock_id=roster.stock_id AND fact.fact_key='shares_outstanding'
          AND fact.estimate_kind='reported' AND fact.value>0 AND fact.period_end<=header.as_of_session
          AND fact.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND fact.filing_published_at<=v_cutoff
          AND fact.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND fact.collected_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY fact.period_end DESC,fact.filing_published_at DESC,fact.source_timestamp DESC,
          fact.recorded_at DESC,fact.fact_id LIMIT 1
      ) shares ON true
    ), sector_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM current_plane WHERE reported_pe>0 AND close>0 AND shares_outstanding>0
    ), sector_aggregate AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT canonical_sector,count(*)::integer AS member_count,
        percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reported_pe) AS p25,
        percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reported_pe) AS p50,
        percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reported_pe) AS p75,
        sum(reported_pe*close*shares_outstanding)/nullif(sum(close*shares_outstanding),0) AS cap_weighted
      FROM sector_eligible GROUP BY canonical_sector HAVING count(*)>=8
    ), deep_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT deep.symbol,deep.symbol_ordinal,count(own_bounded.stock_id)::integer AS own_count
      FROM deep_symbols deep LEFT JOIN own_bounded ON own_bounded.symbol=deep.symbol
      GROUP BY deep.symbol,deep.symbol_ordinal
    ), rows_by_section AS (
      SELECT 'own_history_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        symbol_ordinal AS sort_a,history_rank AS sort_b,
        jsonb_build_array(stock_id,symbol,exchange,session,session_authority_id,reported_pe,close,
          source_ref,filing_published_at,source_timestamp,collected_at,recorded_at) AS payload,NULL::text AS terminal_code
      FROM own_bounded
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_current_rows',row_number() OVER (ORDER BY canonical_sector,symbol,stock_id)::integer,0,
        jsonb_build_array(stock_id,symbol,canonical_sector,exchange,header.as_of_session,session_authority_id,
          reported_pe,close,shares_outstanding,shares_period_end,shares_source_ref,shares_source_timestamp,
          pe_source_ref,pe_recorded_at),NULL
      FROM sector_eligible CROSS JOIN header
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',symbol_ordinal,0,jsonb_build_array(symbol,'insufficient_reported_pe_history',own_count),
        'insufficient_reported_pe_history' FROM deep_counts WHERE own_count<252
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',20001+row_number() OVER (ORDER BY canonical_sector,symbol)::integer,0,
        jsonb_build_array(symbol,CASE WHEN reported_pe IS NULL THEN 'reported_pe_unavailable'
          WHEN close IS NULL THEN 'price_unavailable' ELSE 'shares_unavailable' END),
        CASE WHEN reported_pe IS NULL THEN 'reported_pe_unavailable'
          WHEN close IS NULL THEN 'price_unavailable' ELSE 'shares_unavailable' END
      FROM current_plane WHERE NOT (reported_pe>0 AND close>0 AND shares_outstanding>0)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_rows',row_number() OVER (ORDER BY canonical_sector)::integer,0,
        jsonb_build_array(canonical_sector,header.as_of_session,member_count,p25,p50,p75,cap_weighted),NULL
      FROM sector_aggregate CROSS JOIN header
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',1,0,jsonb_build_array('deep_symbol_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM deep_symbols)),NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',2,0,jsonb_build_array('roster_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM roster)),NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',3,0,jsonb_build_array('sector_eligible_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM sector_eligible)),NULL
    ), ordered AS (
      SELECT rows_by_section.section_key,rows_by_section.terminal_code,rows_by_section.payload,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY section_key ORDER BY sort_a,sort_b,payload::text)-1 AS ordinal
      FROM rows_by_section
    )
    SELECT ordered.ordinal,ordered.terminal_code,ordered.payload FROM ordered
    WHERE ordered.section_key=requested_section AND ordered.ordinal>=requested_offset
    ORDER BY ordered.ordinal LIMIT requested_limit;
  ELSIF requested_kind='market_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
      SELECT symbol.value AS symbol,(symbol.ordinal-1)::integer AS symbol_ordinal
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(pair->1)
        WITH ORDINALITY symbol(value,ordinal)
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
        AND pair->>0='orderedCandidateSymbols'
      ORDER BY symbol.ordinal LIMIT 21
    ), candidate_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'sector_excess_return_5d'),(2,'sector_excess_return_20d'),
        (3,'volume_ratio_20d'),(4,'ma20_slope_5d'),
        (5,'foreign_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (6,'trust_net_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (7,'margin_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (8,'sbl_short_balance_change_5d_over_turnover_5d'),
        (9,'monthly_revenue_yoy'),(10,'revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'),
        (11,'quarterly_eps_yoy'),(12,'operating_margin_yoy_delta'),
        (13,'avg_turnover_20d'),(14,'zero_volume_sessions_20d')
      ) key(key_ordinal,input_key)
    ), market_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'taiex_close','TAIEX'),(2,'taiex_ma20','TAIEX'),(3,'taiex_ma60','TAIEX'),
        (4,'otc_close','OTC'),(5,'otc_ma20','OTC'),(6,'otc_ma60','OTC'),
        (7,'active_common_above_ma20_pct','TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        (8,'active_common_above_ma60_pct','TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        (9,'foreign_cash_net_5d','TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        (10,'investment_trust_net_5d','TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        (11,'aggregate_margin_balance_change_5d','TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        (12,'foreign_index_futures_net_oi','TAIFEX'),
        (13,'put_call_ratio','TAIFEX'),(14,'taiwan_vix','TAIFEX'),
        (15,'sox_return_5d','SOX'),(16,'nasdaq_return_5d','NASDAQ'),
        (17,'usd_twd_return_5d','USD_TWD')
      ) key(key_ordinal,input_key,scope_key)
    ), sector_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'sector_return_5d'),(2,'sector_return_20d'),(3,'sector_return_60d'),
        (4,'sector_excess_return_20d'),(5,'sector_excess_return_60d'),
        (6,'sector_ad_breadth_20d'),(7,'sector_revenue_yoy_median'),
        (8,'sector_eps_yoy_median'),(9,'sector_revenue_acceleration_median'),
        (10,'sector_operating_margin_delta_median')
      ) key(key_ordinal,input_key)
    ), dependency_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'candidate_financial'),(2,'factor_scoring_reference'),
        (3,'sector_scoring_reference'),(4,'sector_valuation_reference'),
        (5,'peer_authority'),(6,'mover_price_reference')
      ) dependency(key_ordinal,input_key)
    ), dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT key.key_ordinal,key.input_key,manifest.manifest_id,manifest.manifest_hash
      FROM dependency_keys key
      JOIN public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
        ON input.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND input.input_role=key.input_key::public.opportunity_manifest_kind_v3
        AND (
          key.input_key<>'mover_price_reference' OR input.ordinal=0
        )
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
        ON manifest.manifest_id=input.manifest_id AND manifest.status='complete'
    ), candidate_sectors AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(row.payload_json->>2,sector_row.payload_json->>2)
        AS canonical_sector
      FROM candidates candidate
      JOIN public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
        ON input.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND input.input_role='factor_scoring_reference' AND input.ordinal=0
      LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=input.manifest_id AND row.section_key='included_rows'
        AND row.payload_json->>1=candidate.symbol
      LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs sector_binding
        ON sector_binding.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND sector_binding.input_role='sector_scoring_reference'
        AND sector_binding.ordinal=0
      LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 sector_row
        ON sector_row.manifest_id=sector_binding.manifest_id
        AND sector_row.section_key IN (
          'sector_excess_included_rows','sector_excess_excluded_rows'
        )
        AND sector_row.payload_json->>1=candidate.symbol
      WHERE coalesce(row.payload_json->>2,sector_row.payload_json->>2)<>'unknown'
    ), expected AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT 1 AS family_ordinal,'candidate_factor' AS input_family,
        key.key_ordinal,key.input_key,candidate.symbol AS scope_key,
        candidate.symbol
      FROM candidate_keys key CROSS JOIN candidates candidate
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 2,'market_context',key_ordinal,input_key,scope_key,NULL
      FROM market_keys
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 3,'sector_context',key.key_ordinal,key.input_key,
        sector.canonical_sector,NULL
      FROM sector_keys key CROSS JOIN candidate_sectors sector
    ), candidate_available AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT expected.*, percentile.score AS value,
        row.payload_json->>4 AS observed_at,row.payload_json->>5 AS source_ref,
        row.payload_json->>6 AS authority_tier,dependency.manifest_hash
      FROM expected
      JOIN dependencies dependency
        ON dependency.input_key='factor_scoring_reference'
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.manifest_id
        AND row.section_key='included_rows'
        AND row.payload_json->>0=expected.input_key
        AND row.payload_json->>1=expected.symbol
      JOIN LATERAL (
        WITH population AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT (reference.payload_json->>3)::double precision AS value
          FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 reference
          WHERE reference.manifest_id=dependency.manifest_id
            AND reference.section_key='included_rows'
            AND reference.payload_json->>0=expected.input_key
          ORDER BY (reference.payload_json->>3)::double precision,
            reference.payload_json->>1
          LIMIT 20001
        ), bounds AS (
          SELECT percentile_cont(0.01) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS low,
            percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS high,
            count(*)::double precision AS population_count
          FROM population
        ), winsorized AS (
          SELECT greatest(bounds.low,least(bounds.high,population.value)) AS value,
            greatest(bounds.low,least(
              bounds.high,(row.payload_json->>3)::double precision
            )) AS candidate_value,bounds.population_count
          FROM population CROSS JOIN bounds
        )
        SELECT round((100.0*(
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE value<candidate_value)
          +0.5*count(*) FILTER (WHERE value=candidate_value)
        )/nullif(max(population_count),0))::numeric,2)::double precision AS score
        FROM winsorized
      ) percentile ON percentile.score IS NOT NULL
      WHERE expected.input_family='candidate_factor'
        AND expected.input_key NOT IN (
          'sector_excess_return_5d','sector_excess_return_20d'
        )
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 conservation
          WHERE conservation.manifest_id=dependency.manifest_id
            AND conservation.section_key='conservation'
            AND conservation.payload_json->>0=expected.input_key
            AND (conservation.payload_json->>2)::integer>=500
            AND (conservation.payload_json->>2)::double precision
              /nullif((conservation.payload_json->>1)::double precision,0)>=0.80
        )
      UNION ALL
      SELECT expected.*, (row.payload_json->>3)::double precision,
        row.payload_json->>4,row.payload_json->>5,'derived_manifest',
        dependency.manifest_hash
      FROM expected
      JOIN dependencies dependency
        ON dependency.input_key='sector_scoring_reference'
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.manifest_id
        AND row.section_key='sector_excess_included_rows'
        AND row.payload_json->>0=expected.input_key
        AND row.payload_json->>1=expected.symbol
      WHERE expected.input_family='candidate_factor'
        AND expected.input_key IN (
          'sector_excess_return_5d','sector_excess_return_20d'
        )
    ), market_mapping AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('taiex_close','taiex_close'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'TAIEX'),
        ('otc_close','otc_close'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'OTC'),
        ('foreign_cash_net_5d','foreign_cash_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,
          'TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        ('investment_trust_net_5d','trust_cash_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,
          'TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        ('aggregate_margin_balance_change_5d','margin_change_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,
          'TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'),
        ('foreign_index_futures_net_oi','foreign_futures_oi'::public.market_fact_key_v3,
          'TAIFEX'),
        ('put_call_ratio','put_call_ratio'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'TAIFEX'),
        ('taiwan_vix','taiwan_vix'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'TAIFEX'),
        ('sox_return_5d','sox_return_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'SOX'),
        ('nasdaq_return_5d','nasdaq_return_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'NASDAQ'),
        ('usd_twd_return_5d','usd_twd_return_5d'::public.market_fact_key_v3,'USD_TWD')
      ) mapping(input_key,fact_key,scope_key)
    ), market_available AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT expected.*,
        CASE
          WHEN expected.input_key IN (
            'foreign_cash_net_5d','investment_trust_net_5d',
            'aggregate_margin_balance_change_5d','foreign_index_futures_net_oi',
            'put_call_ratio','taiwan_vix','sox_return_5d',
            'nasdaq_return_5d','usd_twd_return_5d'
          )
          THEN (
            public.opportunity_market_zscore_v3_internal(
              observation.fact_key,observation.scope_key,observation.provider,
              observation.provider_identity,observation.authority_date,
              CASE
                WHEN expected.input_key IN (
                  'aggregate_margin_balance_change_5d','put_call_ratio',
                  'taiwan_vix','usd_twd_return_5d'
                ) THEN -observation.value
                ELSE observation.value
              END,
              v_cutoff
            )->>'score'
          )::double precision
          ELSE observation.value
        END AS value,
        observation.observed_at::text,
        observation.source_ref,
        CASE observation.provider
          WHEN 'finmind' THEN 'finmind_mirror'
          WHEN 'node_twstock' THEN 'node_twstock_mirror'
          ELSE 'official' END AS authority_tier,
        NULL::text AS manifest_hash
      FROM expected
      JOIN market_mapping mapping
        ON mapping.input_key=expected.input_key
        AND mapping.scope_key=expected.scope_key
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT selected.*
        FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 selected
        WHERE selected.fact_key=mapping.fact_key
          AND selected.observed_at<=v_cutoff
          AND selected.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          AND selected.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          AND (
            expected.scope_key='TW_ACTIVE_COMMON'
            OR selected.scope_key::text=expected.scope_key
          )
        ORDER BY selected.authority_date DESC,
          CASE selected.provider
            WHEN 'twse' THEN 0 WHEN 'tpex' THEN 0
            WHEN 'taifex' THEN 0 WHEN 'global_allowlisted' THEN 0
            WHEN 'finmind' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
          selected.observed_at DESC,selected.recorded_at DESC,
          selected.source_ref,selected.observation_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) observation ON true
      WHERE expected.input_family='market_context'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT expected.*,average.value,average.observed_at,average.source_ref,
        average.authority_tier,NULL::text
      FROM expected
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT avg(history.value)::double precision AS value,
          max(history.observed_at)::text AS observed_at,
          min(history.source_ref) AS source_ref,
          CASE min(history.provider::text)
            WHEN 'finmind' THEN 'finmind_mirror'
            WHEN 'node_twstock' THEN 'node_twstock_mirror'
            ELSE 'official' END AS authority_tier,
          count(*)::integer AS observation_count
        FROM (
          SELECT selected.value,selected.observed_at,selected.source_ref,
            selected.provider
          FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 selected
          WHERE selected.fact_key=CASE
              WHEN expected.input_key LIKE 'taiex_%'
                THEN 'taiex_close'::public.market_fact_key_v3
              ELSE 'otc_close'::public.market_fact_key_v3 END
            AND selected.scope_key::text=expected.scope_key
            AND selected.observed_at<=v_cutoff
            AND selected.collected_at<=v_cutoff
            AND selected.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          ORDER BY selected.authority_date DESC,selected.recorded_at DESC,
            selected.observation_id
          LIMIT CASE WHEN expected.input_key LIKE '%ma20' THEN 20 ELSE 60 END
        ) history
      ) average ON average.observation_count=
        CASE WHEN expected.input_key LIKE '%ma20' THEN 20 ELSE 60 END
      WHERE expected.input_family='market_context'
        AND expected.input_key IN ('taiex_ma20','taiex_ma60','otc_ma20','otc_ma60')
    ), sector_available AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT expected.*,(row.payload_json->>2)::double precision AS value,
        row.payload_json->>3 AS observed_at,row.payload_json->>4 AS source_ref,
        'derived_manifest' AS authority_tier,dependency.manifest_hash
      FROM expected
      JOIN dependencies dependency
        ON dependency.input_key='sector_scoring_reference'
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.manifest_id
        AND row.section_key='sector_aggregate_rows'
        AND row.payload_json->>0=expected.input_key
        AND row.payload_json->>1=expected.scope_key
      WHERE expected.input_family='sector_context'
    ), available AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM candidate_available
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM market_available
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM sector_available
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'included_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY family_ordinal,key_ordinal,scope_key,symbol NULLS FIRST
        )-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          input_family,input_key,scope_key,symbol,'number',value,NULL,
          observed_at,source_ref,authority_tier,manifest_hash
        ) AS payload
      FROM available
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'included_rows',
        (SELECT count(*) FROM available)+row_number() OVER (ORDER BY key_ordinal)-1,
        NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          'dependency_manifest',input_key,'run',NULL,'manifest_ref',NULL,
          manifest_id::text,NULL,NULL,NULL,manifest_hash
        ) AS payload
      FROM dependencies
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY family_ordinal,key_ordinal,scope_key,symbol NULLS FIRST
        )-1,'missing_observation',
        jsonb_build_array(
          input_family,input_key,scope_key,symbol,'missing_observation',NULL,NULL
        )
      FROM expected
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM available
        WHERE available.input_family=expected.input_family
          AND available.input_key=expected.input_key
          AND available.scope_key=expected.scope_key
          AND available.symbol IS NOT DISTINCT FROM expected.symbol
      )
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY expected.family_ordinal,expected.key_ordinal
        )-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          expected.input_family,expected.input_key,count(*),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE available.input_key IS NOT NULL),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE available.input_key IS NULL),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'provider_conflict',0,'future_observation',0,'stale_observation',0,
            'insufficient_coverage',0,'insufficient_history',0,
            'missing_observation',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE available.input_key IS NULL
            ),'non_finite_value',0,
            'non_positive_denominator',0
          )
        )
      FROM expected
      LEFT JOIN available
        ON available.input_family=expected.input_family
        AND available.input_key=expected.input_key
        AND available.scope_key=expected.scope_key
        AND available.symbol IS NOT DISTINCT FROM expected.symbol
      GROUP BY expected.family_ordinal,expected.key_ordinal,
        expected.input_family,expected.input_key
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',64+key_ordinal,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          'dependency_manifest',input_key,1,1,0,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'provider_conflict',0,'future_observation',0,'stale_observation',0,
            'insufficient_coverage',0,'insufficient_history',0,
            'missing_observation',0,'non_finite_value',0,
            'non_positive_denominator',0
          )
        )
      FROM dependencies
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='mover_price_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH header AS (
      SELECT
        max((pair->>1)::date) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='auditedSession')
          AS audited_session,
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='auditedSessionAuthorityHash')
          AS audited_hash,
        max((pair->>1)::date) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='previousSession')
          AS previous_session,
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='previousSessionAuthorityHash')
          AS previous_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), dependency AS (
      SELECT min(input.manifest_id::text)::uuid AS roster_manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id AND input.input_role='instrument_roster'
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol,
        (row.payload_json->>3)::public.stock_exchange_v3 AS exchange
      FROM dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.roster_manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
      WHERE row.payload_json->>4='common_stock' AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
        AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (row.payload_json->>10 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz)
      ORDER BY row.payload_json->>2
      LIMIT 20001
    ), authorities AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.*,header.*,
        audited.session_authority_id AS audited_authority_id,
        previous.session_authority_id AS previous_authority_id
      FROM roster CROSS JOIN header
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT session.session_authority_id
        FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
        WHERE session.session_id=header.audited_session
          AND session.market::text=roster.exchange::text
          AND session.status='completed'
          AND session.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
          AND session.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          AND session.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY session.recorded_at DESC,session.source_timestamp DESC,
          session.session_authority_id
        LIMIT 2
      ) audited ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT session.session_authority_id
        FROM public.tw_trading_sessions_v3 session
        WHERE session.session_id=header.previous_session
          AND session.market::text=roster.exchange::text
          AND session.status='completed'
          AND session.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
          AND session.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          AND session.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY session.recorded_at DESC,session.source_timestamp DESC,
          session.session_authority_id
        LIMIT 2
      ) previous ON true
    ), resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT authority.*,
        ending.*,prior.*,
        action.snapshot_id,action.dataset_hash,action.event_tuple,action.daily_factor,
        action.action_days
      FROM authorities authority
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT price.observation_id,price.raw_open AS end_open,
          price.raw_high AS end_high,price.raw_low AS end_low,
          price.raw_close AS end_close,price.turnover_twd,
          price.source_ref AS end_source_ref,price.source_timestamp AS end_source_timestamp
        FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 price
        WHERE price.stock_id=authority.stock_id AND price.exchange=authority.exchange
          AND price.session_id=authority.audited_session
          AND price.session_authority_id=authority.audited_authority_id
          AND price.provider IN (
            CASE authority.exchange WHEN 'TWSE' THEN 'twse'::public.price_provider_v3
              ELSE 'tpex'::public.price_provider_v3 END,
            'finmind'::public.price_provider_v3
          )
          AND price.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND price.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          AND price.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY CASE
            WHEN price.provider::text=lower(authority.exchange::text) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
          price.source_timestamp DESC,price.collected_at DESC,price.recorded_at DESC,
          price.source_ref,price.observation_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) ending ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT price.observation_id AS prior_observation_id,
          price.raw_open AS prior_open,price.raw_high AS prior_high,
          price.raw_low AS prior_low,price.raw_close AS prior_close,
          price.source_ref AS prior_source_ref,
          price.source_timestamp AS prior_source_timestamp
        FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 price
        WHERE price.stock_id=authority.stock_id AND price.exchange=authority.exchange
          AND price.session_id=authority.previous_session
          AND price.session_authority_id=authority.previous_authority_id
          AND price.provider IN (
            CASE authority.exchange WHEN 'TWSE' THEN 'twse'::public.price_provider_v3
              ELSE 'tpex'::public.price_provider_v3 END,
            'finmind'::public.price_provider_v3
          )
          AND price.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff AND price.collected_at<=v_cutoff
          AND price.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
        ORDER BY CASE
            WHEN price.provider::text=lower(authority.exchange::text) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
          price.source_timestamp DESC,price.collected_at DESC,price.recorded_at DESC,
          price.source_ref,price.observation_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) prior ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT snapshot.snapshot_id,snapshot.dataset_hash,
          coalesce(event.daily_adjustment_factor,1::double precision) AS daily_factor,
          CASE WHEN event.snapshot_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_array(
            event.event_kind,event.pre_action_reference_price,
            event.post_action_reference_price,event.feed_identity,event.source_row_ref
          ) END AS event_tuple,
          jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(
            authority.audited_session,authority.audited_authority_id,
            snapshot.snapshot_id,snapshot.dataset_hash,
            CASE WHEN event.snapshot_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_array(
              event.event_kind,event.pre_action_reference_price,
              event.post_action_reference_price,event.feed_identity,event.source_row_ref
            ) END,
            coalesce(event.daily_adjustment_factor,1::double precision)
          )) AS action_days
        FROM public.opportunity_corporate_action_snapshots_v3 snapshot
        LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_corporate_action_events_v3 event
          ON event.snapshot_id=snapshot.snapshot_id AND event.symbol=authority.symbol
        WHERE snapshot.exchange=authority.exchange
          AND snapshot.session_id=authority.audited_session
          AND snapshot.session_authority_id=authority.audited_authority_id
          AND snapshot.collected_at<=v_cutoff AND snapshot.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_corporate_action_feed_evidence_v3 feed
            WHERE feed.snapshot_id=snapshot.snapshot_id)=3
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.opportunity_corporate_action_events_v3 member
            WHERE member.snapshot_id=snapshot.snapshot_id)=snapshot.declared_event_count
        ORDER BY snapshot.collected_at DESC,snapshot.recorded_at DESC,snapshot.snapshot_id
        LIMIT 1
      ) action ON true
    ), evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT resolved.*,
        jsonb_build_array(
          'adjusted-price-evidence-v3.1',audited_session,observation_id,
          end_source_ref,audited_authority_id,end_open,end_high,end_low,end_close,
          '[]'::jsonb,1,end_open,end_high,end_low,end_close
        ) AS end_evidence,
        jsonb_build_array(
          'adjusted-price-evidence-v3.1',audited_session,prior_observation_id,
          prior_source_ref,previous_authority_id,prior_open,prior_high,prior_low,prior_close,
          action_days,daily_factor,prior_open*daily_factor,prior_high*daily_factor,
          prior_low*daily_factor,prior_close*daily_factor
        ) AS prior_evidence
      FROM resolved
    ), terminal AS (
      SELECT evidence.*,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
          end_evidence::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS end_price_ref,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
          prior_evidence::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS prior_price_ref,
        CASE
          WHEN audited_authority_id IS NULL OR previous_authority_id IS NULL
            THEN 'calendar_authority_mismatch'
          WHEN observation_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_current_close'
          WHEN prior_observation_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_previous_close'
          WHEN snapshot_id IS NULL THEN 'missing_corporate_action_snapshot'
          WHEN turnover_twd IS NULL THEN 'missing_turnover'
          WHEN prior_close*daily_factor<=0 THEN 'non_positive_previous_close'
          WHEN turnover_twd<20000000 THEN 'turnover_below_20000000'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS exclusion_reason
      FROM evidence
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'included_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY symbol)-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,stock_id,audited_session,audited_hash,previous_session,previous_hash,
          audited_authority_id,previous_authority_id,end_close,prior_close*daily_factor,
          turnover_twd,end_evidence,prior_evidence,end_price_ref,prior_price_ref,
          end_source_timestamp,prior_source_timestamp,'tw-corporate-action-v3.1'
        ) AS payload
      FROM terminal WHERE exclusion_reason IS NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'excluded_rows',row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY exclusion_reason,symbol
        )-1,exclusion_reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          symbol,stock_id,exclusion_reason,audited_session,audited_hash,
          previous_session,previous_hash,
          CASE WHEN observation_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE end_price_ref END,
          CASE WHEN prior_observation_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE prior_price_ref END
        )
      FROM terminal WHERE exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',0,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason IS NULL),
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'calendar_authority_mismatch',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='calendar_authority_mismatch'
            ),
            'provider_conflict',0,'future_observation',0,
            'missing_current_close',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_current_close'
            ),
            'missing_previous_close',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_previous_close'
            ),
            'missing_corporate_action_snapshot',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_corporate_action_snapshot'
            ),
            'missing_turnover',count(*) FILTER (WHERE exclusion_reason='missing_turnover'),
            'non_finite_value',0,
            'non_positive_previous_close',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='non_positive_previous_close'
            ),
            'turnover_below_20000000',count(*) FILTER (
              WHERE exclusion_reason='turnover_below_20000000'
            )
          )
        )
      FROM terminal
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='sector_scoring_reference' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH dependencies AS (
      SELECT
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster'
        )::uuid AS roster_manifest_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='taxonomy_assignment'
        )::uuid AS taxonomy_manifest_id,
        min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
          WHERE input.input_role='factor_scoring_reference'
        )::uuid AS factor_manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
    ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid AS stock_id,row.payload_json->>2 AS symbol
      FROM dependencies dependency
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=dependency.roster_manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
      WHERE row.payload_json->>4='common_stock' AND row.payload_json->>5='active'
        AND (row.payload_json->>9)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
        AND (row.payload_json->>10 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>10)::timestamptz)
      ORDER BY row.payload_json->>2
      LIMIT 20001
    ), constituents AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT roster.*,coalesce(sector.canonical_sector,'unknown') AS canonical_sector
      FROM roster
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT row.payload_json->>4 AS canonical_sector
        FROM dependencies dependency
        JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
          ON row.manifest_id=dependency.taxonomy_manifest_id AND row.section_key='rows'
        WHERE (row.payload_json->>1)::uuid=roster.stock_id
          AND row.payload_json->>10='active'
          AND (row.payload_json->>7)::timestamptz<=v_cutoff
          AND (row.payload_json->>8 IS NULL OR v_cutoff<(row.payload_json->>8)::timestamptz)
        ORDER BY row.row_ordinal LIMIT 2
      ) sector ON true
    ), aggregate_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'sector_return_5d'),(2,'sector_return_20d'),(3,'sector_return_60d'),
        (4,'sector_excess_return_20d'),(5,'sector_excess_return_60d'),
        (6,'sector_ad_breadth_20d'),(7,'sector_revenue_yoy_median'),
        (8,'sector_eps_yoy_median'),(9,'sector_revenue_acceleration_median'),
        (10,'sector_operating_margin_delta_median')
      ) key(key_ordinal,aggregate_key)
    ), sectors AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT canonical_sector
      FROM constituents WHERE canonical_sector<>'unknown'
    ), price_features AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT constituent.stock_id,constituent.symbol,constituent.canonical_sector,
        prices.observed_at,prices.source_ref,
        prices.return_5d,prices.return_20d,prices.return_60d,
        CASE WHEN prices.return_20d IS NULL OR prices.return_20d=0 THEN NULL
          WHEN prices.return_20d>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS breadth_20d
      FROM constituents constituent
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        WITH selected_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT selected.*,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY selected.session_id DESC) AS history_rank,
            max(selected.session_id) OVER () AS anchor_session
          FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (price.session_id)
              price.observation_id,price.session_id,price.source_timestamp,
              price.source_ref
            FROM public.opportunity_price_observations_v3 price
            WHERE price.stock_id=constituent.stock_id
              AND price.source_timestamp<=v_cutoff
              AND price.collected_at<=v_cutoff
              AND price.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
            ORDER BY price.session_id DESC,price.source_timestamp DESC,
              price.collected_at DESC,price.recorded_at DESC,
              price.source_ref,price.observation_id
            LIMIT 61
          ) selected
        ), adjusted AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT selected_raw.*,
            public.opportunity_adjusted_price_evidence_v3_internal(
              selected_raw.observation_id,selected_raw.anchor_session,v_cutoff
            ) AS payload
          FROM selected_raw
        )
        SELECT
          max(source_timestamp) AS observed_at,
          min(payload->>'ref') AS source_ref,
          100.0*(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
            FILTER (WHERE history_rank=1)
            /nullif(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
              FILTER (WHERE history_rank=6),0)-1.0) AS return_5d,
          100.0*(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
            FILTER (WHERE history_rank=1)
            /nullif(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
              FILTER (WHERE history_rank=21),0)-1.0) AS return_20d,
          100.0*(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
            FILTER (WHERE history_rank=1)
            /nullif(max((payload#>>'{evidence,14}')::double precision)
              FILTER (WHERE history_rank=61),0)-1.0) AS return_60d
        FROM adjusted
        WHERE payload IS NOT NULL
      ) prices ON true
    ), evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT key.key_ordinal,key.aggregate_key,constituent.canonical_sector,
        constituent.symbol,
        jsonb_build_array(
          constituent.symbol,
          CASE WHEN factor.payload_json IS NOT NULL
            THEN (factor.payload_json->>3)::double precision ELSE NULL END,
          factor.payload_json->>4,factor.payload_json->>5,
          CASE WHEN factor.payload_json IS NULL
            THEN 'missing_observation' ELSE NULL END
        ) AS evidence
      FROM aggregate_keys key JOIN constituents constituent
        ON constituent.canonical_sector<>'unknown'
      CROSS JOIN dependencies dependency
      LEFT JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 factor
        ON factor.manifest_id=dependency.factor_manifest_id
        AND factor.section_key='included_rows'
        AND factor.payload_json->>1=constituent.symbol
        AND factor.payload_json->>0=CASE key.aggregate_key
          WHEN 'sector_revenue_yoy_median' THEN 'monthly_revenue_yoy'
          WHEN 'sector_eps_yoy_median' THEN 'quarterly_eps_yoy'
          WHEN 'sector_revenue_acceleration_median'
            THEN 'revenue_yoy_acceleration_3m'
          WHEN 'sector_operating_margin_delta_median'
            THEN 'operating_margin_yoy_delta'
          ELSE NULL END
      WHERE key.aggregate_key IN (
        'sector_revenue_yoy_median','sector_eps_yoy_median',
        'sector_revenue_acceleration_median',
        'sector_operating_margin_delta_median'
      )
      UNION ALL
      SELECT key.key_ordinal,key.aggregate_key,price.canonical_sector,
        price.symbol,
        jsonb_build_array(
          price.symbol,
          CASE key.aggregate_key
            WHEN 'sector_return_5d' THEN price.return_5d
            WHEN 'sector_return_20d' THEN price.return_20d
            WHEN 'sector_return_60d' THEN price.return_60d
            ELSE price.breadth_20d END,
          price.observed_at,price.source_ref,
          CASE
            WHEN key.aggregate_key='sector_return_5d'
              AND price.return_5d IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_history'
            WHEN key.aggregate_key='sector_return_20d'
              AND price.return_20d IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_history'
            WHEN key.aggregate_key='sector_return_60d'
              AND price.return_60d IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_history'
            WHEN key.aggregate_key='sector_ad_breadth_20d'
              AND price.breadth_20d IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_history'
            ELSE NULL END
        )
      FROM aggregate_keys key JOIN price_features price
        ON price.canonical_sector<>'unknown'
      WHERE key.aggregate_key IN (
        'sector_return_5d','sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d',
        'sector_ad_breadth_20d'
      )
      UNION ALL
      SELECT key.key_ordinal,key.aggregate_key,constituent.canonical_sector,
        constituent.symbol,
        jsonb_build_array(constituent.symbol,NULL,NULL,NULL,'missing_observation')
      FROM aggregate_keys key JOIN constituents constituent
        ON constituent.canonical_sector='unknown'
      WHERE key.aggregate_key IN ('sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d')
    ), evidence_hashes AS (
      SELECT aggregate_key,canonical_sector,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
          jsonb_agg(evidence ORDER BY symbol)::text,', ', ',', 'g'
        ),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS evidence_hash,
        count(*)::integer AS constituent_count
      FROM evidence GROUP BY aggregate_key,canonical_sector
    ), aggregate_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT key.key_ordinal,key.aggregate_key,sector.canonical_sector,
        count(constituent.symbol)::integer AS frozen_count,
        count(*) FILTER (
          WHERE evidence.evidence->>4 IS NULL
        )::integer AS included_count,
        CASE WHEN key.aggregate_key='sector_ad_breadth_20d'
          THEN 100.0*avg((evidence.evidence->>1)::double precision)
            FILTER (WHERE evidence.evidence->>4 IS NULL
              AND evidence.evidence->>1 IS NOT NULL)
          WHEN key.aggregate_key IN (
            'sector_return_5d','sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d'
          ) THEN avg((evidence.evidence->>1)::double precision)
            FILTER (WHERE evidence.evidence->>4 IS NULL)
          ELSE percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY (evidence.evidence->>1)::double precision
          ) FILTER (WHERE evidence.evidence->>4 IS NULL) END AS median_value,
        coalesce(hash.evidence_hash,encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(
          '[]','utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')) AS evidence_hash
      FROM aggregate_keys key CROSS JOIN sectors sector
      LEFT JOIN constituents constituent
        ON constituent.canonical_sector=sector.canonical_sector
      LEFT JOIN evidence
        ON evidence.aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
        AND evidence.canonical_sector=sector.canonical_sector
        AND evidence.symbol=constituent.symbol
      LEFT JOIN evidence_hashes hash
        ON hash.aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
        AND hash.canonical_sector=sector.canonical_sector
      GROUP BY key.key_ordinal,key.aggregate_key,sector.canonical_sector,
        hash.evidence_hash
    ), market_benchmarks AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT horizon,
        count(*)::integer AS frozen_count,
        count(value)::integer AS included_count,
        avg(value)::double precision AS benchmark_return,
        max(observed_at) AS observed_at,
        min(source_ref) AS source_ref,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(
          coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(symbol,value,source_ref)
            ORDER BY symbol),'[]'::jsonb)::text,', ', ',', 'g'
        ),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS evidence_hash
      FROM (
        SELECT symbol,observed_at,source_ref,'20d' AS horizon,
          return_20d AS value FROM price_features
        UNION ALL
        SELECT symbol,observed_at,source_ref,'60d',return_60d
          FROM price_features
      ) population
      GROUP BY horizon
    ), aggregate_base_included AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT stats.*
      FROM aggregate_stats stats
      WHERE stats.aggregate_key NOT IN (
          'sector_excess_return_20d','sector_excess_return_60d'
        )
        AND stats.frozen_count>=5
        AND stats.included_count>=ceil(
          CASE WHEN stats.aggregate_key IN (
            'sector_return_5d','sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d',
            'sector_ad_breadth_20d'
          ) THEN 0.80 ELSE 0.60 END * stats.frozen_count
        )
    ), aggregate_included AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM aggregate_base_included
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        CASE source.aggregate_key
          WHEN 'sector_return_20d' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS key_ordinal,
        CASE source.aggregate_key
          WHEN 'sector_return_20d' THEN 'sector_excess_return_20d'
          ELSE 'sector_excess_return_60d' END AS aggregate_key,
        source.canonical_sector,source.frozen_count,source.included_count,
        source.median_value-market.benchmark_return AS median_value,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
          source.evidence_hash,market.evidence_hash
        )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS evidence_hash
      FROM aggregate_base_included source
      JOIN market_benchmarks market
        ON market.horizon=CASE source.aggregate_key
          WHEN 'sector_return_20d' THEN '20d' ELSE '60d' END
        AND market.frozen_count>=500
        AND market.included_count>=ceil(0.80*market.frozen_count)
      WHERE source.aggregate_key IN ('sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d')
    ), aggregate_exclusions AS (
      SELECT stats.*,
        CASE
          WHEN stats.frozen_count<5 THEN 'insufficient_constituents'
          WHEN stats.aggregate_key IN (
            'sector_return_5d','sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d',
            'sector_ad_breadth_20d'
          ) THEN 'insufficient_endpoint_coverage'
          WHEN stats.aggregate_key IN (
            'sector_excess_return_20d','sector_excess_return_60d'
          ) THEN 'missing_market_benchmark'
          ELSE 'insufficient_financial_coverage'
        END AS exclusion_reason
      FROM aggregate_stats stats
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM aggregate_included included
        WHERE included.aggregate_key=stats.aggregate_key
          AND included.canonical_sector=stats.canonical_sector
      )
    ), excess_keys AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1,'sector_excess_return_5d'),(2,'sector_excess_return_20d')
      ) feature(feature_ordinal,feature_key)
    ), excess_population AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT feature.feature_ordinal,feature.feature_key,
        constituent.symbol,constituent.canonical_sector,
        CASE feature.feature_key
          WHEN 'sector_excess_return_5d' THEN price.return_5d
          ELSE price.return_20d END-sector.median_value AS excess_return,
        price.observed_at,price.source_ref,sector.evidence_hash
      FROM excess_keys feature CROSS JOIN constituents constituent
      LEFT JOIN price_features price ON price.stock_id=constituent.stock_id
      LEFT JOIN aggregate_included sector
        ON sector.canonical_sector=constituent.canonical_sector
        AND sector.aggregate_key=CASE feature.feature_key
          WHEN 'sector_excess_return_5d' THEN 'sector_return_5d'
          ELSE 'sector_return_20d' END
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'market_benchmark_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3
          AS section_key,
        CASE horizon WHEN '20d' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          horizon,benchmark_return,observed_at,source_ref,frozen_count,
          included_count,round(100.0*included_count/nullif(frozen_count,0),2),
          evidence_hash,NULL
        ) AS payload
      FROM market_benchmarks
      WHERE frozen_count>=500
        AND included_count>=ceil(0.80*frozen_count)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'market_benchmark_rows',
        CASE horizon WHEN '20d' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        'insufficient_endpoint_coverage',
        jsonb_build_array(
          horizon,NULL,observed_at,source_ref,frozen_count,included_count,
          round(100.0*included_count/nullif(frozen_count,0),2),
          evidence_hash,'insufficient_endpoint_coverage'
        )
      FROM market_benchmarks
      WHERE frozen_count<500
        OR included_count<ceil(0.80*frozen_count)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_aggregate_rows',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY key_ordinal,canonical_sector
        )-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          aggregate_key,canonical_sector,median_value,v_cutoff,NULL,
          frozen_count,included_count,
          round(100.0*included_count/nullif(frozen_count,0),2),
          evidence_hash
        )
      FROM aggregate_included
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_aggregate_exclusions',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY key_ordinal,canonical_sector
        )-1,exclusion_reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          aggregate_key,canonical_sector,NULL,v_cutoff,NULL,NULL,
          frozen_count,included_count,
          round(100.0*included_count/nullif(frozen_count,0),2),
          evidence_hash,exclusion_reason
        )
      FROM aggregate_exclusions
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'aggregate_evidence_rows',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY key_ordinal,canonical_sector,symbol
        )-1,evidence->>4,
        jsonb_build_array(aggregate_key,canonical_sector,evidence)
      FROM evidence
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_excess_included_rows',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY feature_ordinal,symbol
        )-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          feature_key,symbol,canonical_sector,excess_return,
          observed_at,source_ref,evidence_hash
        )
      FROM excess_population
      WHERE excess_return IS NOT NULL AND canonical_sector<>'unknown'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'sector_excess_excluded_rows',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY feature_ordinal,symbol
        )-1,
        CASE WHEN canonical_sector='unknown'
          THEN 'unknown_sector'
          WHEN observed_at IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_stock_endpoint_coverage'
          ELSE 'insufficient_sector_endpoint_coverage' END,
        jsonb_build_array(
          feature_key,symbol,canonical_sector,
          CASE WHEN canonical_sector='unknown'
            THEN 'unknown_sector'
            WHEN observed_at IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_stock_endpoint_coverage'
            ELSE 'insufficient_sector_endpoint_coverage' END,
          NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
        )
      FROM excess_population
      WHERE excess_return IS NULL OR canonical_sector='unknown'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'conservation',key.key_ordinal-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          key.aggregate_key,(SELECT count(*) FROM sectors),
          (SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_included
            WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key),
          (SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_exclusions
            WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'provider_conflict',0,'future_observation',0,
            'insufficient_constituents',(SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_exclusions
              WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
                AND exclusion_reason='insufficient_constituents'),
            'insufficient_endpoint_coverage',(SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_exclusions
              WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
                AND exclusion_reason='insufficient_endpoint_coverage'),
            'missing_market_benchmark',(SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_exclusions
              WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
                AND exclusion_reason='missing_market_benchmark'),
            'insufficient_financial_coverage',(SELECT count(*) FROM aggregate_exclusions
              WHERE aggregate_key=key.aggregate_key
                AND exclusion_reason='insufficient_financial_coverage'),
            'stale_observation',0,'missing_observation',0,
            'non_finite_value',0,'non_positive_denominator',0
          ),
          CASE WHEN key.aggregate_key IN (
            'sector_return_20d','sector_return_60d'
          ) THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM constituents)
          ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM constituents WHERE canonical_sector<>'unknown') END,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM evidence WHERE key_ordinal=key.key_ordinal)
        )
      FROM aggregate_keys key
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='link_audit_sample' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH manifest_header AS (
      SELECT
        max(pair->>1) FILTER (WHERE pair->>0='evaluationManifestHash')
          AS evaluation_manifest_hash
      FROM public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(manifest.header_json) pair
      WHERE manifest.manifest_id=requested_manifest_id
    ), evaluation_manifest AS (
      SELECT input.manifest_id
      FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifests_v3 manifest
        ON manifest.manifest_id=input.manifest_id
        AND manifest.status='complete'
      WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
        AND input.input_role='evaluation_input' AND input.ordinal=0
    ), supplying_runs AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT (row.payload_json->>2)::uuid AS enrich_run_id
      FROM evaluation_manifest manifest
      JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 row
        ON row.manifest_id=manifest.manifest_id
        AND row.section_key IN ('backtest_rows','live_rows')
    ), population AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT mention.run_id,claim.claim_id,mention.mention_id,mention.mention_ordinal,
        revision.source_key::text AS connector,mention.link_mode::text AS link_mode,
        CASE
          WHEN mention.outcome IN (
            'linked_new','linked_refresh','linked_duplicate_claim'
          ) THEN 'linked'
          WHEN mention.outcome='ambiguous_symbol' THEN 'ambiguous'
          WHEN mention.outcome='rejected_low_confidence' THEN 'rejected'
          ELSE 'unsupported'
        END AS outcome_family,
        claim.source_ref,mention.review_context,
        mention.review_mention_start_offset,mention.review_mention_end_offset,
        mention.normalized_token,mention.outcome::text AS engine_outcome,
        mention.reason::text AS engine_reason,mention.symbol AS engine_symbol,
        encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
          'link-audit-selection-v3.0',mention.run_id,claim.claim_id,
          mention.mention_ordinal
        )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS selection_hash
      FROM supplying_runs supplying
      JOIN public.opportunity_runs enrich ON enrich.run_id=supplying.enrich_run_id
      JOIN public.opportunity_source_mentions mention
        ON mention.run_id=enrich.upstream_run_id
      JOIN public.opportunity_source_claims claim
        ON claim.run_id=mention.run_id
        AND claim.revision_id=mention.revision_id
        AND claim.claim_ordinal=mention.claim_ordinal
      JOIN public.source_document_revisions_v3 revision
        ON revision.revision_id=mention.revision_id
      WHERE mention.recorded_at<=v_cutoff AND claim.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
    ), stratum_counts AS (
      SELECT connector,link_mode,outcome_family,count(*)::integer AS population_count
      FROM population GROUP BY connector,link_mode,outcome_family
    ), totals AS (
      SELECT least(400,coalesce(sum(population_count),0))::integer AS sample_size,
        count(*)::integer AS stratum_count
      FROM stratum_counts
    ), bases AS (
      SELECT counts.*,totals.sample_size,totals.stratum_count,
        least(counts.population_count,
          CASE WHEN totals.stratum_count=0 THEN 0
            ELSE floor(totals.sample_size::numeric/totals.stratum_count)::integer END
        ) AS base_allocation
      FROM stratum_counts counts CROSS JOIN totals
    ), remaining AS (
      SELECT bases.*,
        greatest(0,bases.population_count-bases.base_allocation) AS residual_count,
        bases.sample_size-sum(bases.base_allocation) OVER () AS remaining_seats
      FROM bases
    ), shares AS (
      SELECT remaining.*,
        CASE WHEN sum(residual_count) OVER ()=0 THEN 0::numeric
          ELSE remaining_seats::numeric*residual_count/sum(residual_count) OVER ()
        END AS ideal_share
      FROM remaining
    ), apportioned AS (
      SELECT shares.*,
        floor(ideal_share)::integer AS floor_share,
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY ideal_share-floor(ideal_share) DESC,
            connector,link_mode,outcome_family
        ) AS remainder_rank,
        remaining_seats-sum(floor(ideal_share)::integer) OVER () AS leftover
      FROM shares
    ), allocations AS (
      SELECT connector,link_mode,outcome_family,population_count,
        base_allocation+floor_share+
          CASE WHEN remainder_rank<=leftover AND residual_count>floor_share THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          AS allocated_count
      FROM apportioned
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT population.*,
        allocation.population_count,allocation.allocated_count,
        row_number() OVER (
          PARTITION BY population.connector,population.link_mode,population.outcome_family
          ORDER BY population.selection_hash,population.run_id,
            population.claim_id,population.mention_ordinal
        ) AS selection_ordinal
      FROM population
      JOIN allocations allocation USING(connector,link_mode,outcome_family)
    ), sampled AS (
      SELECT ranked.*,
        jsonb_build_array(
          connector,source_ref,review_context,review_mention_start_offset,
          review_mention_end_offset,normalized_token,link_mode,engine_outcome,
          engine_reason,engine_symbol
        ) AS review_evidence
      FROM ranked WHERE selection_ordinal<=allocated_count
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'strata'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY connector,link_mode,outcome_family)-1 AS ordinal,
        NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          connector,link_mode,outcome_family,population_count,allocated_count
        ) AS payload
      FROM allocations
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'samples',
        row_number() OVER (
          ORDER BY connector,link_mode,outcome_family,selection_hash,
            run_id,claim_id,mention_ordinal
        )-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
            'link-audit-sample-v3.0',
            (SELECT evaluation_manifest_hash FROM manifest_header),
            run_id,claim_id,mention_ordinal
          )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
          connector,link_mode,outcome_family,run_id,claim_id,mention_ordinal,
          selection_hash,review_evidence,
          encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
            'link-audit-review-evidence-v3.0',run_id,claim_id,mention_ordinal,
            review_evidence
          )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex')
        )
      FROM sampled
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF requested_kind='link_audit_resolution' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH samples AS (
      SELECT sample.*
      FROM public.opportunity_link_audit_samples sample
      WHERE sample.sample_manifest_id=(
        SELECT input.manifest_id
        FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
        WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
          AND input.input_role='link_audit_sample' AND input.ordinal=0
      )
    ), labels AS (
      SELECT label.* FROM public.opportunity_link_audit_labels label
      JOIN samples sample USING(sample_manifest_id,sample_id)
      WHERE label.recorded_at<=v_cutoff
    ), pivoted AS (
      SELECT sample.sample_id,
        max(label.canonical_symbol) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_1') AS one_symbol,
        bool_or(label.no_link) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_1') AS one_no_link,
        max(label.label_hash) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_1') AS one_hash,
        max(label.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_1') AS one_at,
        max(label.canonical_symbol) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_2') AS two_symbol,
        bool_or(label.no_link) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_2') AS two_no_link,
        max(label.label_hash) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_2') AS two_hash,
        max(label.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='reviewer_2') AS two_at,
        max(label.canonical_symbol) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='adjudicator') AS final_symbol,
        bool_or(label.no_link) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='adjudicator') AS final_no_link,
        max(label.label_hash) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='adjudicator') AS final_hash,
        max(label.recorded_at) FILTER (WHERE label.label_role='adjudicator') AS final_at
      FROM samples sample LEFT JOIN labels label USING(sample_manifest_id,sample_id)
      GROUP BY sample.sample_id
    ), classified AS (
      SELECT pivoted.*,
        CASE
          WHEN one_hash IS NOT NULL AND two_hash IS NOT NULL
            AND one_symbol IS NOT DISTINCT FROM two_symbol
            AND one_no_link IS NOT DISTINCT FROM two_no_link
          THEN 'reviewer_agreement'
          WHEN final_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 'terminal_adjudication'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS resolution_kind
      FROM pivoted
    ), native AS (
      SELECT 'resolved_rows'::public.opportunity_manifest_section_key_v3 AS section_key,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sample_id)-1 AS ordinal,NULL::text AS reason,
        jsonb_build_array(
          sample_id,resolution_kind,
          CASE resolution_kind WHEN 'reviewer_agreement' THEN one_symbol ELSE final_symbol END,
          CASE resolution_kind WHEN 'reviewer_agreement' THEN one_no_link ELSE final_no_link END,
          CASE resolution_kind
            WHEN 'reviewer_agreement' THEN jsonb_build_array(one_hash,two_hash)
            ELSE jsonb_build_array(one_hash,two_hash,final_hash)
          END,
          greatest(one_at,two_at,final_at)
        ) AS payload
      FROM classified WHERE resolution_kind IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'unresolved_rows',
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sample_id)-1,NULL,
        jsonb_build_array(
          sample_id,
          CASE
            WHEN one_hash IS NULL THEN 'missing_reviewer_1'
            WHEN two_hash IS NULL THEN 'missing_reviewer_2'
            ELSE 'reviewer_disagreement_pending_adjudication'
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN one_hash IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb
            WHEN two_hash IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(one_hash)
            ELSE jsonb_build_array(one_hash,two_hash)
          END
        )
      FROM classified WHERE resolution_kind IS NULL
    )
    SELECT native.ordinal::bigint,native.reason,native.payload
    FROM native WHERE native.section_key=requested_section
    ORDER BY native.ordinal OFFSET requested_offset LIMIT requested_limit;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN;
END
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_market_zscore_v3_internal(market_fact_key_v3,market_scope_key_v3,market_provider_v3,text,date,double precision,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_market_zscore_v3_internal(requested_fact market_fact_key_v3, requested_scope market_scope_key_v3, requested_provider market_provider_v3, requested_provider_identity text, requested_authority_date date, requested_value double precision, requested_source_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
WITH newest_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT observation.authority_date
  FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.fact_key=requested_fact
    AND observation.scope_key=requested_scope
    AND observation.provider=requested_provider
    AND observation.provider_identity IS NOT DISTINCT FROM requested_provider_identity
    AND observation.authority_date<requested_authority_date
    AND observation.observed_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.collected_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
  ORDER BY observation.authority_date DESC
  LIMIT 512
), raw_history AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT observation.*
  FROM public.opportunity_market_observations_v3 observation
  WHERE observation.fact_key=requested_fact
    AND observation.scope_key=requested_scope
    AND observation.provider=requested_provider
    AND observation.provider_identity IS NOT DISTINCT FROM requested_provider_identity
    AND observation.authority_date IN (SELECT authority_date FROM newest_dates)
    AND observation.observed_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.collected_at<=requested_source_cutoff
    AND observation.recorded_at<=requested_source_cutoff
  ORDER BY observation.authority_date DESC,observation.recorded_at DESC,
    observation.observation_id
  LIMIT 32769
), ranked AS (
  SELECT raw_history.*,
    dense_rank() OVER (
      PARTITION BY authority_date
      ORDER BY observed_at DESC,collected_at DESC,recorded_at DESC,source_ref
    ) AS authority_rank
  FROM raw_history
), resolved AS (
  SELECT authority_date,min(CASE
    WHEN requested_fact IN (
      'margin_change_5d','put_call_ratio','taiwan_vix','usd_twd_return_5d'
    ) THEN -value ELSE value END) AS value
  FROM ranked
  WHERE authority_rank=1
  GROUP BY authority_date
  HAVING count(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN requested_fact IN (
      'margin_change_5d','put_call_ratio','taiwan_vix','usd_twd_return_5d'
    ) THEN -value ELSE value END)=1
  ORDER BY authority_date DESC
  LIMIT 252
), statistics AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS history_count,avg(value) AS mean_value,
    stddev_pop(value) AS population_deviation
  FROM resolved
), normalized AS (
  SELECT history_count,mean_value,population_deviation,
    CASE
      WHEN history_count<60 THEN NULL
      WHEN population_deviation>0
        THEN (requested_value-mean_value)/population_deviation
      WHEN requested_value=mean_value THEN 0
      WHEN requested_value>mean_value THEN 10
      ELSE -10
    END AS zscore
  FROM statistics
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'status',CASE WHEN history_count<60 THEN 'missing' ELSE 'fresh' END,
  'reason',CASE
    WHEN history_count<60 THEN 'insufficient_history'
    WHEN population_deviation=0 THEN 'zero_variance'
    ELSE NULL END,
  'historyCount',history_count,
  'score',CASE WHEN zscore IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE greatest(0,least(100,50+15*zscore)) END
)
FROM normalized
$function$

functions.name: opportunity_peer_authority_header_counts_v3_internal(uuid,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.opportunity_peer_authority_header_counts_v3_internal(requested_run_id uuid, requested_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
WITH guard AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT public.opportunity_authority_selected_stream_count_v3_internal(
    'peer_relationship',requested_cutoff
  ) AS selected_stream_count
), dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
      WHERE input.input_role='instrument_roster'
    )::uuid AS roster_manifest_id,
    min(input.manifest_id::text) FILTER (
      WHERE input.input_role='peer_reviewer_allowlist'
    )::uuid AS reviewer_manifest_id
  FROM public.opportunity_run_manifest_inputs input
  WHERE input.run_id=requested_run_id
), bounded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical
  FROM public.opportunity_authority_stream_registry_v3
  WHERE family='peer_relationship'
  ORDER BY stream_key_hash,stream_key_canonical LIMIT 100001
), decoded_registry AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT stream_key_hash,
    (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>1)::uuid supplier_stock_id,
    (convert_from(stream_key_canonical,'utf8')::jsonb->>2)::uuid customer_stock_id
  FROM bounded_registry
), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT registry.stream_key_hash,relationship.*
  FROM decoded_registry registry
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT retained.*
    FROM public.stock_peer_relationships_v3 retained
    WHERE retained.supplier_stock_id=registry.supplier_stock_id
      AND retained.customer_stock_id=registry.customer_stock_id
      AND retained.relationship_kind='supply_chain'
    ORDER BY retained.recorded_at DESC,retained.relationship_authority_id LIMIT 65
  ) relationship
), latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw.stream_key_hash) raw.*
  FROM raw
  WHERE raw.recorded_at<=requested_cutoff
    AND raw.source_timestamp<=requested_cutoff
    AND raw.approved_at<=requested_cutoff
    AND raw.valid_from<=requested_cutoff
  ORDER BY raw.stream_key_hash,raw.recorded_at DESC,raw.relationship_authority_id
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT latest.*,
    supplier.symbol AS roster_supplier,
    customer.symbol AS roster_customer,
    CASE
      WHEN latest.source_timestamp>latest.approved_at THEN 'source_after_approval'
      WHEN latest.status<>'active' THEN 'inactive_status'
      WHEN latest.valid_from>requested_cutoff THEN 'not_yet_valid'
      WHEN latest.valid_to IS NOT NULL AND latest.valid_to<=requested_cutoff THEN 'expired'
      WHEN latest.supplier_stock_id=latest.customer_stock_id THEN 'self_edge'
      WHEN supplier.symbol IS NULL THEN 'ineligible_supplier'
      WHEN customer.symbol IS NULL THEN 'ineligible_customer'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dependencies dependency
        JOIN public.opportunity_manifest_rows_v3 reviewer
          ON reviewer.manifest_id=dependency.reviewer_manifest_id
          AND reviewer.section_key='rows'
        WHERE reviewer.payload_json->>1=latest.reviewer_principal_id::text
          AND reviewer.payload_json->>5='active'
          AND (reviewer.payload_json->>3)::timestamptz<=requested_cutoff
          AND (
            reviewer.payload_json->>4 IS NULL
            OR requested_cutoff<(reviewer.payload_json->>4)::timestamptz
          )
      ) THEN 'reviewer_not_allowed'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (
